import secrets
from django.conf import settings
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import F
from django.utils import timezone
from common.fields import SafeJsonField
from common.phone import normalize_ph_phone

SUFFIX_CHOICES = [("", "None"), ("Jr.", "Jr."), ("Sr.", "Sr."), ("II", "II"), ("III", "III"), ("IV", "IV")]
USER_ROLE_CHOICES = [
    ("ADMIN", "System Administrator"),
    ("PRINCIPAL", "School Principal"),
    ("DEPT_HEAD", "Department Head"),
    ("FACULTY", "Teacher / Adviser"),
    ("PARENT", "Parent / Guardian"),
]


class TeacherProfile(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    employee_id = models.CharField(max_length=50, unique=True, db_index=True)
    first_name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    middle_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    last_name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    suffix = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=SUFFIX_CHOICES, blank=True, default="")
    position = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    department = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    contact_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default="")
    email = models.EmailField(max_length=150, blank=True, default="")

    photo = models.ImageField(upload_to="faculty/", null=True, blank=True)
    photo_updated_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    can_teach = models.BooleanField(default=True, db_index=True)
    qr_token = models.CharField(max_length=128, unique=True, null=True, blank=True, db_index=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    bound_device_id = models.CharField(max_length=128, blank=True, null=True, unique=True)
    device_model = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, null=True)
    device_bound_at = models.DateTimeField(blank=True, null=True)

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="created_teachers"
    )
    updated_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="updated_teachers"
    )

    class Meta:
        db_table = "faculty_profiles"
        ordering = ["last_name", "first_name"]

    @property
    def full_name(self) -> str:
        mid = f" {self.middle_name[:1]}." if self.middle_name else ""
        suf = f" {self.suffix}" if self.suffix else ""
        return f"{self.first_name}{mid} {self.last_name}{suf}".strip()

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.contact_number:
            self.contact_number = normalize_ph_phone(self.contact_number)
        if not self.qr_token:
            self.qr_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.full_name} ({self.employee_id})"


class UserProfile(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    user = models.OneToOneField(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="profile")
    teacher = models.OneToOneField(
        TeacherProfile,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        db_column="faculty_id",
        related_name="account",
    )
    role = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=USER_ROLE_CHOICES, default="FACULTY")
    phone_number = models.CharField(max_length=30, blank=True, default="", db_index=True)
    avatar = models.ImageField(upload_to="avatars/", null=True, blank=True)
    push_token = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, null=True)
    is_teaching = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    is_profile_completed = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    failed_attempts = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    locked_until = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "user_profiles"

    def is_locked(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.locked_until and timezone.now() < self.locked_until)

    def record_failed_attempt(self):
        UserProfile.objects.filter(pk=self.pk).update(failed_attempts=F("failed_attempts") + 1)
        self.refresh_from_db(fields=["failed_attempts"])
        if self.failed_attempts >= 5:
            self.locked_until = timezone.now() + timezone.timedelta(minutes=15)
            self.save(update_fields=["locked_until"])

    def reset_failed_attempts(self):
        if self.failed_attempts > 0 or self.locked_until is not None:
            UserProfile.objects.filter(pk=self.pk).update(failed_attempts=0, locked_until=None)

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.phone_number:
            self.phone_number = normalize_ph_phone(self.phone_number)
        if self.role == "PARENT":
            self.is_teaching = False
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.core.cache import cache
from django.db.models import Q

from common.media import build_media_url
from common.permissions import get_user_role
from apps.school.models import ClassPeriod, Section
from apps.students.models import Enrollment
from .models import TeacherProfile, UserProfile


def resolve_teacher_for_user(user: User | None) -> TeacherProfile | None:
    if not user or not getattr(user, "is_authenticated", False):
        return None

    cache_key = f"accounts:teacher_for_user:{user.id}"
    cached_id = cache.get(cache_key)
    if cached_id is not None:
        if cached_id == 0:
            return None
        found = TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("account").filter(id=cached_id, is_active=True).first()
        if found:
            return found

    profile = UserProfile.objects.select_related("teacher").filter(user=user).first()
    if profile and getattr(profile, "teacher", None):
        teacher = profile.teacher
        if teacher and teacher.is_active:
            cache.set(cache_key, teacher.id, timeout=60)
            return teacher

    by_account = TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("account").filter(account__user=user, is_active=True).first()
    if by_account:
        cache.set(cache_key, by_account.id, timeout=60)
        return by_account

    by_username = (
        TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("account")
        .filter(Q(employee_id__iexact=user.username) | Q(email__iexact=user.email), is_active=True)
        .first()
    )
    if by_username:
        cache.set(cache_key, by_username.id, timeout=60)
        return by_username

    cache.set(cache_key, 0, timeout=30)
    return None


def get_teacher_section_ids(teacher: TeacherProfile | None) -> set[int]:
    if not teacher:
        return set()

    cache_key = f"accounts:teacher_sections:{teacher.id}"
    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return set(cached)

    advisory_ids = set(
        Section.objects.filter(adviser=teacher, is_active=True).values_list("id", flat=True)
    )
    period_sec_ids = set(
        ClassPeriod.objects.filter(teacher=teacher, is_active=True, section__is_active=True)
        .exclude(section_id__isnull=True)
        .values_list("section_id", flat=True)
    )
    combined = advisory_ids | period_sec_ids
    cache.set(cache_key, list(combined), timeout=30)
    return combined


def get_teacher_student_ids(teacher: TeacherProfile | None) -> set[int]:
    if not teacher:
        return set()

    section_ids = get_teacher_section_ids(teacher)
    if not section_ids:
        return set()

    return set(
        Enrollment.objects.filter(
            section_id__in=section_ids,
            status="ENROLLED",
            student__is_active=True,
        ).values_list("student_id", flat=True)
    )


def build_user_session_payload(user: User, request=None) -> dict:
    """Builds the authenticated user session payload from real PostgreSQL profile & teacher data."""
    profile = UserProfile.objects.select_related("teacher").filter(user=user).first()
    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    role = get_user_role(user)

    section_ids = get_teacher_section_ids(teacher) if teacher else set()
    period_count = (
        ClassPeriod.objects.filter(teacher=teacher, is_active=True).count()
        if teacher
        else 0
    )
    assigned_class_count = len(section_ids) + period_count

    can_teach = bool(
        (teacher and getattr(teacher, "can_teach", False))
        or assigned_class_count > 0
        or role == "FACULTY"
    )

    if teacher:
        full_name = teacher.full_name or user.get_full_name() or user.username
        employee_id = teacher.employee_id or user.username
        department = teacher.department or ""
        position = teacher.position or ""
        contact_number = teacher.contact_number or ""
        email = teacher.email or user.email or ""
        photo_raw = teacher.photo or (getattr(profile, "photo", None) if profile else None)
    else:
        full_name = user.get_full_name() or user.username
        employee_id = user.username
        department = "Parent / Guardian" if role == "PARENT" else ""
        position = "Parent / Guardian" if role == "PARENT" else ""
        contact_number = getattr(profile, "phone_number", "") if profile else ""
        email = user.email or ""
        photo_raw = getattr(profile, "photo", None) if profile else None

    photo_url = build_media_url(photo_raw, request)

    return {
        "id": user.id,
        "user_id": user.id,
        "username": user.username,
        "employee_id": employee_id,
        "first_name": user.first_name,
        "middle_name": teacher.middle_name if teacher else "",
        "last_name": user.last_name,
        "suffix": teacher.suffix if teacher else "",
        "full_name": full_name,
        "faculty_name": full_name,
        "email": email,
        "contact_number": contact_number,
        "department": department,
        "position": position,
        "role": role,
        "current_role": role,
        "can_teach": can_teach,
        "is_teaching": can_teach,
        "assigned_class_count": assigned_class_count,
        "is_profile_completed": bool(
            getattr(profile, "is_profile_completed", True) if profile else True
        ),
        "faculty_id": teacher.id if teacher else None,
        "photo": photo_url,
        "photo_url": photo_url,
        "is_active": user.is_active,
        "is_superuser": user.is_superuser,
    }

class UserAccountSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    role = serializers.CharField(required=False, default="FACULTY")
    is_teaching = serializers.BooleanField(required=False, default=True)
    employee_id = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    contact_number = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    department = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    position = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    photo = FlexibleImageField(required=False, allow_null=True)
    photo_url = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    password = serializers.CharField(write_only=True, required=False, allow_blank=True)

    class Meta:
        model = User
        fields = [
            "id", "username", "employee_id", "first_name", "last_name", "email",
            "contact_number", "department", "position", "role", "is_teaching",
            "photo", "photo_url", "is_active", "password",
        ]

    def get_photo_url(self, obj):
        prof = getattr(obj, "profile", None)
        if prof and prof.teacher and prof.teacher.photo:
            return build_media_url(prof.teacher.photo, self.context.get("request"))
        return build_media_url(prof.avatar if prof else None, self.context.get("request"))

    def to_representation(self, instance):
        data = super().to_representation(instance)
        prof = getattr(instance, "profile", None)
        teacher = prof.teacher if prof else None
        role = prof.role if prof else ("ADMIN" if instance.is_superuser else "FACULTY")
        is_teaching = False if role == "PARENT" else (prof.is_teaching if prof else True)
        phone = (prof.phone_number if prof else "") or (teacher.contact_number if teacher else "")

        data["role"] = role
        data["current_role"] = "FACULTY_ADMIN" if (role == "ADMIN" and is_teaching) else role
        data["is_teaching"] = is_teaching
        data["can_teach"] = is_teaching
        data["faculty_id"] = prof.teacher_id if prof else None
        data["employee_id"] = teacher.employee_id if teacher else instance.username
        data["contact_number"] = phone
        data["phone_number"] = phone
        data["department"] = teacher.department if teacher else ""
        data["position"] = teacher.position if teacher else role.title()
        data["full_name"] = teacher.full_name if teacher else (instance.get_full_name() or instance.username)
        return data

    @transaction.atomic
    def create(self, validated_data):
        password = validated_data.pop("password", "")
        raw_role = str(validated_data.pop("role", "FACULTY")).upper()
        role = "ADMIN" if raw_role == "FACULTY_ADMIN" else raw_role
        is_teaching = False if role == "PARENT" else bool(validated_data.pop("is_teaching", True))
        emp_id = str(validated_data.pop("employee_id", "") or validated_data["username"]).strip().upper()
        phone = normalize_ph_phone(validated_data.pop("contact_number", ""))
        dept = validated_data.pop("department", "Junior High School")
        pos = validated_data.pop("position", "Teacher I")
        photo = validated_data.pop("photo", None)

        user = User(**validated_data, is_staff=(role == "ADMIN"), is_superuser=(role == "ADMIN"))
        if password:
            user.set_password(password)
        else:
            user.set_unusable_password()
        user.save()

        profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.update_or_create(
            user=user,
            defaults={
                "role": role,
                "phone_number": phone,
                "is_teaching": is_teaching,
                "is_profile_completed": bool(user.first_name and user.last_name),
                **({"avatar": photo} if photo else {}),
            },
        )

        if role != "PARENT":
            teacher, _ = TeacherProfile.objects.update_or_create(
                employee_id=emp_id[:50],
                defaults={
                    "first_name": user.first_name or user.username,
                    "last_name": user.last_name or "Staff",
                    "email": user.email or "",
                    "contact_number": phone,
                    "department": dept,
                    "position": pos,
                    "can_teach": is_teaching,
                    "is_active": user.is_active,
                    "qr_token": secrets.token_urlsafe(24),
                },
            )
            profile.teacher = teacher
            profile.save(update_fields=["teacher"])
        return user

    @transaction.atomic
    def update(self, instance, validated_data):
        request = self.context.get("request")
        is_admin = bool(
            request and request.user.is_authenticated
            and (request.user.is_superuser or get_user_role(request.user) == "ADMIN")
        )

        password = validated_data.pop("password", "")
        raw_role = validated_data.pop("role", None)
        is_teaching = validated_data.pop("is_teaching", None)
        phone = validated_data.pop("contact_number", None)
        dept = validated_data.pop("department", None)
        pos = validated_data.pop("position", None)
        validated_data.pop("employee_id", None)
        photo = validated_data.pop("photo", None)

        if not is_admin:
            validated_data.pop("is_active", None)
            raw_role = None

        for attr, val in validated_data.items():
            setattr(instance, attr, val)
        if password:
            instance.set_password(password)
        instance.save()

        profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=instance)
        if raw_role and is_admin:
            clean_role = str(raw_role).upper()
            profile.role = "ADMIN" if clean_role == "FACULTY_ADMIN" else clean_role
            instance.is_staff = profile.role == "ADMIN"
            instance.is_superuser = profile.role == "ADMIN"
            instance.save(update_fields=["is_staff", "is_superuser"])

        if is_teaching is not None and is_admin:
            profile.is_teaching = False if profile.role == "PARENT" else bool(is_teaching)
        if phone is not None:
            profile.phone_number = normalize_ph_phone(phone)
        if photo:
            profile.avatar = photo
        profile.is_profile_completed = bool(instance.first_name and instance.last_name)
        profile.save()

        if profile.teacher:
            t = profile.teacher
            t.first_name = instance.first_name or t.first_name
            t.last_name = instance.last_name or t.last_name
            t.email = instance.email or t.email
            if phone is not None:
                t.contact_number = profile.phone_number
            if dept is not None:
                t.department = dept
            if pos is not None:
                t.position = pos
            t.can_teach = profile.is_teaching
            t.is_active = instance.is_active
            t.save()

        cache.delete(user_session_cache_key(instance.id))
        return instance

def build_user_session_payload(user, request=None) -> dict:
    cache_key = user_session_cache_key(user.id)
    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
    if cached is None:
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        profile = getattr(user, "profile", None)
        role = get_user_role(user)
        class_count = ClassPeriod.objects.filter(teacher=teacher).count() if teacher else 0
        can_teach = bool(getattr(teacher, "can_teach", True)) and bool(getattr(profile, "is_teaching", True))
        full_name = teacher.full_name if teacher else (user.get_full_name() or user.username)
        photo_raw = teacher.photo if (teacher and teacher.photo) else (profile.avatar if profile else None)

        cached = {
            "id": user.id,
            "username": user.username,
            "first_name": teacher.first_name if teacher else user.first_name,
            "middle_name": teacher.middle_name if teacher else "",
            "last_name": teacher.last_name if teacher else user.last_name,
            "full_name": full_name,
            "faculty_name": full_name,
            "faculty_id": teacher.employee_id if teacher else user.username,
            "faculty_pk": teacher.id if teacher else None,
            "email": (teacher.email if teacher else "") or user.email,
            "contact_number": teacher.contact_number if teacher else (profile.phone_number if profile else ""),
            "position": teacher.position if teacher else "",
            "department": teacher.department if teacher else "",
            "_photo_path": photo_raw.name if (photo_raw and hasattr(photo_raw, "name")) else None,
            "role": role,
            "system_role": role,
            "is_profile_completed": bool(profile and profile.is_profile_completed),
            "can_teach": can_teach,
            "is_teaching": can_teach or class_count > 0,
            "assigned_class_count": class_count,
            "is_superuser": user.is_superuser,
        }
        cache.set(cache_key, cached, timeout=15)

    school_meta = get_school_metadata(request)
    photo_url = build_media_url(f"/media/{cached['_photo_path']}", request) if cached.get("_photo_path") else None

    return {
        k: v for k, v in cached.items() if k != "_photo_path"
    } | {
        "photo": photo_url,
        "photo_url": photo_url,
        "school_name": school_meta.get("school_name", ""),
        "school_id": school_meta.get("school_id", ""),
        "school_logo": school_meta.get("school_logo"),
        "left_logo": school_meta.get("left_logo"),
        "right_logo": school_meta.get("right_logo"),
    }


def login_with_credentials(*, request, username: str, password: str) -> dict:
    from django.db.models import Q

    clean_identifier = str(username or "").strip()[:100]
    raw_password = str(password or "")
    if not clean_identifier or not raw_password:
        raise AppError("MISSING_CREDENTIALS", "Enter both your username and password.", 400)

    existing_user = (
        User.objects.select_related("profile", "profile__teacher")
        .filter(
            Q(username__iexact=clean_identifier)
            | Q(profile__teacher__employee_id__iexact=clean_identifier)
        )
        .first()
    )
    profile = getattr(existing_user, "profile", None) if existing_user else None

    if profile and profile.is_locked():
        raise AppError(
            "ACCOUNT_LOCKED",
            "Too many failed sign-in attempts. Please wait 15 minutes or ask your School Admin to unlock your account.",
            429,
        )

    if existing_user is None:
        # Constant-time dummy hash check prevents username/Employee ID enumeration
        User().set_password(raw_password)
        raise AppError("INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "Wrong username or password. Please try again.", 401)

    auth_user = authenticate(request=request, username=existing_user.username, password=raw_password)
    if auth_user is None:
        if profile:
            profile.record_failed_attempt()
        raise AppError("INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "Wrong username or password. Please try again.", 401)

    if not auth_user.is_active:
        raise AppError("ACCOUNT_INACTIVE", "This account is inactive. Contact your School Admin.", 403)

    if profile:
        profile.reset_failed_attempts()

    legacy_token, _ = Token.objects.get_or_create(user=auth_user)
    refresh = RefreshToken.for_user(auth_user)
    return {
        "token": legacy_token.key,
        "access": str(refresh.access_token),
        "refresh": str(refresh),
        "user": build_user_session_payload(auth_user, request),
    }

@transaction.atomic
def update_own_profile(*, user, data: dict, files: dict, request=None) -> dict:
    if "first_name" in data:
        user.first_name = str(data["first_name"]).strip()
    if "last_name" in data:
        user.last_name = str(data["last_name"]).strip()
    if "email" in data:
        clean_email = str(data["email"]).strip()
        if clean_email and User.objects.filter(email__iexact=clean_email).exclude(id=user.id).exists():
            raise AppError("EMAIL_TAKEN", "Email is already used by another account.", 400)
        user.email = clean_email

    if data.get("password"):
        pw = str(data["password"]).strip()
        try:
            validate_password(pw, user=user)
        except DjangoValidationError as exc:
            raise AppError("WEAK_PASSWORD", " ".join(exc.messages), 400)
        user.set_password(pw)

    user.save()

    raw_photo = files.get("photo") or files.get("avatar") or data.get("photo") or data.get("avatar")
    photo_file = decode_uploaded_image(raw_photo, prefix="avatar")
    if isinstance(photo_file, serializers.SkipField):
        photo_file = None

    profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=user)
    profile.is_profile_completed = bool(user.first_name and user.last_name)
    if data.get("contact_number"):
        profile.phone_number = str(data["contact_number"]).strip()
    if photo_file:
        profile.avatar = photo_file
    profile.save()

    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    if teacher:
        teacher.first_name = user.first_name or teacher.first_name
        teacher.last_name = user.last_name or teacher.last_name
        teacher.email = user.email or teacher.email
        if data.get("contact_number"):
            teacher.contact_number = str(data["contact_number"]).strip()
        if photo_file:
            photo_file.seek(0)
            teacher.photo = photo_file
        teacher.save()

    cache.delete(user_session_cache_key(user.id))
    return build_user_session_payload(user, request)


def reset_teacher_bound_device(*, teacher_id: int) -> TeacherProfile:
    teacher = TeacherProfile.objects.filter(id=teacher_id).first()
    if not teacher:
        raise AppError("TEACHER_NOT_FOUND", "Teacher profile not found.", 404)
    teacher.bound_device_id = None
    teacher.device_model = None
    teacher.device_bound_at = None
    teacher.save(update_fields=["bound_device_id", "device_model", "device_bound_at"])
    return teacher

class LoginView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.AllowAny]

    def post(self, request):
        username = str(request.data.get("username") or "")
        password = str(request.data.get("password") or "")
        payload = login_with_credentials(request=request, username=username, password=password)
        user_obj = payload.get("user") or {}
        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="auth_user",
            record_id=int(user_obj.get("id") or 0),
            action="LOGIN",
            new_data={"username": user_obj.get("username", username)},
        )
        return Response(payload, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class CurrentUserView(APIView):
    """Returns and updates the signed-in user's profile."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        return Response(build_user_session_payload(request.user, request))

    @transaction.atomic
    def put(self, request):
        user = request.user
        data = request.data
        profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=user)
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)

        first_name = str(data.get("first_name") if "first_name" in data else user.first_name).strip()
        last_name = str(data.get("last_name") if "last_name" in data else user.last_name).strip()
        email = str(data.get("email") if "email" in data else user.email).strip().lower()

        if "first_name" in data:
            user.first_name = first_name[:150]
        if "last_name" in data:
            user.last_name = last_name[:150]
        if "email" in data:
            user.email = email[:254]

        raw_password = str(data.get("password") or "").strip()
        if raw_password:
            if len(raw_password) < 8:
                raise AppError("WEAK_PASSWORD", "Password must be at least 8 characters long.", 400)
            user.set_password(raw_password)

        user.save()

        contact = str(data.get("contact_number") or data.get("phone_number") or "").strip()
        if contact and hasattr(profile, "phone_number"):
            profile.phone_number = contact[:25]

        photo_updated_path = None
        if "photo" in data:
            raw_photo = data.get("photo")
            if not raw_photo:
                if hasattr(profile, "photo"):
                    profile.photo = None
                if teacher:
                    teacher.photo = None
            elif isinstance(raw_photo, str) and raw_photo.startswith("data:image"):
                saved_path = save_base64_logo_to_disk(raw_photo, subdir="avatars", prefix="photo")
                if saved_path:
                    photo_updated_path = saved_path
                    if hasattr(profile, "photo"):
                        profile.photo = saved_path
                    if teacher:
                        teacher.photo = saved_path

        if hasattr(profile, "is_profile_completed"):
            profile.is_profile_completed = True
        profile.save()

        if teacher:
            if "first_name" in data and first_name:
                teacher.first_name = first_name[:100]
            if "middle_name" in data:
                teacher.middle_name = str(data.get("middle_name") or "").strip()[:100]
            if "last_name" in data and last_name:
                teacher.last_name = last_name[:100]
            if "suffix" in data:
                teacher.suffix = str(data.get("suffix") or "").strip()[:20]
            if contact:
                teacher.contact_number = contact[:25]
            if "email" in data:
                teacher.email = email[:254]
            if "department" in data and str(data.get("department") or "").strip():
                teacher.department = str(data.get("department")).strip()[:120]
            if "position" in data and str(data.get("position") or "").strip():
                teacher.position = str(data.get("position")).strip()[:120]
            if photo_updated_path:
                teacher.photo = photo_updated_path
            teacher.save()
            cache.delete_many(["teachers:dropdown:active", "teachers:dropdown:all"])

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="auth_user",
            record_id=user.id,
            action="PROFILE",
            changed_fields=list(data.keys()) if hasattr(data, "keys") else ["profile"],
        )
        return Response(build_user_session_payload(user, request))

    def patch(self, request):
        return self.put(request)

class ValidateFieldView(APIView):
    """Real-time uniqueness check for username, employee_id, or email."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        field = str(request.query_params.get("field") or "username").strip().lower()
        value = str(request.query_params.get("value") or "").strip()
        exclude_raw = request.query_params.get("exclude_id")
        exclude_id = int(exclude_raw) if (exclude_raw and str(exclude_raw).isdigit()) else None

        if not value:
            return Response({"is_taken": False, "valid": True})

        is_taken = False
        message = ""

        if field == "username":
            qs = User.objects.filter(username__iexact=value)
            if exclude_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_id)
            is_taken = qs.exists()
            if is_taken:
                message = "Username is already taken."
        elif field == "employee_id":
            qs = TeacherProfile.objects.filter(employee_id__iexact=value)
            if exclude_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(account__user_id=exclude_id).exclude(id=exclude_id)
            is_taken = qs.exists()
            if is_taken:
                message = "Employee ID is already assigned."
        elif field == "email":
            qs = User.objects.filter(email__iexact=value)
            if exclude_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_id)
            is_taken = qs.exists()
            if is_taken:
                message = "Email address is already in use."

        return Response({"is_taken": is_taken, "valid": not is_taken, "message": message})


class PushTokenUpdateView(APIView):
    """Registers or updates the mobile push notification token for the signed-in user."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        token = str(
            request.data.get("push_token")
            or request.data.get("expo_push_token")
            or request.data.get("token")
            or ""
        ).strip()[:255]
        profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=request.user)
        for attr in ("expo_push_token", "push_token"):
            if hasattr(profile, attr):
                setattr(profile, attr, token)
                profile.save(update_fields=[attr])
                break
        return Response({"ok": True, "registered": bool(token)})

# Backward-compatible alias imported by config/legacy_urls.py
SavePushTokenView = PushTokenUpdateView

class ResetDeviceLockView(APIView):
    """Clears hardware phone binding on a teacher profile so they can pair a replacement phone."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, pk: int | None = None):
        role = get_user_role(request.user)
        if not (request.user.is_superuser or role in ("ADMIN", "SUPERADMIN", "PRINCIPAL")):
            raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "Only School Principals or System Admins can reset device locks.", 403)

        target_id = pk or request.data.get("teacher_id") or request.data.get("faculty_id")
        if not target_id or not str(target_id).isdigit():
            raise AppError("INVALID_ID", "Valid teacher ID is required.", 400)

        teacher = TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("account").filter(id=int(target_id)).first()
        if not teacher:
            raise AppError("NOT_FOUND", "Teacher profile not found.", 404)

        for attr in ("bound_device_id", "device_id", "registered_device_id"):
            if hasattr(teacher, attr):
                setattr(teacher, attr, None)
        if hasattr(teacher, "device_bound_at"):
            teacher.device_bound_at = None
        teacher.save()

        if teacher.account:
            for attr in ("bound_device_id", "device_id"):
                if hasattr(teacher.account, attr):
                    setattr(teacher.account, attr, "")
            teacher.account.save()

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=teacher._meta.db_table,
            record_id=teacher.id,
            action="SECURITY",
            new_data={"reset_device_for": teacher.full_name},
        )
        return Response({"ok": True, "message": f"Phone hardware lock cleared for {teacher.full_name}."})


ResetDeviceBindingView = ResetDeviceLockView


class AuditLogListView(APIView):
    """Returns user activity and security audit logs."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        leader = is_school_leader(request.user)
        qs = AuditLog.objects.select_related("actor").order_by("-created_at")
        if not leader:
            qs = qs.filter(actor=request.user)

        search = str(request.query_params.get("search") or "").strip()
        action_filter = str(request.query_params.get("action") or "ALL").strip().upper()
        date_filter = str(request.query_params.get("date") or "").strip()

        if action_filter and action_filter != "ALL":
            qs = qs.filter(action__icontains=action_filter)
        if date_filter:
            qs = qs.filter(created_at__date=date_filter)
        if search:
            qs = qs.filter(
                Q(actor__username__icontains=search)
                | Q(action__icontains=search)
                | Q(table_name__icontains=search)
            )

        records = []
        for row in qs[:150]:
            local_dt = timezone.localtime(row.created_at)
            actor_name = row.actor.username if row.actor else "system"
            details_parts = []
            if getattr(row, "changed_fields", None):
                details_parts.append(f"Fields: {', '.join(str(f) for f in row.changed_fields)}")
            elif getattr(row, "new_data", None) and isinstance(row.new_data, dict):
                summary = ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in list(row.new_data.items())[:3])
                if summary:
                    details_parts.append(summary)

            records.append(
                {
                    "id": row.id,
                    "timestamp": local_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p"),
                    "time_only": local_dt.strftime("%I:%M:%S %p"),
                    "date_only": local_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                    "user": actor_name,
                    "action": row.action,
                    "module": row.table_name,
                    "details": " • ".join(details_parts) or f"{row.action} on {row.table_name} #{row.record_id}",
                    "ip_address": getattr(row, "ip_address", None) or "127.0.0.1",
                    "status": "SUCCESS",
                }
            )

        return Response(
            {
                "is_admin": leader,
                "count": len(records),
                "records": records,
                "results": records,
            }
        )


ActivityLogListView = AuditLogListView


class AuditLogViewSet(viewsets.ReadOnlyModelViewSet):
    """Read-only viewset for audit log entries."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get_queryset(self):
        qs = AuditLog.objects.select_related("actor").order_by("-created_at")
        if not is_school_leader(self.request.user):
            qs = qs.filter(actor=self.request.user)
        return qs

    def list(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        return AuditLogListView().get(request)

    def retrieve(self, request, pk=None, *args, **kwargs):
        qs = self.get_queryset()
        row = qs.filter(pk=pk).first()
        if not row:
            return Response({"error": "Audit log entry not found."}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)
        local_dt = timezone.localtime(row.created_at)
        return Response(
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "timestamp": local_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p"),
                "time_only": local_dt.strftime("%I:%M:%S %p"),
                "date_only": local_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                "user": row.actor.username if row.actor else "system",
                "action": row.action,
                "module": row.table_name,
                "ip_address": getattr(row, "ip_address", None) or "127.0.0.1",
                "status": "SUCCESS",
            }
        )


class TeacherViewSet(AuditedModelViewSet):
    queryset = TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("account").order_by("last_name", "first_name")
    serializer_class = TeacherSerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsLeadershipOrReadOnly]

    def get_queryset(self):
        qs = super().get_queryset()
        dept = self.request.query_params.get("department", "").strip()
        search = self.request.query_params.get("search", "").strip()
        if dept:
            qs = qs.filter(department__iexact=dept)
        if search:
            qs = qs.filter(
                Q(employee_id__icontains=search)
                | Q(first_name__icontains=search)
                | Q(last_name__icontains=search)
                | Q(position__icontains=search)
                | Q(department__icontains=search)
            )
        return qs

    def _clear_dropdown_cache(self):
        cache.delete_many(["teachers:dropdown:active", "teachers:dropdown:all"])

    def perform_create(self, serializer):
        super().perform_create(serializer)
        self._clear_dropdown_cache()

    def perform_update(self, serializer):
        super().perform_update(serializer)
        self._clear_dropdown_cache()

    def perform_destroy(self, instance):
        super().perform_destroy(instance)
        self._clear_dropdown_cache()

    @action(detail=False, methods=["get"], url_path="dropdown")
    def dropdown(self, request):
        include_all = str(request.query_params.get("include_all", "")).lower() in ("1", "true", "yes")
        cache_key = "teachers:dropdown:all" if include_all else "teachers:dropdown:active"
        rows = cache.get(cache_key)
        if rows is None:
            qs = TeacherProfile.objects.order_by("last_name", "first_name")
            if not include_all:
                qs = qs.filter(is_active=True)
            rows = list(
                qs.only(
                    "id",
                    "employee_id",
                    "first_name",
                    "middle_name",
                    "last_name",
                    "suffix",
                    "department",
                    "position",
                    "contact_number",
                    "email",
                    "can_teach",
                    "is_active",
                    "photo",
                )
            )
            cache.set(cache_key, rows, timeout=15)

        return Response(TeacherDropdownSerializer(rows, many=True, context={"request": request}).data)

from django.db import models
from django.db.models import UniqueConstraint
from django.utils import timezone

ATTENDANCE_STATUS_CHOICES = [
    ("PRESENT", "Present"),
    ("LATE", "Late"),
    ("CUTTING", "Cutting Classes"),
    ("ABSENT", "Absent"),
    ("EXCUSED", "Excused"),
]

SCAN_METHOD_CHOICES = [
    ("QR", "Printed QR ID Scan"),
    ("MANUAL", "Manual Class List Entry"),
]

EXIT_PASS_STATUS_CHOICES = [
    ("PENDING", "Pending Approval"),
    ("ACTIVE", "Active"),
    ("USED", "Used"),
    ("EXPIRED", "Expired"),
    ("REVOKED", "Revoked"),
]


class ClassAttendance(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    student = models.ForeignKey("students.Student", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="class_attendances")
    class_period = models.ForeignKey(
        "school.ClassPeriod", on_delete=models.CASCADE, db_column="schedule_id", related_name="attendance_records"
    )
    recorded_by = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.TeacherProfile", on_delete=models.CASCADE, db_column="faculty_id", related_name="recorded_scans"
    )
    attendance_date = models.DateField(default=timezone.now, db_index=True)
    scanned_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    scan_method = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=SCAN_METHOD_CHOICES, default="QR")
    status = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=ATTENDANCE_STATUS_CHOICES, default="PRESENT")

    class Meta:
        db_table = "subject_attendance_logs"
        constraints = [
            UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["student", "class_period", "attendance_date"],
                name="uq_class_attendance_daily",
            )
        ]


class DailyAttendance(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    student = models.ForeignKey("students.Student", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="daily_attendances")
    section = models.ForeignKey("school.Section", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="daily_attendances")
    attendance_date = models.DateField(default=timezone.now, db_index=True)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=ATTENDANCE_STATUS_CHOICES, default="PRESENT")
    remarks = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, default="")
    recorded_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "daily_attendance_summaries"
        constraints = [
            UniqueConstraint(fields=["student", "attendance_date"], name="uq_daily_attendance_student_date")
        ]


class ExitPass(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    pass_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, unique=True, db_index=True)
    teacher = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.TeacherProfile",
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        db_column="faculty_id",
        related_name="exit_passes",
    )
    student = models.ForeignKey(
        "students.Student", on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="exit_passes"
    )
    issued_by = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.TeacherProfile", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="issued_exit_passes"
    )
    pass_type = models.CharField(max_length=50, default="Exit Permit")
    reason = models.TextField()
    valid_from = models.DateTimeField()
    valid_until = models.DateTimeField(db_column="valid_to")
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=EXIT_PASS_STATUS_CHOICES, default="ACTIVE", db_index=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "gate_passes"

from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone
from common.media import build_media_url
from common.permissions import get_user_role, is_school_leader
from apps.accounts.selectors import (
    get_teacher_section_ids,
    get_teacher_student_ids,
    resolve_teacher_for_user,
)
from apps.school.models import ClassPeriod, Section
from apps.school.selectors import format_section_label
from apps.students.models import Enrollment
from .models import ClassAttendance, DailyAttendance, ExitPass


def format_roster_items(
    students,
    request=None,
    period_logs=None,
    daily_logs=None,
    period_id=None,
) -> list[dict]:
    period_logs = period_logs or {}
    daily_logs = daily_logs or {}
    return [
        {
            "id": st.id,
            "lrn": st.lrn,
            "full_name": st.full_name,
            "name": st.full_name,
            "sex": st.sex,
            "gender": st.sex,
            "photo_url": build_media_url(st.photo, request),
            "attendance_status": (
                (period_logs.get((period_id, st.id)) if period_id else period_logs.get(st.id))
                or daily_logs.get(st.id)
                or "UNSCANNED"
            ),
            "parent_contact": st.parent_contact,
            "qr_token": st.qr_token,
        }
        for st in students
    ]


def get_assigned_classes_with_rosters(
    *,
    user,
    view_all: bool = False,
    include_students: bool = True,
    request=None,
) -> list[dict]:
    from django.db.models import Count

    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    leader = is_school_leader(user)
    today = timezone.localdate()

    periods_qs = ClassPeriod.objects.none()
    extra_sections_qs = Section.objects.none()

    if teacher and not view_all:
        own_periods = ClassPeriod.objects.filter(
            Q(teacher=teacher) | Q(section__adviser=teacher),
            is_active=True,
        ).distinct()
        own_advisory = Section.objects.filter(adviser=teacher, is_active=True)

        if own_periods.exists() or own_advisory.exists():
            periods_qs = own_periods
            extra_sections_qs = own_advisory
        elif leader:
            periods_qs = ClassPeriod.objects.filter(is_active=True)
            extra_sections_qs = Section.objects.filter(is_active=True)
    elif leader:
        periods_qs = ClassPeriod.objects.filter(is_active=True)
        extra_sections_qs = Section.objects.filter(is_active=True)

    periods = list(
        periods_qs.select_related("section", "section__grade_level", "subject", "teacher").order_by("start_time")
    )
    covered_section_ids = {p.section_id for p in periods if p.section_id}
    extra_sections = list(
        extra_sections_qs.exclude(id__in=covered_section_ids)
        .select_related("grade_level")
        .order_by("grade_level__level_order", "name")
    )

    all_section_ids = covered_section_ids | {s.id for s in extra_sections}
    if not all_section_ids:
        return []

    if not include_students:
        counts_by_sec = dict(
            Enrollment.objects.filter(section_id__in=all_section_ids, status="ENROLLED", student__is_active=True)
            .values("section_id")
            .annotate(cnt=Count("id"))
            .values_list("section_id", "cnt")
        )
        results = []
        for p in periods:
            if not p.section:
                continue
            start_s = str(p.start_time)[:5] if p.start_time else ""
            end_s = str(p.end_time)[:5] if p.end_time else ""
            cnt = counts_by_sec.get(p.section_id, 0)
            results.append({
                "id": p.id,
                "schedule_id": p.id,
                "section_id": p.section_id,
                "name": p.section.name,
                "section_name": p.section.name,
                "grade_level": p.section.grade_level.name if p.section.grade_level else "",
                "subject_code": p.subject.code if p.subject else "",
                "subject_title": p.subject.title if p.subject else "",
                "room": p.section.room_number or p.room_number,
                "start_time": start_s,
                "end_time": end_s,
                "time_display": f"{start_s} - {end_s}".strip(" -"),
                "total_students": cnt,
                "students": [],
                "is_adviser": bool(teacher and p.section.adviser_id == teacher.id),
            })
        return results

    enrollments = (
        Enrollment.objects.filter(section_id__in=all_section_ids, status="ENROLLED", student__is_active=True)
        .select_related("student")
        .order_by("student__last_name", "student__first_name")
    )
    students_by_sec: dict[int, list] = {}
    all_student_ids = []
    for enr in enrollments:
        students_by_sec.setdefault(enr.section_id, []).append(enr.student)
        all_student_ids.append(enr.student_id)

    period_logs = {
        (row["class_period_id"], row["student_id"]): row["status"]
        for row in ClassAttendance.objects.filter(
            attendance_date=today,
            student_id__in=all_student_ids,
        ).values("class_period_id", "student_id", "status")
    }
    daily_logs = dict(
        DailyAttendance.objects.filter(
            attendance_date=today,
            student_id__in=all_student_ids,
        ).values_list("student_id", "status")
    )

    results = []
    for p in periods:
        if not p.section:
            continue
        roster = format_roster_items(
            students_by_sec.get(p.section_id, []),
            request=request,
            period_logs=period_logs,
            daily_logs=daily_logs,
            period_id=p.id,
        )
        start_s = str(p.start_time)[:5] if p.start_time else ""
        end_s = str(p.end_time)[:5] if p.end_time else ""
        results.append({
            "id": p.id,
            "schedule_id": p.id,
            "section_id": p.section_id,
            "name": p.section.name,
            "section_name": p.section.name,
            "grade_level": p.section.grade_level.name if p.section.grade_level else "",
            "subject_code": p.subject.code if p.subject else "",
            "subject_name": p.subject.title if p.subject else "",
            "subject_title": p.subject.title if p.subject else "",
            "room": p.section.room_number or p.room_number,
            "start_time": start_s,
            "end_time": end_s,
            "time_display": f"{start_s} - {end_s}".strip(" -"),
            "total_students": len(roster),
            "students": roster,
            "is_adviser": bool(teacher and p.section.adviser_id == teacher.id),
        })

    for sec in extra_sections:
        roster = format_roster_items(students_by_sec.get(sec.id, []), request=request, daily_logs=daily_logs)
        results.append({
            "id": sec.id,
            "schedule_id": sec.id,
            "section_id": sec.id,
            "name": sec.name,
            "section_name": sec.name,
            "grade_level": sec.grade_level.name if sec.grade_level else "",
            "subject_code": "ADV",
            "subject_name": "Advisory Homeroom",
            "subject_title": "Advisory Homeroom",
            "room": sec.room_number or "",
            "start_time": "",
            "end_time": "",
            "time_display": "Homeroom",
            "total_students": len(roster),
            "students": roster,
            "is_adviser": bool(teacher and sec.adviser_id == teacher.id),
        })

    return results

def get_section_student_roster(*, user, section_id: int | None = None, request=None) -> list[dict]:
    if not section_id:
        return get_assigned_classes_with_rosters(user=user, request=request)

    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        if not teacher or section_id not in get_teacher_section_ids(teacher):
            return []

    today = timezone.localdate()
    students = [
        enr.student
        for enr in Enrollment.objects.filter(
            section_id=section_id, status="ENROLLED", student__is_active=True
        )
        .select_related("student")
        .order_by("student__last_name", "student__first_name")
    ]
    student_ids = [s.id for s in students]

    period_logs = dict(
        ClassAttendance.objects.filter(student_id__in=student_ids, attendance_date=today).values_list(
            "student_id", "status"
        )
    )
    daily_logs = dict(
        DailyAttendance.objects.filter(student_id__in=student_ids, attendance_date=today).values_list(
            "student_id", "status"
        )
    )
    return format_roster_items(students, request=request, period_logs=period_logs, daily_logs=daily_logs)


def get_adviser_matrix(*, user, section_id: int | None = None, request=None) -> dict:
    today = timezone.localdate()
    now_time = timezone.localtime().time()
    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    leader = is_school_leader(user)

    advisory_ids = (
        set(Section.objects.filter(adviser=teacher, is_active=True).values_list("id", flat=True))
        if teacher
        else set()
    )

    if leader:
        sections_qs = (
            Section.objects.filter(is_active=True)
            .select_related("grade_level")
            .order_by("grade_level__level_order", "name")
        )
    elif teacher:
        sections_qs = (
            Section.objects.filter(id__in=get_teacher_section_ids(teacher), is_active=True)
            .select_related("grade_level")
            .order_by("grade_level__level_order", "name")
        )
    else:
        sections_qs = Section.objects.none()

    available = [
        {
            "id": s.id,
            "name": s.name,
            "grade_level": s.grade_level.name if s.grade_level else "",
            "is_adviser": s.id in advisory_ids,
        }
        for s in sections_qs
    ]

    target = (
        sections_qs.filter(id=section_id).first()
        if section_id
        else (sections_qs.filter(id__in=advisory_ids).first() or sections_qs.first())
    )
    if not target:
        return {
            "has_advisory_class": False,
            "is_adviser": False,
            "available_sections": available,
            "schedules": [],
            "matrix": [],
        }

    periods = list(
        ClassPeriod.objects.filter(section=target, is_active=True)
        .select_related("subject", "teacher")
        .order_by("start_time")
    )
    students = [
        e.student
        for e in Enrollment.objects.filter(section=target, status="ENROLLED", student__is_active=True)
        .select_related("student")
        .order_by("student__last_name", "student__first_name")
    ]
    student_ids = [s.id for s in students]

    log_map: dict[tuple[int, int], tuple[str, str]] = {}
    first_seen_map: dict[int, str] = {}
    started_period_ids: set[int] = set()

    on_campus_ids = set(
        DailyAttendance.objects.filter(
            attendance_date=today,
            student_id__in=student_ids,
            status__in=["PRESENT", "LATE"],
        ).values_list("student_id", flat=True)
    )

    attendance_rows = (
        ClassAttendance.objects.filter(attendance_date=today, student_id__in=student_ids)
        .values("student_id", "class_period_id", "status", "scanned_at", "class_period__subject__code")
        .order_by("scanned_at")
    )

    for row in attendance_rows:
        started_period_ids.add(row["class_period_id"])
        t_str = timezone.localtime(row["scanned_at"]).strftime("%I:%M %p") if row["scanned_at"] else ""
        st_code = row["status"]
        log_map[(row["student_id"], row["class_period_id"])] = (st_code, t_str)

        if st_code in ("PRESENT", "LATE"):
            on_campus_ids.add(row["student_id"])
            if row["student_id"] not in first_seen_map:
                subj_code = row["class_period__subject__code"] or "CLASS"
                first_seen_map[row["student_id"]] = f"{t_str} ({subj_code})" if t_str else subj_code

    matrix = []
    total_periods = len(periods)

    for idx, st in enumerate(students, start=1):
        attended = cutting = 0
        in_campus = st.id in on_campus_ids
        subj_cells = []

        for p in periods:
            rec = log_map.get((st.id, p.id))
            if rec:
                st_status, scan_t = rec
                if st_status in ("PRESENT", "LATE", "EXCUSED"):
                    attended += 1
                elif st_status in ("ABSENT", "CUTTING") and in_campus:
                    st_status = "CUTTING"
                    cutting += 1
            else:
                scan_t = ""
                if in_campus and (p.id in started_period_ids or (p.start_time and now_time >= p.start_time)):
                    st_status = "CUTTING"
                    cutting += 1
                else:
                    st_status = "UNSCANNED"

            subj_cells.append({
                "schedule_id": p.id,
                "subject_code": p.subject.code if p.subject else "SUB",
                "status": st_status,
                "time": scan_t,
            })

        campus_status = first_seen_map.get(st.id) or ("Present Today" if in_campus else "Not Seen Yet")

        matrix.append({
            "number": idx,
            "student_id": st.id,
            "student_name": st.full_name,
            "lrn": st.lrn,
            "photo_url": build_media_url(st.photo, request),
            "campus_status": campus_status,
            "presence_state": "ACTIVE" if in_campus else "NONE",
            "attended_count": attended,
            "cutting_count": cutting,
            "total_subjects": total_periods,
            "compliance_rate": round((attended / total_periods) * 100) if total_periods else 0,
            "subjects": subj_cells,
        })

    return {
        "has_advisory_class": True,
        "is_adviser": target.id in advisory_ids,
        "section_id": target.id,
        "section_name": target.name,
        "grade_level": target.grade_level.name if target.grade_level else "",
        "total_students": len(students),
        "available_sections": available,
        "schedules": [
            {
                "schedule_id": p.id,
                "subject_code": p.subject.code if p.subject else "",
                "subject_name": p.subject.title if p.subject else "",
                "faculty_name": p.teacher.full_name if p.teacher else "Unassigned",
                "time_window": f"{str(p.start_time)[:5]} - {str(p.end_time)[:5]}" if p.start_time else "",
            }
            for p in periods
        ],
        "matrix": matrix,
    }

def get_attendance_logs(
    *,
    user,
    target_date,
    section_id: int | None = None,
    period_id: int | None = None,
) -> list[dict]:
    qs = (
        ClassAttendance.objects.filter(attendance_date=target_date)
        .select_related(
            "student",
            "class_period",
            "class_period__subject",
            "class_period__section",
            "class_period__section__grade_level",
        )
        .order_by("-scanned_at")
    )

    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        if not teacher:
            return []
        qs = qs.filter(student_id__in=get_teacher_student_ids(teacher))

    if section_id:
        qs = qs.filter(class_period__section_id=section_id)
    if period_id:
        qs = qs.filter(class_period_id=period_id)

    return [
        {
            "id": item.id,
            "student_id": item.student_id,
            "student_name": item.student.full_name,
            "lrn": item.student.lrn,
            "schedule_id": item.class_period_id,
            "subject_code": item.class_period.subject.code if (item.class_period and item.class_period.subject) else "",
            "section": format_section_label(
                item.class_period.section.grade_level.name
                if (item.class_period and item.class_period.section and item.class_period.section.grade_level)
                else "",
                item.class_period.section.name if (item.class_period and item.class_period.section) else "",
            ),
            "attendance_date": str(item.attendance_date),
            "status": item.status,
            "scan_method": item.scan_method,
            "scanned_at": timezone.localtime(item.scanned_at).strftime("%I:%M:%S %p"),
        }
        for item in qs[:300]
    ]

def get_exit_passes_for_user(*, user, status_filter: str = "ALL", search: str = ""):
    role = get_user_role(user)
    qs = ExitPass.objects.select_related("student", "teacher", "issued_by").order_by("-created_at")

    if status_filter and status_filter.upper() != "ALL":
        clean_st = status_filter.upper()
        if clean_st == "DECLINED":
            qs = qs.filter(status__in=["REVOKED", "DECLINED"])
        else:
            qs = qs.filter(status=clean_st)
    if search:
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(pass_number__icontains=search)
            | Q(student__first_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(student__last_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(teacher__first_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(teacher__last_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(reason__icontains=search)
        )
    if role == "PARENT":
        return qs.filter(student__parent_user=user)
    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        if not teacher:
            return qs.none()
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(teacher=teacher)
            | Q(issued_by=teacher)
            | Q(student_id__in=get_teacher_student_ids(teacher))
        )
    return qs
    role = get_user_role(user)
    qs = ExitPass.objects.select_related("student", "teacher", "issued_by").order_by("-created_at")

    if status_filter and status_filter.upper() != "ALL":
        qs = qs.filter(status=status_filter.upper())
    if search:
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(pass_number__icontains=search)
            | Q(student__first_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(student__last_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(reason__icontains=search)
        )
    if role == "PARENT":
        return qs.filter(student__parent_user=user)
    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        if not teacher:
            return qs.none()
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(teacher=teacher)
            | Q(issued_by=teacher)
            | Q(student_id__in=get_teacher_student_ids(teacher))
        )
    return qs

import uuid
from datetime import timedelta
from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework import serializers
from common.permissions import is_school_leader
from apps.accounts.models import TeacherProfile
from apps.accounts.selectors import resolve_teacher_for_user
from apps.messaging.services import notify_student_parent
from .models import ExitPass


class ExitPassSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    bearer_type = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    student_name = serializers.CharField(source="student.full_name", read_only=True, default="")
    student_lrn = serializers.CharField(source="student.lrn", read_only=True, default="")
    teacher_name = serializers.CharField(source="teacher.full_name", read_only=True, default="")
    faculty_name = serializers.CharField(source="teacher.full_name", read_only=True, default="")
    faculty_emp_id = serializers.CharField(source="teacher.employee_id", read_only=True, default="")
    adviser_name = serializers.CharField(source="issued_by.full_name", read_only=True, default="School Staff")
    valid_to = serializers.DateTimeField(source="valid_until", required=False)

    class Meta:
        model = ExitPass
        fields = [
            "id", "pass_number", "bearer_type",
            "student", "student_name", "student_lrn",
            "teacher", "teacher_name", "faculty_name", "faculty_emp_id",
            "issued_by", "adviser_name", "pass_type", "reason",
            "valid_from", "valid_until", "valid_to", "status", "created_at",
        ]
        read_only_fields = ["id", "pass_number", "issued_by", "status", "created_at"]
        extra_kwargs = {
            "valid_from": {"required": False},
            "valid_until": {"required": False},
        }

    def get_bearer_type(self, obj) -> str:
        return "STUDENT" if obj.student_id else "FACULTY"

    def to_representation(self, instance):
        data = super().to_representation(instance)
        if data.get("status") == "REVOKED":
            data["status"] = "DECLINED"
        return data

    def validate(self, attrs):
        now = timezone.now()
        attrs.setdefault("valid_from", now)
        attrs.setdefault("valid_until", attrs["valid_from"] + timedelta(hours=4))
        if attrs["valid_until"] <= attrs["valid_from"]:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"valid_until": "Return time must be after departure time."})
        return attrs

    def create(self, validated_data):
        request = self.context["request"]
        issuer = resolve_teacher_for_user(request.user) or TeacherProfile.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
        if not validated_data.get("student") and not validated_data.get("teacher"):
            validated_data["teacher"] = issuer

        is_student_pass = bool(validated_data.get("student"))
        initial_status = "ACTIVE" if (is_school_leader(request.user) or is_student_pass) else "PENDING"
        pass_code = f"EP-{timezone.localdate().strftime('%Y%m%d')}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6].upper()}"

        pass_obj = ExitPass.objects.create(
            **validated_data,
            pass_number=pass_code,
            issued_by=issuer,
            status=initial_status,
        )
        if pass_obj.student:
            notify_student_parent(
                student=pass_obj.student,
                title=f"Exit Pass Issued: {pass_obj.student.first_name}",
                message=f"Exit pass #{pass_code} issued for {pass_obj.student.full_name} ({pass_obj.reason}).",
                category="GATE_PASS",
            )
        return pass_obj

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone
from django.utils.dateparse import parse_datetime

from common.exceptions import AppError
from common.gps import verify_campus_gps
from common.media import build_media_url
from common.permissions import is_school_leader
from common.qr_signer import verify_student_qr
from apps.accounts.selectors import get_teacher_student_ids, resolve_teacher_for_user
from apps.campus.selectors import get_active_campus_coords
from apps.messaging.services import notify_student_parent
