from rest_framework.pagination import PageNumberPagination
from rest_framework.response import Response


class StandardPagination(PageNumberPagination):
    page_size = 25
    page_size_query_param = "page_size"
    max_page_size = 500

    def get_page_size(self, request):
        raw = str(request.query_params.get(self.page_size_query_param, "")).strip().upper()
        if raw in ("ALL", "MAX"):
            return self.max_page_size
        return super().get_page_size(request)

    def get_paginated_response(self, data):
        return Response({
            "count": self.page.paginator.count,
            "total_pages": self.page.paginator.num_pages,
            "current_page": self.page.number,
            "page_size": self.get_page_size(self.request),
            "next": self.get_next_link(),
            "previous": self.get_previous_link(),
            "results": data,
        })

from rest_framework import permissions

LEADERSHIP_ROLES = {"ADMIN", "SUPERADMIN", "PRINCIPAL", "DEPT_HEAD"}


def get_user_role(user) -> str:
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return "ANONYMOUS"
    if user.is_superuser:
        return "ADMIN"
    profile = getattr(user, "profile", None)
    if profile and profile.role:
        return str(profile.role).upper()
    return "ADMIN" if user.is_staff else "FACULTY"


def is_school_leader(user) -> bool:
    return bool(user and user.is_authenticated and (user.is_superuser or get_user_role(user) in LEADERSHIP_ROLES))


class IsLeadershipOrReadOnly(permissions.BasePermission):
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        if not request.user or not request.user.is_authenticated:
            return False
        if request.method in permissions.SAFE_METHODS:
            return True
        return is_school_leader(request.user)


class IsSystemAdmin(permissions.BasePermission):
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        return bool(
            request.user
            and request.user.is_authenticated
            and (request.user.is_superuser or get_user_role(request.user) in {"ADMIN", "SUPERADMIN"})
        )

def normalize_ph_phone(raw_phone: str) -> str:
    digits = "".join(ch for ch in str(raw_phone or "") if ch.isdigit())
    if digits.startswith("639") and len(digits) == 12:
        return f"+{digits}"
    if digits.startswith("09") and len(digits) == 11:
        return f"+63{digits[1:]}"
    if digits.startswith("9") and len(digits) == 10:
        return f"+63{digits}"
    return f"+{digits}" if digits else ""

import hashlib
import hmac
from dataclasses import dataclass
from django.conf import settings


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VerifiedQrData:
    lrn: str
    qr_token: str
    is_signed: bool


def sign_student_qr(lrn: str, qr_token: str) -> str:
    clean_lrn = str(lrn or "").strip()
    clean_token = str(qr_token or "").strip()
    payload = f"{clean_lrn}:{clean_token}".encode("utf-8")
    sig = hmac.new(settings.SECRET_KEY.encode("utf-8"), payload, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()[:12].upper()
    return f"ATTENDSURE:{clean_lrn}:{clean_token}:{sig}"


def verify_student_qr(raw_scan: str, *, allow_legacy_unsigned: bool = True) -> VerifiedQrData | None:
    clean = str(raw_scan or "").strip().replace("\r", "").replace("\n", "").replace("\0", "")[:128]
    if not clean:
        return None

    parts = clean.split(":")
    if len(parts) == 4 and parts[0].upper() == "ATTENDSURE":
        _, lrn, token, provided_sig = parts
        expected_sig = sign_student_qr(lrn, token).rsplit(":", 1)[-1]
        if not hmac.compare_digest(provided_sig.upper(), expected_sig):
            return None
        return VerifiedQrData(lrn=lrn.strip(), qr_token=token.strip(), is_signed=True)

    if not allow_legacy_unsigned:
        return None

    token_only = parts[-1].strip()
    return VerifiedQrData(lrn=token_only, qr_token=token_only, is_signed=False)

r"""
AttendSure - Thread-Safe Color Terminal API & Security Logger
File: D:\AttendSure_V3\backend\common\request_logger.py
"""

import ipaddress
import logging
import os
import re
import sys
import threading
import time
import unicodedata
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlencode
from django.utils import timezone

security_logger = logging.getLogger("attendsure.security")

_CONSOLE_LOCK = threading.Lock()

# Strips ANSI CSI, OSC, and single-char ESC sequences
TERMINAL_ESCAPE_RE = re.compile(
    r"\x1b(?:[@-Z\\-_]|\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]|\][^\x07\x1b]*(?:\x07|\x1b\\))"
)
KEY_SPLIT_RE = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")

# Exact parameter names that must always be redacted
EXACT_SENSITIVE_KEYS = {
    "pass",
    "code",
    "key",
    "sig",
    "signature",
    "pin",
    "otp",
    "jwt",
    "bearer",
    "authorization",
}

# Word segments (split on _, -, .) that indicate a credential or token
SENSITIVE_KEY_SEGMENTS = {
    "password",
    "passwd",
    "pwd",
    "passcode",
    "passphrase",
    "token",
    "secret",
    "apikey",
    "otp",
    "jwt",
    "refresh",
    "access",
    "session",
    "sessionid",
    "csrf",
    "csrftoken",
    "private",
    "credential",
}

HIDDEN_POLL_PARAMS = {"silent", "nocache", "_t"}

QUIET_POLL_PATHS = {
    "/api/notifications/",
    "/api/v1/messaging/notifications/",
    "/api/system/status/",
    "/api/v1/reports/system-status/",
    "/api/core/maintenance/db-check/",
    "/api/health/db/",
    "/api/v1/health/db/",
    "/api/v1/school/public-branding/",
}

TRUSTED_PROXIES = {
    ip.strip()
    for ip in os.getenv("TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS", "127.0.0.1,::1").split(",")
    if ip.strip()
}


def _enable_windows_ansi_colors() -> bool:
    """Enables ANSI color codes on Windows terminals unless NO_COLOR is set."""
    if os.getenv("NO_COLOR") or "test" in sys.argv:
        return False
    if not hasattr(sys.stdout, "isatty") or not sys.stdout.isatty():
        return False
    if os.name != "nt":
        return True
    try:
        import ctypes

        kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
        handle = kernel32.GetStdHandle(-11)  # STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE
        mode = ctypes.c_ulong()
        if kernel32.GetConsoleMode(handle, ctypes.byref(mode)):
            kernel32.SetConsoleMode(handle, mode.value | 0x0004)
        return True
    except Exception:
        return True


def _atomic_print(line: str) -> None:
    """Writes a complete newline-terminated log row atomically across threads."""
    if sys.stdout is None:
        return
    try:
        with _CONSOLE_LOCK:
            sys.stdout.write(f"{line}\n")
            sys.stdout.flush()
    except OSError:
        pass


class TerminalColors:
    RESET = "\033[0m"
    BOLD = "\033[1m"
    DIM = "\033[2m"

    RED = "\033[91m"
    GREEN = "\033[92m"
    YELLOW = "\033[93m"
    CYAN = "\033[96m"
    MAGENTA = "\033[95m"
    WHITE = "\033[97m"

    BG_RED = "\033[41m\033[97m\033[1m"
    BG_YELLOW = "\033[43m\033[30m\033[1m"


def _sanitize_log_text(value: object, max_len: int = 140) -> str:
    """Strips ANSI escapes, C0/C1 controls, and Unicode BiDi/format spoofing chars."""
    cleaned = TERMINAL_ESCAPE_RE.sub("", str(value or ""))
    safe_chars = [
        ch for ch in cleaned if unicodedata.category(ch)[0] != "C"
    ]
    return "".join(safe_chars)[:max_len]


def _is_sensitive_key(key: str) -> bool:
    """Redacts tokens and secrets without masking benign keys like pass_type or subject_code."""
    lowered = key.strip().lower()
    if lowered in EXACT_SENSITIVE_KEYS:
        return True
    if lowered.endswith(("_key", "-key", "_code", "-code")) and lowered.startswith(
        ("api", "auth", "secret", "qr", "otp", "reset", "verify", "client")
    ):
        return True
    segments = set(KEY_SPLIT_RE.split(lowered))
    return bool(segments & SENSITIVE_KEY_SEGMENTS)


def _safe_query_string(raw_query: str) -> str:
    """Formats query parameters safely while masking credentials and tokens."""
    if not raw_query:
        return ""
    pairs = parse_qsl(raw_query[:1024], keep_blank_values=True)
    masked = [
        (k, "***" if _is_sensitive_key(k) else v)
        for k, v in pairs
        if k not in HIDDEN_POLL_PARAMS
    ]
    if not masked:
        return ""
    return f"?{_sanitize_log_text(urlencode(masked), max_len=90)}"


def _validate_ip(raw_ip: str) -> str | None:
    candidate = raw_ip.strip()
    if not candidate:
        return None
    try:
        return str(ipaddress.ip_address(candidate))
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _extract_client_ip(request) -> str:
    """Honors forwarded headers only when REMOTE_ADDR is a trusted local reverse proxy."""
    remote_addr = str(request.META.get("REMOTE_ADDR") or "127.0.0.1").strip()

    if remote_addr in TRUSTED_PROXIES:
        cf_ip = _validate_ip(str(request.META.get("HTTP_CF_CONNECTING_IP") or ""))
        if cf_ip:
            return cf_ip

        xff = str(request.META.get("HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR") or "")
        if xff:
            forwarded_ip = _validate_ip(xff.split(",")[0])
            if forwarded_ip:
                return forwarded_ip

    return _validate_ip(remote_addr) or "127.0.0.1"


def _resolve_authenticated_username(request, response) -> str | None:
    """Reads already-resolved DRF or Django user objects with zero extra DB queries."""
    if response is not None:
        renderer_ctx = getattr(response, "renderer_context", None)
        if isinstance(renderer_ctx, dict):
            drf_request = renderer_ctx.get("request")
            drf_user = getattr(drf_request, "_user", None)
            if drf_user and getattr(drf_user, "is_authenticated", False):
                return _sanitize_log_text(drf_user.username, max_len=40)

    # Read _cached_user from __dict__ so SimpleLazyObject never triggers a DB hit on 404s
    cached_user = getattr(request, "__dict__", {}).get("_cached_user")
    if cached_user and getattr(cached_user, "is_authenticated", False):
        return _sanitize_log_text(cached_user.username, max_len=40)

    return None


def _format_response_size(response, status_code: int) -> str:
    """Reads Content-Length first to avoid copying response byte buffers."""
    if response is None or status_code in (204, 304):
        return "0B"

    header_len = response.get("Content-Length")
    if header_len and str(header_len).isdigit():
        byte_len = int(header_len)
    elif getattr(response, "streaming", False):
        return "stream"
    else:
        content = getattr(response, "content", None)
        byte_len = len(content) if content is not None else None

    if byte_len is None:
        return "stream"
    if byte_len >= 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{byte_len / (1024 * 1024):.2f}MB"
    if byte_len >= 1024:
        return f"{byte_len / 1024:.1f}KB"
    return f"{byte_len}B"


class RequestLoggerMiddleware:
    """Prints thread-safe, color-coded API status, user, size, and latency lines."""

    sync_capable = True
    async_capable = False

    def __init__(self, get_response):
        self.get_response = get_response
        self.use_colors = _enable_windows_ansi_colors()
        self.quiet_mode = os.getenv("ATTENDSURE_QUIET_LOGGER", "").lower() in ("1", "true")

        reset = self._color(TerminalColors.RESET)
        bold = self._color(TerminalColors.BOLD)
        self._reset = reset
        self._dim = self._color(TerminalColors.DIM)
        self._bold = bold
        self._white = self._color(TerminalColors.WHITE)
        self._red = self._color(TerminalColors.RED)

        # Precompute method badges once at startup
        self._method_badges = {
            "POST": (
                f"{self._color(TerminalColors.GREEN)}{bold}[CREATE]{reset}",
                f"{self._color(TerminalColors.GREEN)}{'POST':<6}{reset}",
            ),
            "GET": (
                f"{self._color(TerminalColors.CYAN)}{bold}[READ]  {reset}",
                f"{self._color(TerminalColors.CYAN)}{'GET':<6}{reset}",
            ),
            "PUT": (
                f"{self._color(TerminalColors.YELLOW)}{bold}[UPDATE]{reset}",
                f"{self._color(TerminalColors.YELLOW)}{'PUT':<6}{reset}",
            ),
            "PATCH": (
                f"{self._color(TerminalColors.YELLOW)}{bold}[UPDATE]{reset}",
                f"{self._color(TerminalColors.YELLOW)}{'PATCH':<6}{reset}",
            ),
            "DELETE": (
                f"{self._color(TerminalColors.MAGENTA)}{bold}[DELETE]{reset}",
                f"{self._color(TerminalColors.MAGENTA)}{'DELETE':<6}{reset}",
            ),
        }

    def __call__(self, request):
        started = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            response = self.get_response(request)
        except Exception:
            duration_ms = max(1, round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000))
            if not self.quiet_mode:
                self.log_request(request, None, duration_ms, forced_code=500)
            raise

        duration_ms = max(1, round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000))
        if not self.quiet_mode:
            self.log_request(request, response, duration_ms)
        return response

    def _color(self, ansi_code: str) -> str:
        return ansi_code if self.use_colors else ""

    def _status_badge(self, code: int) -> str:
        reset, bold = self._reset, self._bold
        if 200 <= code < 300:
            return f"{self._color(TerminalColors.GREEN)}{bold}[OK {code}]       {reset}"
        if code == 304:
            return f"{self._color(TerminalColors.CYAN)}[CACHED 304]   {reset}"
        if 300 <= code < 400:
            return f"{self._color(TerminalColors.CYAN)}[REDIRECT {code}] {reset}"
        if code in (401, 403):
            return f"{self._color(TerminalColors.BG_YELLOW)} [DENIED {code}]  {reset}"
        if code == 404:
            return f"{self._red}{bold}[NOT FOUND 404]{reset}"
        if code == 405:
            return f"{self._color(TerminalColors.MAGENTA)}{bold}[METHOD 405]   {reset}"
        if code == 429:
            return f"{self._color(TerminalColors.BG_YELLOW)} [LIMIT 429]   {reset}"
        if 400 <= code < 500:
            return f"{self._color(TerminalColors.YELLOW)}{bold}[BAD REQ {code}]  {reset}"
        return f"{self._color(TerminalColors.BG_RED)} [ERROR {code}]   {reset}"

    def log_request(
        self,
        request,
        response,
        duration_ms: int,
        forced_code: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        path = _sanitize_log_text(request.path)
        if path.startswith("/static/"):
            return

        method = _sanitize_log_text(request.method, max_len=10).upper()
        code = forced_code if forced_code is not None else int(getattr(response, "status_code", 200))

        if method == "OPTIONS" and 200 <= code < 400:
            return

        now_str = timezone.localtime().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        raw_qs = request.META.get("QUERY_STRING", "")
        is_media = path.startswith("/media/")
        is_silent_poll = method == "GET" and ("silent=1" in raw_qs or path in QUIET_POLL_PATHS)

        if (is_silent_poll or is_media) and 200 <= code < 400 and duration_ms <= 500:
            tag = "MEDIA" if is_media else "POLL "
            state_str = "CACHED 304" if code == 304 else f"OK {code}"
            _atomic_print(
                f"{self._dim}[{now_str}] [{tag}]   [{state_str}] {method} {path} ({duration_ms}ms){self._reset}"
            )
            return

        action_badge, method_str = self._method_badges.get(
            method,
            (f"{self._white}[CHECK] {self._reset}", f"{method:<6}"),
        )
        status_badge = self._status_badge(code)

        username = None if is_media else _resolve_authenticated_username(request, response)
        user_label = (
            f"{self._white}(User: {username}){self._reset}"
            if username
            else f"{self._dim}(Guest){self._reset}"
        )

        size_str = _format_response_size(response, code)
        if duration_ms > 500:
            perf_badge = f"{self._red}{self._bold}{duration_ms}ms SLOW{self._reset} {self._dim}[{size_str}]{self._reset}"
        else:
            perf_badge = f"{self._dim}{duration_ms}ms [{size_str}]{self._reset}"

        full_target = f"{path}{_safe_query_string(raw_qs)}"
        _atomic_print(
            f"[{now_str}] {action_badge} {status_badge} {method_str} {full_target} {user_label} {perf_badge}"
        )

        if code >= 400:
            client_ip = _extract_client_ip(request)
            security_logger.warning(
                "%s %s -> %s (User: %s, IP: %s, %sms)",
                method,
                full_target,
                code,
                username or "Guest",
                client_ip,
                duration_ms,
            )


ColorTerminalMiddleware = RequestLoggerMiddleware

import time
from django.core.cache import cache
from django.db import connection
from django.http import JsonResponse
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from rest_framework.decorators import api_view, permission_classes
from rest_framework.response import Response

from common.audit import record_audit_log
from common.permissions import IsSystemAdmin


class ApiSecurityMiddleware:
    """
    Applies OWASP security headers and prevents 40 KB Django debug HTML pages
    from leaking internal URL patterns when an /api/ path returns 404.
    """

    def __init__(self, get_response):
        self.get_response = get_response

    def __call__(self, request):
        response = self.get_response(request)

        if request.path.startswith("/api/") and response.status_code == 404:
            content_type = response.get("Content-Type", "")
            if "text/html" in content_type:
                response = JsonResponse(
                    {
                        "ok": False,
                        "error_code": "ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND",
                        "message": f"API route not found: {request.path}",
                    },
                    status=404,
                )

        response["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
        response["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY"
        response["Referrer-Policy"] = "same-origin"
        response["Permissions-Policy"] = "camera=(self), geolocation=(self), microphone=()"

        if request.path.startswith(("/api/auth/", "/api/v1/accounts/login", "/api/me")):
            response["Cache-Control"] = "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, private"

        return response


@api_view(["GET"])
@permission_classes([permissions.AllowAny])
def database_health_view(request):
    """Checks live PostgreSQL connectivity without exposing database names or hosts."""
    started = time.perf_counter()
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SELECT 1;")
        cursor.fetchone()
    latency_ms = max(1, round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000))
    return Response(
        {
            "ok": True,
            "status": "CONNECTED",
            "database": "CONNECTED",
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
        },
        status=status.HTTP_200_OK,
    )


@api_view(["POST"])
@permission_classes([permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsSystemAdmin])
def clear_system_cache_view(request):
    """Clears server cache for system administrators only and logs the action."""
    cache.clear()
    record_audit_log(
        request=request,
        table_name="system_cache",
        record_id=0,
        action="FLUSH",
    )
    return Response(
        {"ok": True, "success": True, "message": "System cache cleared."},
        status=status.HTTP_200_OK,
    )

from django.conf import settings
from django.conf.urls.static import static
from django.contrib import admin
from django.urls import include, path, re_path
from django.views.static import serve

from common.security import clear_system_cache_view, database_health_view


def serve_cached_media(request, path):
    response = serve(request, path, document_root=settings.MEDIA_ROOT)
    response["Cache-Control"] = "public, max-age=86400"
    response["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = "*"
    return response

"""
ATTENDSURE - Gunicorn Production Configuration
Formula for workers: (2 x CPU cores) + 1
Example: 4 CPU cores = 9 workers
"""

import multiprocessing

# Bind to internal port (Nginx will talk to this)
bind = "127.0.0.1:8000"

# Number of worker processes handling requests
workers = (multiprocessing.cpu_count() * 2) + 1

# Worker type
worker_class = "sync"

# Maximum time a worker can take to answer before restarting (prevents frozen requests)
timeout = 30

# Keep-alive connections for fast mobile requests
keepalive = 5

# Restart workers periodically to prevent memory leaks from photo processing
max_requests = 1000
max_requests_jitter = 100

# Logging
accesslog = "-"
errorlog = "-"
loglevel = "info"

import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
os.environ["DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE"] = "config.settings"

DOMAIN_APPS = [
    "accounts",
    "school",
    "students",
    "attendance",
    "campus",
    "messaging",
    "reports",
]


def ensure_app_packages_and_urls():
    """Guarantees every app has __init__.py, migrations/__init__.py, and urls.py."""
    (BASE_DIR / "apps" / "__init__.py").touch(exist_ok=True)
    for app_name in DOMAIN_APPS:
        app_dir = BASE_DIR / "apps" / app_name
        mig_dir = app_dir / "migrations"
        mig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (app_dir / "__init__.py").touch(exist_ok=True)
        (mig_dir / "__init__.py").touch(exist_ok=True)

        urls_file = app_dir / "urls.py"
        if not urls_file.exists():
            urls_file.write_text("urlpatterns = []\n", encoding="utf-8")
            print(f"[CREATED] apps/{app_name}/urls.py")


def archive_legacy_folders():
    backup_dir = BASE_DIR / "_legacy_backup"
    legacy_paths = [
        BASE_DIR / "attendsure_core",
        BASE_DIR / "apps" / "academics",
        BASE_DIR / "apps" / "api",
        BASE_DIR / "apps" / "common",
        BASE_DIR / "apps" / "core",
        BASE_DIR / "apps" / "telemetry",
    ]
    for path in legacy_paths:
        if path.exists():
            backup_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            target = backup_dir / path.name
            if target.exists():
                shutil.rmtree(target)
            shutil.move(str(path), str(target))
            print(f"[ARCHIVED] {path.relative_to(BASE_DIR)} -> _legacy_backup/{path.name}")


def ensure_holidays_table_for_existing_db(connection):
    """Creates school_holidays if attaching to an existing AttendSure database."""
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        tables = set(connection.introspection.table_names(cursor))
        if "academic_years" in tables and "school_holidays" not in tables:
            if connection.vendor == "postgresql":
                cursor.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS school_holidays (
                        id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
                        holiday_date DATE NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                        title VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
                        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
                    );
                """)
            else:
                cursor.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS school_holidays (
                        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                        holiday_date DATE NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                        title VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
                        created_at DATETIME NOT NULL
                    );
                """)
            print("[CREATED TABLE] school_holidays")


def sync_database_state():
    import django
    from django.core.management import call_command
    from django.db import connection

    django.setup()

    print("\n[1/3] Running Django system check...")
    call_command("check")

    print("\n[2/3] Generating migrations for domain apps...")
    call_command(
        "makemigrations",
        "accounts",
        "school",
        "students",
        "attendance",
        "campus",
        "messaging",
    )

    ensure_holidays_table_for_existing_db(connection)

    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        existing_tables = set(connection.introspection.table_names(cursor))

    print("\n[3/3] Syncing database state (preserving all existing records)...")
    if "students" in existing_tables:
        call_command("migrate", "--fake-initial")
    else:
        call_command("migrate")

    print("\n[SUCCESS] All domain apps checked and synced with zero errors!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ensure_app_packages_and_urls()
    archive_legacy_folders()
    sync_database_state()

# AttendSure - Windows 10 Zero-Downtime Deployment Switcher
# File: D:\AttendSure_V3\deploy\switch.ps1

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# Navigate to project root (one folder up from deploy)
$ScriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
Set-Location "$ScriptDir\.."

$NginxConf = "$ScriptDir\nginx.conf"

if (-not (Test-Path $NginxConf)) {
    Write-Host "Error: nginx.conf not found at $NginxConf" -ForegroundColor Red
    Exit 1
}

# 1. Determine currently active upstream port
$ConfContent = Get-Content $NginxConf -Raw
if ($ConfContent -match "127\.0\.0\.1:8001") {
    $CurrentPort = "8001"
    $TargetColor = "green"
    $TargetPort = "8002"
} else {
    $CurrentPort = "8002"
    $TargetColor = "blue"
    $TargetPort = "8001"
}

Write-Host "==================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Active Port   : $CurrentPort" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "Deploying Target: web_$TargetColor on port $TargetPort" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "==================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# 2. Build and boot the idle container in Docker Desktop
Write-Host "Building and launching container web_$TargetColor..." -ForegroundColor Gray
docker compose build "web_$TargetColor"
docker compose up -d "web_$TargetColor"

# 3. Health check verification before switching
Write-Host "Verifying container health on http://127.0.0.1:$TargetPort..." -ForegroundColor Gray
Start-Sleep -Seconds 4

try {
    $Response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:$TargetPort/api/settings/school/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5
    if ($Response.StatusCode -ne 200) {
        throw "Target returned HTTP status $($Response.StatusCode)"
    }
    Write-Host "Health check passed (HTTP 200 OK)." -ForegroundColor Green
} catch {
    Write-Host "Health check failed: $_. Aborting traffic swap." -ForegroundColor Red
    Exit 1
}

# 4. Swap upstream configuration
$UpdatedContent = $ConfContent -replace "127\.0\.0\.1:$CurrentPort", "127\.0\.0\.1:$TargetPort"
Set-Content -Path $NginxConf -Value $UpdatedContent

# 5. Reload Nginx container without downtime
docker compose exec nginx nginx -s reload

Write-Host "==================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Traffic successfully routed to $TargetColor (Port $TargetPort)!" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "==================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

#!/bin/bash
set -e

NGINX_CONF="/etc/nginx/nginx.conf"
CURRENT_PORT=$(grep -oE "127.0.0.1:[0-9]+" $NGINX_CONF | cut -d: -f2)

if [ "$CURRENT_PORT" == "8001" ]; then
    TARGET_COLOR="green"
    TARGET_PORT="8002"
else
    TARGET_COLOR="blue"
    TARGET_PORT="8001"
fi

echo "=================================================="
echo "Active: $CURRENT_PORT | Deploying to: $TARGET_COLOR on $TARGET_PORT"
echo "=================================================="

# 1. Pull changes and rebuild the target container
docker compose build web_$TARGET_COLOR
docker compose up -d web_$TARGET_COLOR

# 2. Wait and test health check endpoint
echo "Verifying health on target port $TARGET_PORT..."
sleep 4
HEALTH=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:$TARGET_PORT/api/settings/school/ || true)

if [ "$HEALTH" != "200" ]; then
    echo "Deployment aborted: Target returned HTTP $HEALTH. Rolling back."
    exit 1
fi

# 3. Swap the upstream port inside Nginx configuration
sed -i "s/127.0.0.1:$CURRENT_PORT/127.0.0.1:$TARGET_PORT/g" $NGINX_CONF

# 4. Reload Nginx without dropping active connections
nginx -s reload

echo "=================================================="
echo "Traffic switched to $TARGET_COLOR ($TARGET_PORT) with zero downtime."
echo "=================================================="

// AttendSure - Secure Mobile API Client with Automated Failover
// File: mobile/src/api/client.ts

import axios, { AxiosError, InternalAxiosRequestConfig } from 'axios';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import {
  getServerBaseUrl,
  resolveFastestServer,
  invalidateServerCache,
  cleanUrl,
} from '../services/configService';

export const AUTH_TOKEN_KEY = 'attendsure_auth_token';
const LEGACY_TOKEN_KEYS = ['user_token', 'attendsure_token'];

export const apiClient = axios.create({
  timeout: 8000,
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    Accept: 'application/json',
  },
});

apiClient.interceptors.request.use(
  async (config: InternalAxiosRequestConfig) => {
    // 1. Resolve and sanitize base URL (guarantees no trailing slashes or /api)
    const rawBaseUrl = await getServerBaseUrl();
    config.baseURL = cleanUrl(rawBaseUrl);

    // 2. Prevent duplicate /api/ prefixes and path traversal
    let requestPath = config.url || '';
    if (!requestPath.startsWith('http://') && !requestPath.startsWith('https://')) {
      const sanitized = requestPath
        .replace(/^\/+/, '')
        .replace(/\.\.\//g, '')
        .replace(/^(api\/)+/i, '');
      config.url = `/api/${sanitized}`;
    }

    // 3. Resolve stored authentication token
    let token = await AsyncStorage.getItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
    if (!token) {
      for (const legacyKey of LEGACY_TOKEN_KEYS) {
        const legacyToken = await AsyncStorage.getItem(legacyKey);
        if (legacyToken) {
          token = legacyToken;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // 4. Attach token with CRLF injection protection
    if (token && config.headers && !config.headers.Authorization) {
      const sanitizedToken = token.trim().replace(/[\r\n]/g, '');
      config.headers.Authorization = `Token ${sanitizedToken}`;
    }

    return config;
  },
  (error) => Promise.reject(error)
);

apiClient.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  async (error: AxiosError) => {
    const originalRequest = error.config as InternalAxiosRequestConfig & {
      _retryCount?: number;
    };

    // Clear stored credentials on 401 Unauthorized
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
      await AsyncStorage.multiRemove([
        AUTH_TOKEN_KEY,
        'user_token',
        'attendsure_token',
        'attendsure_user',
        'attendsure_role',
      ]);
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }

    // Automated failover if network times out or drops
    const isNetworkError =
      !error.response ||
      error.code === 'ECONNABORTED' ||
      error.message?.includes('Network Error') ||
      error.message?.includes('timeout');

    if (isNetworkError && originalRequest) {
      originalRequest._retryCount = originalRequest._retryCount || 0;

      if (originalRequest._retryCount < 1) {
        originalRequest._retryCount += 1;
        invalidateServerCache();

        try {
          const newBaseUrl = await resolveFastestServer();
          originalRequest.baseURL = cleanUrl(newBaseUrl);
          return apiClient(originalRequest);
        } catch (discoveryError) {
          return Promise.reject(discoveryError);
        }
      }
    }

    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export default apiClient;

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { StyleSheet, Animated } from 'react-native';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';

const LOGO_SOURCE = require('../../assets/attendsure-logo.svg');

interface AttendSureBadgeProps {
  size?: number;
  animate?: boolean;
}

export const AttendSureBadge: React.FC<AttendSureBadgeProps> = ({
  size = 96,
  animate = false,
}) => {
  const scaleAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
  const iconSize = Math.round(size * 0.62);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!animate) return;

    const breatheAnimation = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(scaleAnim, {
          toValue: 1.05,
          duration: 1200,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.timing(scaleAnim, {
          toValue: 1,
          duration: 1200,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
      ])
    );

    breatheAnimation.start();
    return () => breatheAnimation.stop();
  }, [animate, scaleAnim]);

  return (
    <Animated.View
      style={[
        styles.badgeContainer,
        {
          width: size,
          height: size,
          borderRadius: size / 2,
          transform: [{ scale: scaleAnim }],
        },
      ]}
    >
      <Image
        source={LOGO_SOURCE}
        style={{ width: iconSize, height: iconSize }}
        contentFit="contain"
      />
    </Animated.View>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  badgeContainer: {
    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    borderWidth: 2,
    borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
    shadowColor: '#004b87',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.18,
    shadowRadius: 10,
    elevation: 6,
    overflow: 'hidden',
  },
});

export default AttendSureBadge;

import React from 'react';
import { Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { useThemeMode } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

interface BadgeProps {
  label: string;
  variant?: 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'info' | 'neutral';
}

export function Badge({ label, variant = 'neutral' }: BadgeProps) {
  const { palette, ui, fonts } = useThemeMode();

  const map = {
    success: { bg: palette.successLight, text: palette.success },
    warning: { bg: palette.warningLight, text: palette.warning },
    danger: { bg: palette.dangerLight, text: palette.danger },
    info: { bg: palette.infoLight, text: palette.info },
    neutral: { bg: palette.surfaceSubtle, text: palette.textSecondary },
  };
  const cur = map[variant];

  return (
    <View style={[ui.badge, { backgroundColor: cur.bg }]}>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: cur.text }}>{label}</Text>
    </View>
  );

import React from 'react';
import { Text, TouchableOpacity, ActivityIndicator, ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { useThemeMode } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

interface ButtonProps {
  title: string;
  onPress: () => void;
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'outline';
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  style?: ViewStyle;
}

export function Button({ title, onPress, variant = 'primary', loading = false, disabled = false, style }: ButtonProps) {
  const { palette, radius, spacing, fonts } = useThemeMode();

  const stylesMap = {
    primary: { bg: palette.primary, text: '#ffffff', border: 'transparent' },
    danger: { bg: palette.danger, text: '#ffffff', border: 'transparent' },
    secondary: { bg: palette.surfaceSubtle, text: palette.textPrimary, border: palette.border },
    outline: { bg: 'transparent', text: palette.textSecondary, border: palette.borderStrong },
  };
  const cfg = stylesMap[variant];

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      style={[
        {
          height: 44,
          borderRadius: radius.md,
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          paddingHorizontal: spacing.md,
          backgroundColor: cfg.bg,
          borderColor: cfg.border,
          borderWidth: cfg.border !== 'transparent' ? 1 : 0,
          opacity: disabled ? 0.5 : 1,
        },
        style,
      ]}
      onPress={onPress}
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      activeOpacity={0.8}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <ActivityIndicator color={cfg.text} size="small" />
      ) : (
        <Text style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: cfg.text }}>{title}</Text>
      )}
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

  return (
    <View style={[ui.card, style]}>
      {(title || rightAction) && (

          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>

          </View>
          {rightAction && <View>{rightAction}</View>}
        </View>
      )}
      <View>{children}</View>
    </View>
  );

  leftLogoUrl?: string | null;  
  rightLogoUrl?: string | null;

interface DepEdFooterProps {
  schoolLogoUrl?: string | null; 
  address?: string;
  contactNumber?: string;
  email?: string;

const sanitizeImageUrl = (url?: string | null): string | null => {
  if (!url) return null;
  const clean = url.trim();
  if (
    clean.startsWith('http://') ||
    clean.startsWith('https://') ||
    clean.startsWith('data:image/') ||
    clean.startsWith('file://')
  ) {
    return clean;
  }
  return null;
};

const cleanText = (val?: string | null): string => {
  if (!val) return '';
  return val.replace(/[\r\n\t]/g, ' ').trim();
};

export const DepEdReportHeader: React.FC<DepEdHeaderProps> = ({
  leftLogoUrl,
  rightLogoUrl,
  region,
  division,
  formTitle,
  formSubtitle,
}) => {
  const safeKagawaranLogo = sanitizeImageUrl(leftLogoUrl);
  const safeDepEdLogo = sanitizeImageUrl(rightLogoUrl);

  const cleanRegion = cleanText(region);
  const cleanDivision = cleanText(division);
  const cleanTitle = cleanText(formTitle);
  const cleanSub = cleanText(formSubtitle);

  return (
    <View style={styles.headerContainer}>
      <View style={styles.sealBox}>
        {safeKagawaranLogo ? (
          <Image
            source={{ uri: safeKagawaranLogo }}
            style={styles.sealImage}
            contentFit="contain"
            cachePolicy="memory-disk"
            transition={100}
          />
        ) : null}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.headerCenter}>
        <Text style={styles.republicText}>Republic of the Philippines</Text>
        <Text style={styles.depedText}>Department of Education</Text>

        {cleanRegion ? (
          <Text style={styles.officeText}>{cleanRegion.toUpperCase()}</Text>
        ) : null}

        {cleanDivision ? (
          <Text style={styles.officeText}>{cleanDivision.toUpperCase()}</Text>
        ) : null}

        <Text style={styles.formTitleText}>{cleanTitle}</Text>
        {cleanSub ? <Text style={styles.formSubText}>{cleanSub}</Text> : null}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.sealBox}>
        {safeDepEdLogo ? (
          <Image
            source={{ uri: safeDepEdLogo }}
            style={styles.sealImage}
            contentFit="contain"
            cachePolicy="memory-disk"
            transition={100}
          />
        ) : null}

};

// D:\AttendSure_V3\mobile\src\components\reports\DTRReportView.tsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  TouchableOpacity,
  TextInput,
  Modal,
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { apiClient } from '../../api/client';

export interface DailyDTRRow {
  day: number;
  date_str: string;
  day_of_week: string;
  is_weekend: boolean;
  am_arrival: string;
  am_departure: string;
  pm_arrival: string;
  pm_departure: string;
  undertime_hours: number | string;
  undertime_minutes: number | string;
  is_loafing?: boolean;
  loafing_excused?: boolean;
  loafing_remarks?: string;
}

export interface DTRReportData {
  faculty_id: number;
  faculty_name: string;
  employee_id: string;
  department?: string;
  month: string;
  month_number: number;
  year: number;
  regular_days_hours: string;
  saturdays_hours: string;
  school_head: string;
  school_head_title?: string;
  dtr_submitted?: boolean;
  dept_head_approved: boolean;
  approved_by_dept_head_at?: string | null;
  user_role?: string;
  can_approve_dept?: boolean;
  can_clear_loafing?: boolean;
  rows: DailyDTRRow[];
  total_undertime_hours: number;
  total_undertime_minutes: number;
  days_present: number;
}

export interface DTRReportViewProps {
  data: DTRReportData | null;
  selectedMonth?: number;
  selectedYear?: number;
  onMonthChange?: (month: number, year: number) => void;
  submitting?: boolean;
  onSubmit?: () => void;
  onRefreshNeeded?: () => void;
}

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
];

export const DTRReportView: React.FC<DTRReportViewProps> = ({
  data,
  selectedMonth = new Date().getMonth() + 1,
  selectedYear = new Date().getFullYear(),
  onMonthChange,
  submitting = false,
  onSubmit,
  onRefreshNeeded,
}) => {
  if (!data) return null;

  const [viewSide, setViewSide] = useState<'FRONT' | 'BACK' | 'BOTH'>('FRONT');
  const [selectedViolationRow, setSelectedViolationRow] = useState<DailyDTRRow | null>(null);
  const [pardonRemarks, setPardonRemarks] = useState<string>('');
  const [actionProcessing, setActionProcessing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showDatePickerModal, setShowDatePickerModal] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const isApproved = Boolean(data.dept_head_approved);
  const isSubmitted = Boolean(data.dtr_submitted);
  const resolvedHead = (data.school_head || 'School Head / In-Charge').trim();
  const resolvedTitle = (data.school_head_title || 'In-Charge').trim();

  // Normalize 31 rows
  const rawRows = Array.isArray(data.rows) ? data.rows : [];
  const rows31: DailyDTRRow[] = [];

  for (let dayNum = 1; dayNum <= 31; dayNum++) {
    const found = rawRows.find((r) => r.day === dayNum);
    if (found) {
      rows31.push(found);
    } else {
      rows31.push({
        day: dayNum,
        date_str: '',
        day_of_week: '',
        is_weekend: false,
        am_arrival: '',
        am_departure: '',
        pm_arrival: '',
        pm_departure: '',
        undertime_hours: '',
        undertime_minutes: '',
        is_loafing: false,
        loafing_excused: false,
      });
    }
  }

  // Month navigation handlers
  const handlePrevMonth = () => {
    if (!onMonthChange) return;
    if (selectedMonth === 1) {
      onMonthChange(12, selectedYear - 1);
    } else {
      onMonthChange(selectedMonth - 1, selectedYear);
    }
  };

  const handleNextMonth = () => {
    if (!onMonthChange) return;
    if (selectedMonth === 12) {
      onMonthChange(1, selectedYear + 1);
    } else {
      onMonthChange(selectedMonth + 1, selectedYear);
    }
  };

  // Excuse loafing
  const handleExcuseLoafing = async () => {
    if (!selectedViolationRow) return;

    const cleanRemarks = pardonRemarks.replace(/[\r\n\t]/g, ' ').trim();
    if (!cleanRemarks) {
      Alert.alert('Required', 'Please enter official remarks or justification.');
      return;
    }

    setActionProcessing(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`/reports/dtr/${data.faculty_id}/`, {
        action: 'EXCUSE_LOAFING',
        faculty_id: data.faculty_id,
        date_str: selectedViolationRow.date_str,
        remarks: cleanRemarks,
      });

      Alert.alert('Excused', `Departure on ${selectedViolationRow.date_str} excused.`);
      setSelectedViolationRow(null);
      setPardonRemarks('');
      if (onRefreshNeeded) onRefreshNeeded();
    } catch (err: any) {
      Alert.alert('Denied', err?.response?.data?.error || 'Could not excuse record.');
    } finally {
      setActionProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // Front DTR Sheet
  const renderFrontSheet = () => (
    <View style={styles.sheetContainer}>
      {/* Draft Watermark */}
      {!isApproved && (
        <View style={styles.watermarkOverlay} pointerEvents="none">
          <View style={styles.watermarkRotate}>
            <View style={styles.watermarkBorder}>
              <Text style={styles.watermarkText}>DRAFT</Text>
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.watermarkSub}>NOT APPROVED BY DEPT HEAD</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Date Navigation Bar on Top of Form */}
      <View style={styles.topDateNavCard}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.dateNavArrow} onPress={handlePrevMonth}>
          <Ionicons name="chevron-back" size={16} color="#004b87" />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.dateDisplayBtn}
          onPress={() => setShowDatePickerModal(true)}
          activeOpacity={0.7}
        >
          <Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={14} color="#004b87" />
          <Text style={styles.dateDisplayText}>
            {MONTH_NAMES[selectedMonth - 1]} {selectedYear}
          </Text>
          <Ionicons name="caret-down-outline" size={11} color="#64748b" />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.dateNavArrow} onPress={handleNextMonth}>
          <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={16} color="#004b87" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Statutory Header */}
      <Text style={styles.formMeta}>Civil Service Form No. 48</Text>
      <Text style={styles.formTitle}>DAILY TIME RECORD</Text>
      <Text style={styles.formDivider}>----- o0o -----</Text>

      {/* Name Line */}
      <View style={styles.nameBlock}>
        <Text style={styles.nameText}>{data.faculty_name.toUpperCase()}</Text>
        <View style={styles.blackUnderline} />
        <Text style={styles.captionText}>(Name)</Text>
        {data.employee_id ? (
          <Text style={styles.empIdCaption}>Employee ID: {data.employee_id}</Text>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {/* Month & Prescribed Hours */}
      <View style={styles.hoursBlock}>
        <Text style={styles.monthCoverText}>
          For the month of <Text style={styles.boldUnderline}>{MONTH_NAMES[selectedMonth - 1]}</Text>, 20
          <Text style={styles.boldUnderline}>{String(selectedYear).slice(-2)}</Text>
        </Text>

        <View style={styles.hoursSpecRow}>
          <Text style={styles.hoursSpecLabel}>
            Official hours of arrival{'\n'}and departure
          </Text>
          <View style={styles.hoursSpecBox}>
            <Text style={styles.hoursText}>
              Regular Days: <Text style={styles.underlineVal}>{data.regular_days_hours || '8:00 AM - 12:00 PM / 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM'}</Text>
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.hoursText}>
              Saturdays: <Text style={styles.underlineVal}>{data.saturdays_hours || 'As Required'}</Text>
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* 31-Day Grid Table */}
      <View style={styles.table}>
        <View style={styles.tableRowHeader}>
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colDay, { borderBottomWidth: 0 }]}>
            <Text style={styles.thBold}>Days</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colHalf, styles.borderLeft]}>
            <Text style={styles.thBold}>A. M.</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colHalf, styles.borderLeft]}>
            <Text style={styles.thBold}>P. M.</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colUt, styles.borderLeft]}>
            <Text style={styles.thBold}>UNDERTIME</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={[styles.tableRowHeader, { borderBottomWidth: 1.2 }]}>
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colDay]} />
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colTime, styles.borderLeft]}>
            <Text style={styles.thSmall}>ARRIVAL</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colTime, styles.borderLeft]}>
            <Text style={styles.thSmall}>DEPARTURE</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colTime, styles.borderLeft]}>
            <Text style={styles.thSmall}>ARRIVAL</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colTime, styles.borderLeft]}>
            <Text style={styles.thSmall}>DEPARTURE</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colUtPart, styles.borderLeft]}>
            <Text style={styles.thSmall}>Hours</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colUtPart, styles.borderLeft]}>
            <Text style={styles.thSmall}>Minutes</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {rows31.map((row) => {
          const isViolating = Boolean(row.is_loafing && !row.loafing_excused);
          const isWeekend = Boolean(row.is_weekend);

          return (
            <View
              key={String(row.day)}

                  ? { backgroundColor: '#fafafa' }

                        color: isViolating ? '#dc2626' : '#059669',
                      }}
                    >
                      {isViolating ? '!' : '✓'}
                    </Text>
                  ) : null}
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

              <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colTime, styles.borderLeft]}>
                <Text style={[styles.tdText, isViolating && styles.redText]}>
                  {row.am_arrival}
                </Text>
              </View>

              <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colTime, styles.borderLeft]}>
                <Text style={[styles.tdText, isViolating && styles.redText]}>
                  {row.am_departure}
                </Text>
              </View>

              <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colTime, styles.borderLeft]}>
                <Text style={[styles.tdText, isViolating && styles.redText]}>
                  {row.pm_arrival}
                </Text>
              </View>

              <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colTime, styles.borderLeft]}>
                <Text style={[styles.tdText, isViolating && styles.redText]}>
                  {row.pm_departure}
                </Text>
              </View>

              <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colUtPart, styles.borderLeft]}>
                <Text style={[styles.tdText, row.undertime_hours ? styles.redText : null]}>
                  {row.undertime_hours}
                </Text>
              </View>

              <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colUtPart, styles.borderLeft]}>
                <Text style={[styles.tdText, row.undertime_minutes ? styles.redText : null]}>
                  {row.undertime_minutes}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          );
        })}

        {/* Totals */}
        <View style={styles.totalRow}>
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colTotalSpan]}>

              {data.total_undertime_hours > 0 ? String(data.total_undertime_hours) : ''}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.cell, styles.colUtPart, styles.borderLeft]}>
            <Text style={styles.totalValText}>
              {data.total_undertime_minutes > 0 ? String(data.total_undertime_minutes) : ''}

      <View style={styles.sigBox}>
        <Text style={styles.sigName}>{data.faculty_name}</Text>
        <View style={styles.sigLine} />
        <Text style={styles.captionText}>(Signature of Faculty / Employee)</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.sigBox}>

      </View>

      <Text style={styles.backNote}>(See Instructions on back)</Text>

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  TouchableOpacity,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { DepEdReportHeader, DepEdReportFooter } from './DepEdReportHeaderFooter';

export interface Learner {
  id: number;
  lrn: string;
  name: string;
  sex: string;
  birthdate: string;
  age: number | string;
  birth_place?: string;
  mother_tongue: string;
  ethnic_group: string;
  religion: string;
  house_street: string;
  barangay: string;
  municipality_city: string;
  province: string;
  father_name: string;
  mother_maiden_name: string;
  guardian_name: string;
  guardian_relationship: string;
  parent_contact: string;
  remarks: string;
}

export interface SF1ReportViewProps {
  data: any;
  learners: Learner[];
}

export const SF1ReportView: React.FC<SF1ReportViewProps> = ({ data, learners }) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();

  if (!data) return null;

  const [groupingMode, setGroupingMode] = useState<'COMBINED' | 'SEPARATED'>('COMBINED');

  // Dynamic Adviser Resolution:
  // If the active logged-in employee is an assigned Faculty/Faculty, prioritize their verified name
  // to avoid showing placeholder/mock database seeds.
  const currentUser = user as Record<string, any> | null;
  const activeUserFullName =
    currentUser?.full_name ||
    `${currentUser?.first_name || ''} ${currentUser?.last_name || ''}`.trim() ||
    currentUser?.faculty_name ||
    currentUser?.username ||
    '';

  const userRole = String(
    currentUser?.role || currentUser?.system_role || 'EMPLOYEE'
  ).trim().toUpperCase();

  const isTeachingRole = ['FACULTY', 'FACULTY', 'EMPLOYEE'].includes(userRole);

  const resolvedAdviserName =
    (isTeachingRole && activeUserFullName.length > 0
      ? activeUserFullName
      : null) ||
    data.adviser_name ||
    activeUserFullName ||
    'Class Adviser';

  const resolvedSchoolHead = String(data.school_head || 'School Head').trim();

  // 1. Memoized Combined Learner List (Null-safe sorting)
  const sortedCombinedLearners = useMemo(() => {
    if (data.has_enrolled_students === false) return [];
    const raw: Learner[] = data.students || data.learners || learners || [];
    return [...raw].sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''));
  }, [data, learners]);

  // 2. Memoized Gender Breakdown (Single declaration to resolve TS2451)
  const { maleLearners, femaleLearners } = useMemo(() => {
    if (data.has_enrolled_students === false) {
      return { maleLearners: [], femaleLearners: [] };
    }
    const raw: Learner[] = data.students || data.learners || learners || [];
    const m = raw.filter((l: Learner) => l.sex === 'M' || l.sex === 'Male');
    const f = raw.filter((l: Learner) => l.sex === 'F' || l.sex === 'Female');
    return {
      maleLearners: [...m].sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '')),
      femaleLearners: [...f].sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '')),
    };
  }, [data, learners]);

  const maleCount = data.total_male ?? maleLearners.length;
  const femaleCount = data.total_female ?? femaleLearners.length;
  const totalCount = data.total_combined ?? (maleCount + femaleCount);

  const activeStudentList =
    groupingMode === 'COMBINED' ? sortedCombinedLearners : [...maleLearners, ...femaleLearners];
  const isListEmpty = activeStudentList.length === 0;

  // Sanitized guardian parser to prevent text overflow & injection
  const parseGuardian = (name: string, rel: string) => {
    const commonRel = ['MOTHER', 'FATHER', 'AUNT', 'UNCLE', 'GRANDMOTHER', 'GRANDFATHER', 'GUARDIAN'];
    const cleanName = (name || '').replace(/[\r\n\t]/g, ' ').trim();
    const cleanRel = (rel || '').replace(/[\r\n\t]/g, ' ').trim();
    if (commonRel.includes(cleanName.toUpperCase()) && !commonRel.includes(cleanRel.toUpperCase())) {
      return { gName: cleanRel, gRel: cleanName };
    }
    return { gName: cleanName, gRel: cleanRel.toLowerCase() === 'mather' ? 'Mother' : cleanRel };
  };

  const leftLogoUrl = data.left_logo || null;
  const rightLogoUrl = data.right_logo || null;

  return (
    <View style={styles.sheetContainer}>
      {/* Layout Mode Control Bar */}
      <View style={styles.controlBar}>
        <Text style={styles.controlLabel}>Class List Layout:</Text>
        <View style={styles.toggleRow}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.toggleBtn, groupingMode === 'COMBINED' && styles.toggleBtnActive]}
            onPress={() => setGroupingMode('COMBINED')}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name="people-outline"
              size={13}
              color={groupingMode === 'COMBINED' ? '#ffffff' : '#64748b'}
            />
            <Text
              style={[styles.toggleText, groupingMode === 'COMBINED' && styles.toggleTextActive]}
            >
              One List
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.toggleBtn, groupingMode === 'SEPARATED' && styles.toggleBtnActive]}
            onPress={() => setGroupingMode('SEPARATED')}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name="git-branch-outline"
              size={13}
              color={groupingMode === 'SEPARATED' ? '#ffffff' : '#64748b'}
            />
            <Text
              style={[styles.toggleText, groupingMode === 'SEPARATED' && styles.toggleTextActive]}
            >
              By Sex
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Full Sheet Document Horizontal Scroll (960px Canvas) */}
      <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={true}>
        <View style={styles.officialDocumentCanvas}>
          {/* ========================================================
              1. DYNAMIC DEPED DMOS HEADER (FROM DATABASE)
             ======================================================== */}
          <DepEdReportHeader
            leftLogoUrl={leftLogoUrl}
            rightLogoUrl={rightLogoUrl}
            region={data.region}
            division={data.division}
            formTitle="School Form 1 (SF 1) School Register"
            formSubtitle="(This replaces Form 1, Master List & STS Form 2)"
          />

          {/* ========================================================
              2. METADATA GRID (FROM DATABASE)
             ======================================================== */}
          <View style={styles.metaGrid}>
            <View style={styles.metaRow}>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>School ID: </Text>
                {data.school_id || '—'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>Region: </Text>
                {data.region || '—'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>Division: </Text>
                {data.division || '—'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>District: </Text>
                {data.district || '—'}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.metaRow}>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>School Name: </Text>
                {data.school_name || '—'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>School Year: </Text>
                {data.academic_year || '—'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>Grade Level: </Text>
                {data.grade_level || '—'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>Section: </Text>
                {data.section_name || '—'}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* ========================================================
              3. SF1 OFFICIAL TABLE
             ======================================================== */}
          <View style={styles.table}>
            <View style={styles.thRow}>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 32 }]}>#</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 95 }]}>LRN</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 170 }]}>
                LEARNER'S NAME{'\n'}(Last, First, Middle)
              </Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 38 }]}>SEX</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 75 }]}>BIRTH DATE</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 36 }]}>AGE</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 85 }]}>MOTHER TONGUE</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 75 }]}>IP GROUP</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 75 }]}>RELIGION</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 140 }]}>ADDRESS</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 120 }]}>FATHER'S NAME</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 120 }]}>MOTHER'S MAIDEN</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 110 }]}>GUARDIAN</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 90 }]}>CONTACT</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: 80 }]}>REMARKS</Text>
            </View>

            {isListEmpty ? (
              <View style={{ padding: 24, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#64748b' }}>
                  {data.notice || `No students enrolled in Section ${data.section_name || 'this class'}.`}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : groupingMode === 'COMBINED' ? (
              activeStudentList.map((learner: Learner, idx: number) => {

                );

                      ]}

                      {learner.name}

                    <Text style={[styles.td, { width: 38 }]}>{learner.sex}</Text>

              <>
                <View style={styles.genderHeader}>
