/**
 * AttendSure - Dynamic School Identity Badge (Theme-Adaptive & Zero Mock Data)
 * File: web/src/components/branding/SchoolTenantBadge.tsx
 */

import React, { memo, useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { School } from 'lucide-react';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl, sanitizeText } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { BRAND_ASSETS } from './BrandAssets';

export interface SchoolTenantBadgeProps {
  showDivision?: boolean;
  showSchoolId?: boolean;
  compact?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const formatDivisionText = (division?: string, region?: string): string => {
  const cleanDivision = sanitizeText(division || '', 80);
  if (cleanDivision) {
    return /division/i.test(cleanDivision) ? cleanDivision : `Division of ${cleanDivision}`;
  }
  return sanitizeText(region || '', 60);
};

export const SchoolTenantBadge: React.FC<SchoolTenantBadgeProps> = memo(
  ({
    showDivision = true,
    showSchoolId = false,
    compact = false,
    className,
    style,
  }) => {
    const { school, loading } = useSchool();
    const { mode, tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();

    const [sealFailed, setSealFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const [fallbackFailed, setFallbackFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);

    const safeSchoolLogo = useMemo(
      () => (isSafeImageUrl(school.school_logo) ? school.school_logo : null),
      [school.school_logo]
    );

    useEffect(() => {
      setSealFailed(false);
    }, [safeSchoolLogo]);

    const schoolName = useMemo(() => {
      const cleaned = sanitizeText(school.school_name || '', 120);
      if (cleaned) return cleaned;
      return loading ? 'Loading school...' : 'School Not Configured';
    }, [school.school_name, loading]);

    const divisionLabel = useMemo(
      () => (showDivision ? formatDivisionText(school.division, school.region) : ''),
      [showDivision, school.division, school.region]
    );

    const validSchoolId = useMemo(() => {
      if (!showSchoolId) return '';
      const rawId = sanitizeText(school.school_id || '', 20);
      return rawId && rawId !== '55555' && rawId !== '000000' ? rawId : '';
    }, [showSchoolId, school.school_id]);

    const activeImageSrc =
      safeSchoolLogo && !sealFailed
        ? safeSchoolLogo
        : !fallbackFailed
        ? BRAND_ASSETS.attendsureLogo
        : null;

    const sealBoxSize = compact ? 22 : 26;
    const sealImgSize = compact ? 16 : 20;

    return (
      <div
        className={className}
        title={
          divisionLabel
            ? `${schoolName} • ${divisionLabel}`
            : schoolName
        }
        style={{
          display: 'inline-flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: compact ? 8 : 10,
          padding: compact ? '4px 11px 4px 6px' : '5px 14px 5px 7px',
          maxWidth: '100%',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderWidth: mode === 'high-contrast' ? 1.5 : 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
          borderRadius: 9999,
          boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
          fontFamily: fonts.sans,
          userSelect: 'none',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
          transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
          ...style,
        }}
      >
        {/* Porcelain Seal Medallion keeps dark-ink logos crisp in Dark Mode */}
        <div
          style={{
            width: sealBoxSize,
            height: sealBoxSize,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderStyle: 'solid',
            borderColor: mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)' : '#e2e8f0',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          {activeImageSrc ? (
            <img
              src={activeImageSrc}
              alt={`${schoolName} Seal`}
              width={sealImgSize}
              height={sealImgSize}
              decoding="async"
              referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
              draggable={false}
              onError={() => {
                if (safeSchoolLogo && !sealFailed) {
                  setSealFailed(true);
                } else {
                  setFallbackFailed(true);
                }
              }}
              style={{
                width: sealImgSize,
                height: sealImgSize,
                objectFit: 'contain',
                display: 'block',
              }}
            />
          ) : (
            <School size={compact ? 13 : 15} color="#004b87" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
        </div>

        <span
          style={{
            fontSize: compact ? fonts.size.sm : fonts.size.base,
            fontWeight: 800,
            color: tokens.textPrimary,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            minWidth: 0,
          }}
        >
          {schoolName}
        </span>

        {validSchoolId && (
          <span
            style={{
              fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
              fontWeight: 700,
              fontFamily: fonts.mono,
              color: brand.primary,
              backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
              padding: '1px 7px',
              borderRadius: 9999,
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            ID: {validSchoolId}
          </span>
        )}

        {divisionLabel && (
          <span
            style={{
              fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
              fontWeight: 500,
              color: tokens.textSecondary,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              flexShrink: 1,
            }}
          >
            &bull; {divisionLabel}
          </span>

/**
 * AttendSure - Pure-Vector Theme-Adaptive Developer Signature Badge
 * File: web/src/components/branding/TechBlazerSignature.tsx
 */

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { sanitizeText } from '../../theme/tokens';

export interface TechBlazerSignatureProps {
  size?: number;
  textColor?: string;
  label?: string;
  layout?: 'stacked' | 'inline';
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const MIN_ICON_PX = 14;
const MAX_ICON_PX = 96;

const clampIconSize = (rawSize?: number): number => {
  const parsed = Number(rawSize);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return 20;
  return Math.min(MAX_ICON_PX, Math.max(MIN_ICON_PX, Math.round(parsed)));
};

const isSafeCssColor = (value?: string): boolean => {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = value.trim();
  return (
    /^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$/.test(clean) ||
    /^(rgb|rgba|hsl|hsla)\([0-9.,%\s/]+\)$/.test(clean) ||
    /^var\(--[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+(?:\s*,\s*#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8})?\)$/.test(clean)
  );
};

export const TechBlazerSignature: React.FC<TechBlazerSignatureProps> = memo(
  ({
    size = 20,
    textColor,
    label = 'from',
    layout = 'stacked',
    className = '',
    style,
  }) => {
    const { mode, tokens, fonts } = useTheme();

    const safeSize = clampIconSize(size);
    const tileSize = Math.round(safeSize * 1.35);
    const wordmarkFontPx = Math.max(11, Math.round(safeSize * 0.88));
    const safeLabel = sanitizeText(label, 24);
    const resolvedTextColor = isSafeCssColor(textColor) ? textColor!.trim() : tokens.textPrimary;

    const tileBorderColor =
      mode === 'dark'
        ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)'
        : mode === 'high-contrast'
        ? '#002b4d'
        : '#e2e8f0';

    return (
      <div
        className={className}
        aria-label={`${safeLabel ? `${safeLabel} ` : ''}TECHBLAZER`}
        style={{
          display: 'inline-flex',
          flexDirection: layout === 'inline' ? 'row' : 'column',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          gap: layout === 'inline' ? 7 : 4,
          userSelect: 'none',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
          ...style,
        }}
      >
        {safeLabel && (
          <span
            style={{
              fontFamily: fonts.sans,
              fontSize: '0.72rem',
              color: tokens.textMuted,
              letterSpacing: '0.04em',
              fontWeight: 600,
              textTransform: 'lowercase',
              lineHeight: 1.2,
            }}
          >
            {safeLabel}
          </span>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              width: `${tileSize}px`,
              height: `${tileSize}px`,
              borderRadius: Math.max(6, Math.round(tileSize * 0.26)),
              background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%)',
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderStyle: 'solid',
              borderColor: tileBorderColor,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              flexShrink: 0,
              boxSizing: 'border-box',
            }}
          >
            <svg
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              width={safeSize}
              height={safeSize}
              fill="none"
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              <path d="M4 5.5H20V9H13.8V19H10.2V9H4V5.5Z" fill="#004b87" />
              <path d="M15.2 12.5L20 19H15.8L12.8 14.8L15.2 12.5Z" fill="#0284c7" />
            </svg>
          </div>

          <span
            style={{
              fontFamily: fonts.display,

              transition: 'color 0.2s ease',

/**
 * AttendSure - Fault Isolation Error Boundary
 * File: frontend/src/components/common/ErrorBoundary.tsx
 *
 * Prevents sub-feature crashes (such as heavy DepEd report calculations,
 * canvas layout engines, or station monitors) from crashing the entire portal.
 */

import React, { Component } from 'react';
import type { ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, RefreshCw, Copy, Check, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  featureName?: string;
  fallback?: ReactNode | ((props: { error: Error; resetError: () => void }) => ReactNode);
  onReset?: () => void;
  onError?: (error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) => void;
  resetKeys?: any[];
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  errorInfo: ErrorInfo | null;
  copied: boolean;
  showDetails: boolean;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, State> {
  public state: State = {
    hasError: false,
    error: null,
    errorInfo: null,
    copied: false,
    showDetails: false,
  };

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): Partial<State> {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    this.setState({ errorInfo });
    this.props.onError?.(error, errorInfo);

    console.error(
      `[AttendSure Fault Isolation] Critical render failure in ${this.props.featureName || 'Component'}:`,
      error,
      errorInfo
    );
  }

  public componentDidUpdate(prevProps: ErrorBoundaryProps) {
    if (!this.state.hasError) return;

    // Automatically recover if any resetKey changed (e.g. user switched tabs, selected another section, or re-navigated)
    if (this.props.resetKeys && prevProps.resetKeys) {
      const hasChanged = this.props.resetKeys.some(
        (key, index) => key !== prevProps.resetKeys?.[index]
      );
      if (hasChanged) {
        this.handleReset();
      }
    }
  }

  private handleReset = () => {
    this.props.onReset?.();
    this.setState({
      hasError: false,
      error: null,
      errorInfo: null,
      copied: false,
      showDetails: false,
    });
  };

  private handleCopyDiagnostic = async () => {
    const errorText = [
      `Feature: ${this.props.featureName || 'Application Module'}`,
      `Time: ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
      `Error: ${this.state.error?.name}: ${this.state.error?.message}`,
      `Stack: ${this.state.error?.stack || 'No stack trace'}`,
      `Component Stack: ${this.state.errorInfo?.componentStack || 'No component stack'}`,
    ].join('\n');

    let success = false;
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(errorText);
        success = true;
      } catch {
        success = false;
      }
    }

    if (!success) {
      try {
        const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textArea.value = errorText;
        textArea.style.position = 'fixed';
        textArea.style.left = '-999999px';
        textArea.style.top = '-999999px';
        document.body.appendChild(textArea);
        textArea.focus();
        textArea.select();
        success = document.execCommand('copy');
        textArea.remove();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Copy fallback failed:', err);
      }
    }

    if (success) {
      this.setState({ copied: true });
      setTimeout(() => this.setState({ copied: false }), 2500);
    }
  };

  public render() {
    if (this.state.hasError && this.state.error) {
      if (typeof this.props.fallback === 'function') {
        return this.props.fallback({
          error: this.state.error,
          resetError: this.handleReset,
        });
      }

      if (this.props.fallback) {
        return this.props.fallback;
      }

      const featureTitle = this.props.featureName || 'Module';

      return (
        <div style={errorContainerStyle}>
          <div style={errorCardStyle}>
            <div style={iconBadgeStyle}>
              <AlertTriangle size={24} color="#dc2626" />
            </div>

            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', width: '100%' }}>
              <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 6px 0', fontSize: '1.05rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                {featureTitle} Temporarily Unavailable
              </h3>
              <p style={{ margin: '0 0 14px 0', fontSize: '0.80rem', color: '#64748b', lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
                An isolated issue occurred while rendering this feature. Other AttendSure tabs, gate monitors, and background tasks remain operational.
              </p>

              <div style={debugCodeStyle}>
                {this.state.error.message || String(this.state.error)}
              </div>

              {this.state.showDetails && (
                <div style={stackTraceContainerStyle}>
                  <pre style={stackTracePreStyle}>
                    {this.state.error.stack || 'No extended stack trace available.'}
                    {this.state.errorInfo?.componentStack || ''}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div style={actionsRowStyle}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={this.handleReset}
                style={primaryBtnStyle}
              >
                <RefreshCw size={14} />
                <span>Retry Feature</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={this.handleCopyDiagnostic}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                title="Copy technical diagnostic details to clipboard"
              >
                {this.state.copied ? <Check size={14} color="#059669" /> : <Copy size={14} />}
                <span>{this.state.copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy Log'}</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => this.setState((prev) => ({ showDetails: !prev.showDetails }))}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
              >
                <span>{this.state.showDetails ? 'Hide Stack' : 'Details'}</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                title="Perform a full page reload"
              >
                <RotateCcw size={14} />
                <span>Reload</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

export default ErrorBoundary;

/**
 * AttendSure - Universal Page Setup Modal
 * File: frontend/src/components/common/PageSetupModal.tsx
 *
 * Configures paper dimensions, margins, orientation, and layout format.
 * The official letterhead header is locked to Page 1 across all reports.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Check,
  RotateCw,
  FileText,
  Maximize2,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Palette,
  BookmarkCheck,
  Undo2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { PAPER_SIZES, MARGIN_PRESETS } from '../../types/pageSetup';
import type {
  PageSetupConfig,
  PaperSizeKey,
  PageOrientation,
  LayoutMode,
  MarginPresetKey,
} from '../../types/pageSetup';

interface PageSetupModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  currentConfig: PageSetupConfig;
  onLiveChange?: (config: PageSetupConfig) => void;
  onApply: (config: PageSetupConfig, setAsDefault: boolean) => void;
  reportTitle?: string;
}

const PRESET_COLORS = [
  { label: 'Standard White', value: '#ffffff' },
  { label: 'Soft Ivory', value: '#fdfbf7' },
  { label: 'Clean Slate', value: '#f8fafc' },
  { label: 'Document Cream', value: '#fffdf5' },
];

export const PageSetupModal: React.FC<PageSetupModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  currentConfig,
  onLiveChange,
  onApply,
  reportTitle = 'Report',
}) => {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<PageSetupConfig>({
    ...currentConfig,
    headerRepeat: 'first_page_only', // Enforce 1st page header rule
  });
  const [setAsDefault, setSetAsDefault] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const initialConfigRef = useRef<PageSetupConfig>(currentConfig);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setDraft({
        ...currentConfig,
        headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
      });
      initialConfigRef.current = currentConfig;
      setSetAsDefault(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, currentConfig]);

  const updateDraft = useCallback(
    (newDraft: PageSetupConfig) => {
      const standardizedDraft: PageSetupConfig = {
        ...newDraft,
        headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
      };
      setDraft(standardizedDraft);
      onLiveChange?.(standardizedDraft);
    },
    [onLiveChange]
  );

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    onLiveChange?.(initialConfigRef.current);
    onClose();
  }, [onLiveChange, onClose]);

  // Keyboard shortcut listener (Escape to cancel)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleCancel();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, handleCancel]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleOrientationChange = (orientation: PageOrientation) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, orientation });
  };

  const handleLayoutModeChange = (layoutMode: LayoutMode) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, layoutMode });
  };

  const handlePaperSizeChange = (paperSize: PaperSizeKey) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, paperSize });
  };

  const handlePageColorChange = (pageColor: string) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, pageColor });
  };

  const handleMarginPresetChange = (preset: MarginPresetKey) => {
    updateDraft({
      ...draft,
      marginPreset: preset,
      margins: { ...MARGIN_PRESETS[preset].margins },
    });
  };

  const handleCustomMarginChange = (side: keyof PageSetupConfig['margins'], val: number) => {
    updateDraft({
      ...draft,
      marginPreset: 'custom',
      margins: {
        ...draft.margins,
        [side]: Math.max(0, Number(val) || 0),
      },
    });
  };

  const handleResetToInitial = () => {
    updateDraft(initialConfigRef.current);
    setSetAsDefault(false);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    onApply(draft, setAsDefault);
    onClose();
  };

  const selectedPaper = PAPER_SIZES[draft.paperSize] || PAPER_SIZES.folio;
  const isLandscape = draft.orientation === 'landscape';
  const liveWidth = isLandscape ? selectedPaper.height : selectedPaper.width;
  const liveHeight = isLandscape ? selectedPaper.width : selectedPaper.height;

  return (
    <div
      style={overlayStyle}
      onClick={handleCancel}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="page-setup-modal-title"
    >
      <div style={modalContainerStyle} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        {/* Header */}
        <div style={modalHeaderStyle}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            <div style={iconBadgeStyle}>
              <SlidersHorizontal size={18} color="#0284c7" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 id="page-setup-modal-title" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                Page Setup
              </h2>
              <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                Configure document layout for {reportTitle}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleCancel}
            style={closeButtonStyle}
            aria-label="Close page setup modal"
            type="button"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div style={modalBodyStyle}>
          {/* 1. Layout Mode (Pages vs Pageless) */}
          <div style={sectionGroupStyle}>
            <label style={sectionLabelStyle}>Layout Format</label>
            <div style={buttonToggleGridStyle}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleLayoutModeChange('pages')}
                style={{
                  ...toggleCardStyle,
                  borderColor: draft.layoutMode === 'pages' ? '#0284c7' : '#cbd5e1',
                  backgroundColor: draft.layoutMode === 'pages' ? '#f0f9ff' : '#ffffff',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <FileText size={16} color={draft.layoutMode === 'pages' ? '#0284c7' : '#64748b'} />
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#0f172a' }}>Pages</span>
                </div>
                <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                  Divided sheets with Page 1 header, footers &amp; paper bounds.
                </p>
              </button>

              <button

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable Server Pagination Bar & Safe CSV Exporter
 * File: web/src/components/common/Pagination.tsx
 *
 * Cybersecurity & Stability Hardening:
 * 1. OWASP CSV Formula Injection Defense: Neutralizes cells starting with =, +, -, @, |, \t, \r.
 * 2. Asynchronous Memory Cleanup: Delays URL.revokeObjectURL by 1s to prevent premature download aborts.
 * 3. Strict Numeric Math: shields against NaN / divide-by-zero during rapid page size switching.
 * 4. WCAG Accessible Controls: Adds aria-label descriptors to all buttons and select inputs.
 */

import React, { useId } from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, ChevronsLeft, ChevronsRight } from 'lucide-react';

/** Safe upper ceiling representing "All" records without exhausting server RAM */
export const ALL_ROWS_SIZE = 10000;

export const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS: number[] = [
  25,
  50,
  100,
  250,
  500,
  1000,
  ALL_ROWS_SIZE,
];

/**
 * Cybersecurity Helper: Sanitizes cell values to prevent CSV Formula / DDE Injection
 * in Microsoft Excel, LibreOffice, and Google Sheets.
 * Blocks: =, +, -, @, |, \t, \r
 */
export const sanitizeCsvCell = (val: string | number | boolean | undefined | null): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '""';
  
  // Escape internal double quotes by doubling them per RFC 4180
  const clean = String(val).replace(/"/g, '""').trim();
  
  // Neutralize formula trigger characters with a leading single quote
  if (/^[=+\-@\t\r|]/.test(clean)) {
    return `"'${clean}"`;
  }
  
  return `"${clean}"`;
};

/**
 * Reusable CSV Downloader for any table module.
 * Embeds UTF-8 BOM (\uFEFF) for proper display of special characters in Excel.
 */
export const exportToCsv = (
  filename: string,
  headers: string[],
  rows: (string | number | boolean | undefined | null)[][]
): boolean => {
  if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return false;

  const csvLines = [
    headers.map((h) => sanitizeCsvCell(h)).join(','),
    ...rows.map((row) => row.map((cell) => sanitizeCsvCell(cell)).join(',')),
  ];

  // UTF-8 BOM prefix ensures correct rendering in Excel
  const csvContent = '\uFEFF' + csvLines.join('\r\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv') ? filename : `${filename}.csv`;
  link.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);

  // Defer revocation by 1 second to ensure browser has completed file stream
  setTimeout(() => {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 1000);

  return true;
};

export interface PaginationProps {
  currentPage: number;
  totalPages: number;
  totalCount: number;
  pageSize: number;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
  onPageSizeChange?: (size: number) => void;
  pageSizeOptions?: number[];
  itemLabel?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

export const Pagination: React.FC<PaginationProps> = ({
  currentPage,
  totalPages,
  totalCount,
  pageSize,
  onPageChange,
  onPageSizeChange,
  pageSizeOptions = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS,
  itemLabel = 'records',
  disabled = false,
  className,
  style,
}) => {
  const selectId = useId();

  if (totalCount <= 0) return null;

  // Defensive Numeric shields
  const safePageSize = Math.max(1, Number(pageSize) || 25);
  const isAllSelected = safePageSize >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE;
  const safeTotalPages = isAllSelected ? 1 : Math.max(1, Number(totalPages) || 1);
  const safeCurrentPage = isAllSelected
    ? 1
    : Math.min(Math.max(1, Number(currentPage) || 1), safeTotalPages);

  const startRecord = isAllSelected ? 1 : (safeCurrentPage - 1) * safePageSize + 1;
  const endRecord = isAllSelected ? totalCount : Math.min(safeCurrentPage * safePageSize, totalCount);

  const isPrevDisabled = disabled || isAllSelected || safeCurrentPage <= 1;
  const isNextDisabled = disabled || isAllSelected || safeCurrentPage >= safeTotalPages;

  return (
    <div className={className} style={{ ...containerStyle, ...style }} role="navigation" aria-label="Pagination Navigation">
      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', color: '#475569' }}>
        Showing <strong>{startRecord.toLocaleString()}</strong> to <strong>{endRecord.toLocaleString()}</strong> of{' '}
        <strong>{totalCount.toLocaleString()}</strong> {itemLabel}
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        {onPageSizeChange && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginRight: 8 }}>
            <label htmlFor={selectId} style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
              Rows per page:
            </label>
            <select
              id={selectId}
              value={safePageSize}
              disabled={disabled}
              aria-label="Rows per page selector"
              onChange={(e) => {
                const nextSize = Number(e.target.value);
                if (!isNaN(nextSize) && nextSize > 0) {
                  onPageSizeChange(nextSize);
                }
              }}
              style={{
                ...selectStyle,
                opacity: disabled ? 0.6 : 1,
                cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              {pageSizeOptions.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt} value={opt}>
                  {opt >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE ? 'All' : opt}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* First Page */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange(1)}
          disabled={isPrevDisabled}
          aria-label="Go to first page"
          title="First Page"
          style={{
            ...btnStyle,
            opacity: isPrevDisabled ? 0.35 : 1,
            cursor: isPrevDisabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
          }}
        >
          <ChevronsLeft size={16} />
        </button>

        {/* Previous Page */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange(safeCurrentPage - 1)}
          disabled={isPrevDisabled}
          aria-label="Go to previous page"
          title="Previous Page"
          style={{
            ...btnStyle,
            opacity: isPrevDisabled ? 0.35 : 1,
            cursor: isPrevDisabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
          }}
        >
          <ChevronLeft size={16} />
        </button>

        {/* Page Position Indicator */}
        <span
          style={{
            fontSize: '0.80rem',
            fontWeight: 600,
            padding: '0 8px',
            color: '#0f172a',
            userSelect: 'none',
          }}
        >
          Page {safeCurrentPage} of {safeTotalPages}
        </span>

        {/* Next Page */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange(safeCurrentPage + 1)}
          disabled={isNextDisabled}
          aria-label="Go to next page"
          title="Next Page"
          style={{
            ...btnStyle,
            opacity: isNextDisabled ? 0.35 : 1,
            cursor: isNextDisabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
          }}
        >
          <ChevronRight size={16} />
        </button>

        {/* Last Page */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange(safeTotalPages)}
          disabled={isNextDisabled}
          aria-label="Go to last page"
          title="Last Page"
          style={{
            ...btnStyle,
            opacity: isNextDisabled ? 0.35 : 1,
            cursor: isNextDisabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
          }}
        >
          <ChevronsRight size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Pagination;

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable User & Faculty Avatar
 * Replaces duplicate implementations across FacultyTab, AttendanceLogsTab, DTRTab, and MyAssignedClassesTab.
 * File: web/src/components/common/ProfileAvatar.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { User } from 'lucide-react';

interface ProfileAvatarProps {
  photoUrl?: string | null;
  name?: string;
  size?: number;
  iconSize?: number;
}

export const ProfileAvatar: React.FC<ProfileAvatarProps> = ({
  photoUrl,
  name = 'Member',
  size = 38,
  iconSize = 19,
}) => {
  const [imageFailed, setImageFailed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setImageFailed(false);
  }, [photoUrl]);

  const hasPhoto = Boolean(
    photoUrl &&
      typeof photoUrl === 'string' &&
      photoUrl.trim() !== '' &&
      photoUrl.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'null' &&
      photoUrl.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'undefined'
  );

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: '50%',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-subtle, #f1f5f9)',
        border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e2e8f0)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
      title={name}
    >
      {hasPhoto && !imageFailed ? (
        <img
          src={photoUrl!}
          alt={name}
          style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
          onError={() => setImageFailed(true)}
        />
      ) : (
        <User size={iconSize} color="var(--text-muted, #94a3b8)" />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ProfileAvatar;

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable Status Badge
 * Replaces hardcoded status pills for Attendance, Direction, and Account states.
 * File: web/src/components/common/StatusBadge.tsx
 */

import React from 'react';
import { LogIn, LogOut, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

interface StatusBadgeProps {
  status: string;
  type?: 'DIRECTION' | 'ATTENDANCE' | 'ACTIVE' | 'GENERIC';
}

export const StatusBadge: React.FC<StatusBadgeProps> = ({ status, type = 'GENERIC' }) => {
  const s = String(status || '').toUpperCase();

  let bg = 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.12)';
  let text = 'var(--text-secondary, #64748b)';
  let border = 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.25)';
  let icon: React.ReactNode = null;

  if (type === 'DIRECTION' || s === 'IN' || s === 'OUT') {
    if (s === 'IN') {
      bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-success, #10B981)';
      border = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28)';
      icon = <LogIn size={11} />;
    } else {
      bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-danger, #EF4444)';
      border = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28)';
      icon = <LogOut size={11} />;
    }
  } else if (type === 'ACTIVE' || s === 'ACTIVE' || s === 'INACTIVE') {
    if (s === 'ACTIVE') {
      bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-success, #10B981)';
      border = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28)';
      icon = <CheckCircle2 size={11} />;
    } else {
      bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-danger, #EF4444)';
      border = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28)';
      icon = <XCircle size={11} />;
    }
  } else if (type === 'ATTENDANCE' || ['PRESENT', 'LATE', 'ABSENT', 'CUTTING'].includes(s)) {
    if (s === 'PRESENT') {
      bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-success, #10B981)';
      border = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28)';
    } else if (s === 'LATE' || s === 'TARDY') {
      bg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-warning, #F59E0B)';
      border = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.28)';
      icon = <Clock size={11} />;
    } else {
      bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-danger, #EF4444)';
      border = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28)';
      icon = <AlertTriangle size={11} />;
    }
  }

  return (
    <span
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 4,
        padding: '3px 8px',
        borderRadius: 6,
        fontSize: '0.68rem',
        fontWeight: 800,
        backgroundColor: bg,
        color: text,
        border: `1px solid ${border}`,
        letterSpacing: '0.2px',
      }}
    >
      {icon}
      <span>{s}</span>
    </span>
  );
};

export default StatusBadge;

/**
 * AttendSure - Instant-Hydrating School Dashboard
 * File: web/src/components/dashboard/DashboardView.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache, subscribeApiCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { StatsCard } from '../common/StatsCard';
import {
  UserCheck,
  UserX,
  Clock,
  Radio,
  RefreshCw,
  Scan,
  TrendingUp,
  Inbox,
  Database,
  Ticket,
  CalendarCheck,
  Send,
  Users,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Bell,
  Sparkles,
  QrCode,
  BookOpen,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface DashboardViewProps {
  isServerOnline?: boolean;
  userRole?: string;
  onStatusChange?: (online: boolean) => void;
  onManualRefresh?: () => void;
  onNavigateTab?: (tab: string, report?: string) => void;
}

interface HourlyBar {
  hour: string;
  count: number;
  height: number;
  is_peak: boolean;
}

interface RecentScanItem {
  person_name: string;
  grade_section: string;
  scan_time: string;
}

interface NoticeItem {
  id: number | string;
  title: string;
  details: string;
}

interface DashboardState {
  total_students: number;
  students_present: number;
  students_absent: number;
  attendance_rate: number;
  faculty_on_duty: number;
  total_faculty: number;
  classroom_scans_today: number;
  active_exit_passes: number;
  push_alerts_today: number;
  mobile_parents_connected: number;
  hourly_scans: HourlyBar[];
  recent_scans: RecentScanItem[];
  notices: NoticeItem[];
}

const EMPTY_DASHBOARD: DashboardState = {
  total_students: 0,
  students_present: 0,
  students_absent: 0,
  attendance_rate: 0,
  faculty_on_duty: 0,
  total_faculty: 0,
  classroom_scans_today: 0,
  active_exit_passes: 0,
  push_alerts_today: 0,
  mobile_parents_connected: 0,
  hourly_scans: [],
  recent_scans: [],
  notices: [],
};

const normalizeDashboardPayload = (d: Record<string, any> | undefined): DashboardState => {
  if (!d) return EMPTY_DASHBOARD;
  const total = Number(d.total_students) || 0;
  const present = Number(d.students_present) || 0;
  const rawHourly = Array.isArray(d.hourly_scans) ? d.hourly_scans : [];
  const maxCount = Math.max(...rawHourly.map((h: any) => Number(h.count) || 0), 1);

  return {
    total_students: total,
    students_present: present,
    students_absent: Number(d.students_absent) || Math.max(0, total - present),
    attendance_rate: total > 0 ? Math.round((present / total) * 100) : Number(d.attendance_rate) || 0,
    faculty_on_duty: Number(d.faculty_on_duty) || 0,
    total_faculty: Number(d.total_faculty) || 0,
    classroom_scans_today: Number(d.classroom_scans_today ?? d.gate_scans_today) || 0,
    active_exit_passes: Number(d.active_exit_passes ?? d.active_gate_passes) || 0,
    push_alerts_today: Number(d.push_alerts_today ?? d.push_sent_today) || 0,
    mobile_parents_connected: Number(d.mobile_parents_connected) || 0,
    hourly_scans: rawHourly.map((h: any) => {
      const c = Number(h.count) || 0;
      return {
        hour: String(h.hour || ''),
        count: c,
        height: c > 0 ? Math.round((c / maxCount) * 100) : 0,
        is_peak: Boolean(h.is_peak),
      };
    }),
    recent_scans: Array.isArray(d.recent_scans) ? d.recent_scans : [],
    notices: Array.isArray(d.notices) ? d.notices : [],
  };
};

export const DashboardView: React.FC<DashboardViewProps> = ({
  isServerOnline = true,
  userRole,
  onStatusChange,
  onManualRefresh,
  onNavigateTab,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();

  const warmPayload = useMemo(
    () => peekApiCache<Record<string, any>>(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard),
    []
  );

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => warmPayload === undefined);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastSyncTime, setLastSyncTime] = useState<string>(() =>
    warmPayload ? new Date().toLocaleTimeString() : ''
  );
  const [fetchFailed, setFetchFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [calendarDate, setCalendarDate] = useState<Date>(() => new Date());
  const [data, setData] = useState<DashboardState>(() =>
    normalizeDashboardPayload(warmPayload)
  );

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const role = (userRole || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const isAdmin = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(role);
  const isFaculty = role === 'FACULTY';
  const isOnline = isServerOnline && !fetchFailed;

  useEffect(() => {
    return subscribeApiCache(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard, undefined, (freshRaw) => {
      setData(normalizeDashboardPayload(freshRaw as Record<string, any>));
      setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  const navigateTo = (tab: string, report?: string) => {
    onNavigateTab?.(tab, report);
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendsure:navigate', { detail: report ? { tab, report } : tab }));
  };

  const fetchDashboardData = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      try {
        if (!silent) setRefreshing(true);
        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard, {
          params: {
            silent: silent ? '1' : undefined,
            ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        if (res.data) {
          setFetchFailed(false);
          setData(normalizeDashboardPayload(res.data));
          setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
          onStatusChange?.(true);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (anyErr?.name !== 'CanceledError' && anyErr?.code !== 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          setFetchFailed(true);
          onStatusChange?.(false);
        }
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [onStatusChange]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchDashboardData(warmPayload !== undefined, false);
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void fetchDashboardData(true, true);
      }
    }, 20000);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchDashboardData, warmPayload]);

  const calendarDays = useMemo(() => {
    const y = calendarDate.getFullYear();
    const m = calendarDate.getMonth();
    const firstDay = new Date(y, m, 1).getDay();
    const totalDays = new Date(y, m + 1, 0).getDate();
    const now = new Date();
    return [
      ...Array.from({ length: firstDay }, () => ({ day: null as number | null, isToday: false })),
      ...Array.from({ length: totalDays }, (_, i) => ({
        day: i + 1,
        isToday: now.getFullYear() === y && now.getMonth() === m && now.getDate() === i + 1,
      })),
    ];
  }, [calendarDate]);

  const quickActions = [
    { label: 'QR Scanner', desc: 'Scan student QR ID card', icon: <QrCode size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('classroom-scanner') },
    { label: isFaculty ? 'Student Exit Permit' : 'Exit Passes', desc: 'Student exit & teacher travel', icon: <Ticket size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('gate-passes') },
    { label: 'Daily Attendance (SF2)', desc: 'Official DepEd register', icon: <CalendarCheck size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('reports', 'sf2') },
    { label: 'Monthly DTR', desc: 'CSC Form 48 work hours', icon: <Clock size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('dtr') },
    { label: isFaculty ? 'My Classes' : 'Student Lists', desc: 'Enrolled students by section', icon: isFaculty ? <BookOpen size={19} /> : <Users size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo(isFaculty ? 'my-classes' : 'students') },
    ...(isAdmin ? [{ label: 'Push Alerts', desc: 'Send mobile alerts to parents', icon: <Send size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('push') }] : []),
  ];

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
        <RefreshCw size={22} className="animate-spin" style={{ margin: '0 auto 8px', display: 'block', color: brand.primary }} />
        <span>Loading dashboard...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ height: '100%', overflowY: 'auto', backgroundColor: tokens.bgCanvas, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
      <div style={{ maxWidth: 1380, margin: '0 auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
        <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: '10px 16px', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <span style={ui.badge(isOnline ? tokens.successLight : tokens.dangerLight, isOnline ? brand.success : brand.danger)}>
              ● {isOnline ? 'ONLINE' : 'OFFLINE'}
            </span>
            {isAdmin && (
              <>
                <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5 }}>
                  <Database size={13} color={brand.primary} /> Database: {isOnline ? 'Connected' : 'Offline'}
                </span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5 }}>
                  <Radio size={13} color={brand.primary} /> Push Alerts Today: {data.push_alerts_today.toLocaleString()} &bull; Parents Linked: {data.mobile_parents_connected.toLocaleString()}
                </span>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            {lastSyncTime && <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>Updated: {lastSyncTime}</span>}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                void fetchDashboardData(false, true);
                onManualRefresh?.();
              }}
              disabled={refreshing}
              style={ui.btnSecondary}
            >
              <RefreshCw size={13} className={refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''} /> {refreshing ? 'Updating...' : 'Refresh'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(210px, 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
          <StatsCard
            label="STUDENTS IN CLASS"
            value={isOnline ? data.students_present.toLocaleString() : '—'}
            helpText={`${data.attendance_rate}% of ${data.total_students.toLocaleString()} students`}
            badge={<UserCheck size={18} color={brand.success} />}
          />
          <StatsCard
            label="NOT SCANNED TODAY"
            value={isOnline ? data.students_absent.toLocaleString() : '—'}
            valueColor={data.students_absent > 0 ? brand.danger : tokens.textPrimary}
            helpText="No classroom scan yet today"
            badge={<UserX size={18} color={brand.danger} />}
          />
          <StatsCard
            label="TEACHERS ON CAMPUS"
            value={isOnline ? `${data.faculty_on_duty}/${data.total_faculty}` : '—'}
            helpText="Verified via mobile GPS check-in"
            badge={<Clock size={18} color={brand.success} />}
          />
          <StatsCard
            label="CLASSROOM QR SCANS"
            value={isOnline ? data.classroom_scans_today.toLocaleString() : '—'}
            helpText={`${data.active_exit_passes} Active Exit Passes`}
            badge={<Scan size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
          />
        </div>

        <div style={ui.card}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
            <Sparkles size={15} color={brand.primary} />
            <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Quick Actions</h3>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(185px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
            {quickActions.map((act) => (
              <button
                key={act.label}
                type="button"
                onClick={act.onClick}
                style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'left' }}
              >
                <div style={{ width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 8, backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, color: brand.primary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                  {act.icon}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{act.label}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted }}>{act.desc}</div>
                </div>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(310px, 1fr))', gap: 14 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <div style={ui.card}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 12 }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Classroom Scans by Hour</h3>
                <span style={ui.badge(tokens.primaryLight, brand.primary)}><TrendingUp size={12} /> Today</span>
              </div>
              {data.hourly_scans.some((h) => h.count > 0) ? (
                <div style={{ height: 150, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 8 }}>
                  {data.hourly_scans.map((item, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', height: '100%', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textMuted }}>{item.count || ''}</span>
                      <div style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 26, height: `${item.height}%`, backgroundColor: item.is_peak ? brand.primary : brand.secondary, borderRadius: '4px 4px 0 0' }} />
                      <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>{item.hour}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                  <Inbox size={22} style={{ margin: '0 auto 4px', display: 'block' }} /> No classroom scans recorded today
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div style={ui.card}>
              <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 10px', fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Recent Classroom QR Scans</h3>
              {data.recent_scans.length > 0 ? (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
                  {data.recent_scans.slice(0, 5).map((s, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                      <div>
                        <strong style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{s.person_name}</strong>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted }}>{s.grade_section}</div>
                      </div>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{s.scan_time}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div style={{ padding: 20, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>No scans recorded yet</div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <div style={ui.card}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 10 }}>
                <strong style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {calendarDate.toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}
                </strong>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setCalendarDate(new Date(calendarDate.getFullYear(), calendarDate.getMonth() - 1, 1))} style={ui.btnSecondary}><ChevronLeft size={13} /></button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setCalendarDate(new Date())} style={ui.btnSecondary}>Today</button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setCalendarDate(new Date(calendarDate.getFullYear(), calendarDate.getMonth() + 1, 1))} style={ui.btnSecondary}><ChevronRight size={13} /></button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(7, 1fr)', textAlign: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                {['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'].map((d) => (
                  <span key={d} style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted }}>{d}</span>
                ))}
                {calendarDays.map((item, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} style={{ height: 28, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: item.isToday ? 800 : 500, backgroundColor: item.isToday ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent', color: item.isToday ? '#fff' : tokens.textPrimary }}>
                    {item.day || ''}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={ui.card}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
                <Bell size={15} color={brand.primary} />
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>School Bulletin</h3>
              </div>
              {data.notices.length === 0 ? (
                <div style={{ padding: 18, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: fonts.size.sm }}>No announcements posted</div>
              ) : (
                data.notices.map((n) => (
                  <div key={n.id} style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{n.title}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{n.details}</div>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DashboardView;

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  Award,
  CheckCircle2,
  Download,
  Globe,
  Leaf,
  RefreshCw,
  ShieldAlert,
  ShieldCheck,
  Smartphone,
  Users,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { useApiResource } from '../../hooks/useApiResource';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

interface EmergencyStudent {
  student_id: number;
  lrn: string;
  full_name: string;
  section: string;
  parent_contact: string;
}

interface EmergencyFaculty {
  faculty_id: number;
  employee_id: string;
  full_name: string;
  department: string;
}

interface EmergencyRollCallData {
  timestamp: string;
  total_people_on_campus: number;
  students_count: number;
  faculty_count: number;
  students: EmergencyStudent[];
  faculty: EmergencyFaculty[];
}

export const EnterpriseSDGWidget: React.FC = () => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { data: sdgData, loading: loadingSdg, reload: reloadSdg } = useApiResource<any>('/v1/reports/sdg-impact/', null);
  const { data: sardoData, loading: loadingSardo, reload: reloadSardo } = useApiResource<any>('/v1/reports/dropout-risk/', null);

  const [showAtRiskList, setShowAtRiskList] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [rollCallOpen, setRollCallOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [rollCallLoading, setRollCallLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [rollCallData, setRollCallData] = useState<EmergencyRollCallData | null>(null);
  const [rollCallSearch, setRollCallSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [safeStudentIds, setSafeStudentIds] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});
  const [exportingEdFi, setExportingEdFi] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const loading = loadingSdg || loadingSardo;

  const handleRefresh = () => {
    reloadSdg(false);
    reloadSardo(false);
  };

  const handleOpenEmergencyRollCall = async () => {
    setRollCallOpen(true);
    setRollCallLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get('/v1/campus/roll-call/');
      setRollCallData(res.data);
    } catch {
      setRollCallData(null);
    } finally {
      setRollCallLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleStudentSafe = (studentId: number) => {
    setSafeStudentIds((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [studentId]: !prev[studentId],
    }));
  };

  const handleExportEdFi = async () => {
    setExportingEdFi(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get('/enterprise/edfi-export/');
      const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(res.data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `attendsure_edfi_v6_export_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setExportingEdFi(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredRollCallStudents = useMemo(() => {

    const q = rollCallSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return list;
    return list.filter(

  const sdg16 = sdgData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_16_accountable_institutions;
  const atRiskStudents = Array.isArray(sardoData?.at_risk_students) ? sardoData.at_risk_students : [];

        </div>

        {atRiskStudents.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ ...healthyBannerStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.successLight, color: brand.success }}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={16} color={brand.success} />
            <span>
              Zero students are currently at risk of dropping out over the last 30 days. All class lists have healthy attendance.
            </span>
          </div>
        ) : (
          showAtRiskList && (
            <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto', marginTop: 10 }}>
              <table style={{ ...tableStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                    <th style={{ ...thStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>Learner Name &amp; LRN</th>
                    <th style={{ ...thStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>Grade &amp; Section</th>
                    <th style={{ ...thStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>30-Day Attendance</th>
                    <th style={{ ...thStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>Risk Level</th>
                    <th style={{ ...thStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>Recommended Action</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {atRiskStudents.slice(0, 10).map((st: any) => {
                    const isCritical = st.risk_level === 'CRITICAL_SARDO';
                    return (
                      <tr key={st.student_id} style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                        <td style={tdStyle}>
                          <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{st.full_name}</div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                            LRN: {st.lrn} {st.is_4ps_beneficiary ? '• 4Ps Beneficiary' : ''}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ ...tdStyle, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{st.section}</td>
                        <td style={tdStyle}>
                          <span style={{ color: brand.danger, fontWeight: 700 }}>{st.absent_days_30d} Absent</span>
                          {' • '}
                          <span style={{ color: brand.warning, fontWeight: 700 }}>{st.cutting_days_30d} Cutting</span>
                          {' • '}
                          <span style={{ color: tokens.textMuted }}>{st.late_days_30d} Late</span>
                        </td>
                        <td style={tdStyle}>
                          <span
                            style={{
                              padding: '3px 8px',
                              borderRadius: 10,
                              fontSize: '0.68rem',
                              fontWeight: 800,
                              backgroundColor: isCritical ? tokens.dangerLight : tokens.warningLight,
                              color: isCritical ? brand.danger : brand.warning,
                              border: `1px solid ${isCritical ? brand.danger : brand.warning}`,
                            }}
                          >
                            {isCritical ? 'CRITICAL SARDO' : 'EARLY WARNING'} ({st.risk_score}%)
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ ...tdStyle, fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                          {st.recommended_intervention}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Compact Top Application Header
 * File: web/src/components/layout/Header.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES } from '../../api/routes';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl, type ThemeMode } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { ControlSwitch } from '../ui/ControlSwitch';
import StudentIdPassModal from '../modals/StudentIdPassModal';
import {
  Bell,
  ChevronDown,
  LogOut,
  User,
  CheckCircle2,
  X,
  Activity,
  QrCode,
  Inbox,
  Sun,
  Moon,
  Eye,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { UserSession } from '../../types/section';
import type { NavItemKey } from './Sidebar';

export interface TabBadgeCounts {
  [key: string]: number | undefined;
}

export function formatBadgeCount(count?: number | null): string {
  if (!count || count <= 0) return '';
  return count > 999 ? `${(count / 1000).toFixed(1)}k` : String(count);
}

export interface HeaderProps {
  title?: string;
  currentTitle?: string;
  activeTab?: string;
  onTabChange?: (tab: string) => void;
  isSystemOnline?: boolean;
  session?: UserSession | null;
  userPhoto?: string | null;
  schoolName?: string;
  schoolId?: string;
  schoolLogo?: string | null;
  onLogout?: () => void;
  onNavigateTab?: (tab: NavItemKey) => void;
  onOpenProfile?: () => void;
}

interface AlertNotice {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  message: string;
}

export const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({
  title,
  currentTitle = 'Dashboard',
  isSystemOnline = true,
  session,
  userPhoto,
  schoolName,
  schoolId,
  onLogout,
  onOpenProfile,
}) => {
  const { school } = useSchool();
  const { mode, setThemeMode, tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();

  const [systemOnline, setSystemOnline] = useState<boolean>(isSystemOnline);
  const [dropdownOpen, setDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const [notifOpen, setNotifOpen] = useState(false);
  const [unreadAlerts, setUnreadAlerts] = useState<AlertNotice[]>([]);
  const [isDigitalPassOpen, setIsDigitalPassOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSystemOnline(isSystemOnline);
  }, [isSystemOnline]);

  const pollAlerts = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!session?.token || document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return;
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications, { params: { page_size: 10 } });
      const raw = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];
      const unread = raw
        .filter((item: { is_read?: boolean }) => !item.is_read)
        .map((item: { id: number; title: string; message: string }) => ({
          id: item.id,
          title: item.title,
          message: item.message,
        }));
      setUnreadAlerts(unread);
      setSystemOnline(true);
    } catch {
      // Quiet background poll
    }
  }, [session?.token]);

  useEffect(() => {
    pollAlerts();
    const timer = setInterval(pollAlerts, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [pollAlerts]);

  const markAllAlertsRead = async () => {
    await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.messaging.markRead, {}).catch(() => {});
    setUnreadAlerts([]);
  };

  const handleLogout = () => {
    if (onLogout) {
      onLogout();
      return;
    }
    localStorage.clear();
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendsure:auth-expired'));
  };

  const activeSchoolName = schoolName || school.school_name || 'School Campus';
  const activeSchoolId = schoolId || school.school_id || '—';
  const displayName = session?.faculty_name || session?.username || 'Account';
  const displayRole = (session?.role || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const resolvedPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(userPhoto) ? userPhoto : null;

  const themeOptions: { value: ThemeMode; title: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[] = [
    { value: 'light', title: 'Light Mode', icon: <Sun size={13} /> },
    { value: 'dark', title: 'Dark Mode', icon: <Moon size={13} /> },
    { value: 'high-contrast', title: 'High-Contrast Mode', icon: <Eye size={13} /> },
  ];

  return (
    <header
      style={{
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        borderBottomWidth: 1,
        borderBottomStyle: 'solid',
        borderBottomColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
        padding: '7px 16px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        flexWrap: 'wrap',
        gap: 10,
        minHeight: 52,
        zIndex: 40,
      }}
    >
      <div>
        <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
          {title || currentTitle}
        </h1>
        <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
          {activeSchoolName} &bull; School ID: {activeSchoolId}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8 }}>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsDigitalPassOpen(true)}
          style={{
            ...ui.badge(tokens.primaryLight, brand.primary),
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderStyle: 'solid',
            borderColor: brand.primary,
            padding: '5px 10px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
          }}
        >
          <QrCode size={12} /> My Pass
        </button>

        <div style={ui.badge(systemOnline ? tokens.successLight : tokens.dangerLight, systemOnline ? brand.success : brand.danger)}>
          <Activity size={11} /> {systemOnline ? 'Online' : 'Offline'}
        </div>

        <ControlSwitch
          options={themeOptions}
          value={mode}
          onChange={setThemeMode}
          compactIconsOnly
          ariaLabel="Theme Mode"
        />

        <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setNotifOpen(!notifOpen)}
            aria-label="Notifications"
            style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, padding: 6, position: 'relative' }}
          >
            <Bell size={14} />
            {unreadAlerts.length > 0 && (
              <span
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: -4,
                  right: -4,
                  backgroundColor: brand.danger,
                  color: '#fff',
                  fontSize: '0.58rem',
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  borderRadius: 9999,
                  padding: '1px 5px',
                }}
              >
                {formatBadgeCount(unreadAlerts.length)}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>

          {notifOpen && (
            <div style={{ ...ui.card, position: 'absolute', top: 'calc(100% + 8px)', right: 0, width: 280, zIndex: 1000 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 }}>
                <strong style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Unread Alerts</strong>
                {unreadAlerts.length > 0 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={markAllAlertsRead}
                    style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, fontSize: fonts.size.xs, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 size={11} /> Mark all read
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {unreadAlerts.length === 0 ? (
                <div style={{ padding: 14, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: fonts.size.sm }}>
                  <Inbox size={18} style={{ margin: '0 auto 4px', display: 'block' }} /> No unread alerts
                </div>
              ) : (
                unreadAlerts.slice(0, 6).map((n) => (
                  <div key={n.id} style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 8, marginBottom: 6 }}>
                    <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{n.title}</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{n.message}</div>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setUnreadAlerts((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== n.id))}
                      style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: tokens.textMuted, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                    >
                      <X size={12} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setDropdownOpen(!dropdownOpen)}
            style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer' }}
          >
            <div
              style={{
                width: 30,
                height: 30,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderStyle: 'solid',
                borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
              }}
            >
              {resolvedPhoto ? (
                <img src={resolvedPhoto} alt={displayName} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
              ) : (
                <User size={14} color={brand.primary} />
              )}
            </div>
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{displayName}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.62rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>{displayRole}</div>
            </div>
            <ChevronDown size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} />
          </button>

          {dropdownOpen && (
            <div style={{ ...ui.card, position: 'absolute', top: 'calc(100% + 8px)', right: 0, width: 180, padding: 8, zIndex: 1000 }}>
              {onOpenProfile && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setDropdownOpen(false);
                    onOpenProfile();
                  }}
                  style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, width: '100%', borderStyle: 'none', marginBottom: 4 }}
                >
                  <User size={14} /> My Profile
                </button>
              )}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleLogout}
                style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, width: '100%', borderStyle: 'none', color: brand.danger }}
              >
                <LogOut size={14} /> Sign Out
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {isDigitalPassOpen && (
        <StudentIdPassModal
          student={{
            id: session?.user_id || 0,
            name: displayName,
            lrn: session?.username || 'STAFF',
            photo_url: resolvedPhoto,
          }}
          selectedClass={{ id: 0, section_name: `${displayRole} • ${activeSchoolName}` } as never}
          onClose={() => setIsDigitalPassOpen(false)}
          onCopyLrn={(id) => navigator.clipboard?.writeText(id)}
        />
      )}
    </header>
  );
};

  session?: UserSession | null;
  userPhoto?: string | null;
  isCollapsed?: boolean;
  onToggleCollapse?: () => void;
  schoolName?: string;
  schoolId?: string;
  schoolLogo?: string | null;
  canTeach?: boolean;
  allowedTabs?: NavItemKey[];
  badgeCounts?: TabBadgeCounts;
}

interface NavItem {
  key: NavItemKey;
  label: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}

interface NavGroup {
  groupTitle: string;
  items: NavItem[];
}

const getSchoolAbbreviation = (name?: string): string => {
  if (!name || !name.trim()) return 'AS';
  const ignore = new Set(['of', 'the', 'and', 'in', 'at', 'for', 'to', 'ng', 'sa']);
  const words = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter((w) => !ignore.has(w.toLowerCase()));
  return words.length === 1
    ? words[0].slice(0, 4).toUpperCase()
    : words.map((w) => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 6);
};

const formatBadge = (count?: number): string => {
  if (!count || count <= 0) return '';
  return count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
};

export const Sidebar: React.FC<SidebarProps> = ({
  activeTab,
  onSelectTab,
  onPrefetchTab,
  session,
  userPhoto,
  isCollapsed: controlledCollapsed,
  onToggleCollapse,
  schoolName = '',
  schoolId = '',
  schoolLogo,
  canTeach = false,
  allowedTabs,
  badgeCounts: propBadgeCounts,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [liveBadges, setLiveBadges] = useState<TabBadgeCounts>({});
  const [internalCollapsed, setInternalCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(
    () => localStorage.getItem('attendsure_sidebar_collapsed') === 'true'
  );

  const isCollapsed = controlledCollapsed !== undefined ? controlledCollapsed : internalCollapsed;
  const role = (session?.role || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const isLeadership = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(role);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onSync = (e: Event) => {
      const detail = (e as CustomEvent<TabBadgeCounts>).detail;
      if (detail) setLiveBadges(detail);
    };
    window.addEventListener('attendsure:notifications-sync', onSync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('attendsure:notifications-sync', onSync);
  }, []);

  const handleToggle = () => {
    const next = !isCollapsed;
    setInternalCollapsed(next);
    localStorage.setItem('attendsure_sidebar_collapsed', String(next));
    onToggleCollapse?.();
  };

  const mergedBadges: TabBadgeCounts = { ...liveBadges, ...propBadgeCounts };
  const schoolAbbr = useMemo(() => getSchoolAbbreviation(schoolName), [schoolName]);

  const allGroups: NavGroup[] = useMemo(
    () => [
      {

        items: [{ key: 'dashboard', label: 'Dashboard', icon: <LayoutDashboard size={17} /> }],
      },
