          { key: 'classroom-scanner', label: 'QR Scanner', icon: <QrCode size={17} /> },
          { key: 'my-classes', label: 'My Classes', icon: <BookOpen size={17} /> },
          { key: 'advisory-monitor', label: 'Advisory Matrix', icon: <LayoutGrid size={17} /> },
          { key: 'students', label: 'Students', icon: <GraduationCap size={17} /> },
          { key: 'facultys', label: 'Teachers & Staff', icon: <Users size={17} /> },
          { key: 'schedules', label: 'Schedules', icon: <CalendarDays size={17} /> },
        ],
      },
      {
        groupTitle: 'ATTENDANCE & ALERTS',
        items: [
          { key: 'messages', label: 'Parent Chat', icon: <MessageSquare size={17} /> },
          { key: 'push', label: 'Push Alerts', icon: <Bell size={17} /> },
          { key: 'gate-passes', label: 'Exit Passes', icon: <Ticket size={17} /> },
          { key: 'dtr', label: 'Monthly DTR', icon: <Clock size={17} /> },
          { key: 'geofence', label: 'Campus GPS', icon: <MapPin size={17} /> },
        ],
      },
      {
        groupTitle: 'ADMINISTRATION',
        items: [
          { key: 'reports', label: 'DepEd Reports', icon: <FileSpreadsheet size={19} /> },
          { key: 'users', label: 'User Accounts', icon: <UserCheck size={17} /> },
          { key: 'settings', label: 'School Settings', icon: <Settings size={17} /> },
        ],
      },
    ],
    []
  );

  const visibleGroups = useMemo(() => {
    return allGroups
      .map((group) => ({
        ...group,
        items: group.items.filter((item) => {
          if (allowedTabs && allowedTabs.length > 0) return allowedTabs.includes(item.key);
          if (item.key === 'users') return role === 'ADMIN' || role === 'SUPERADMIN';
          if (['settings', 'push', 'geofence'].includes(item.key)) {
            return ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(role);
          }
          if (['facultys', 'schedules'].includes(item.key)) return isLeadership;
          if (item.key === 'my-classes') return canTeach || isLeadership;
          return true;
        }),
      }))
      .filter((group) => group.items.length > 0);
  }, [allGroups, allowedTabs, canTeach, isLeadership, role]);

  const safeLogo = isSafeImageUrl(schoolLogo) ? schoolLogo : null;
  const safeUserPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(userPhoto) ? userPhoto : null;

  return (
    <aside
      style={{
        width: isCollapsed ? 64 : 196,
        minWidth: isCollapsed ? 64 : 196,
        height: '100%',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        transition: 'width 0.2s ease',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          padding: isCollapsed ? '10px 6px' : '10px 10px',
          borderBottomWidth: 1,
          borderBottomStyle: 'solid',
          borderBottomColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'center',
          position: 'relative',
        }}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleToggle}
          title={isCollapsed ? 'Expand sidebar' : 'Collapse sidebar'}
          style={{
            position: isCollapsed ? 'static' : 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            right: 8,
            marginBottom: isCollapsed ? 4 : 0,
            width: 22,
            height: 22,
            borderRadius: 6,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderStyle: 'solid',
            borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
            color: brand.primary,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            cursor: 'pointer',
          }}
        >
          {isCollapsed ? <ChevronRight size={13} /> : <ChevronLeft size={13} />}
        </button>

        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 4 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 900, color: brand.primary }}>{schoolAbbr}</div>
          {schoolId && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.62rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textMuted, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
              ID: {schoolId}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

            src={safeLogo}

              height: 32,
              borderRadius: '50%',
              backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg,
              color: '#fff',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              fontWeight: 800,
              fontSize: '0.76rem',

        {!isCollapsed && schoolName && (

              textAlign: 'center',

          >

      <nav style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', padding: isCollapsed ? '8px 6px' : '8px 8px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
        {visibleGroups.map((group) => (
          <div key={group.groupTitle} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
            {!isCollapsed && (
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.60rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted, padding: '3px 8px', letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>
                {group.groupTitle}
              </div>
            )}
            {group.items.map((item) => {
              const active = activeTab === item.key;
              const badge = formatBadge(mergedBadges[item.key]);
              return (
                <button
                  key={item.key}
                  type="button"
                  title={isCollapsed ? item.label : undefined}
                  onMouseEnter={() => onPrefetchTab?.(item.key)}
                  onFocus={() => onPrefetchTab?.(item.key)}
                  onClick={() => onSelectTab(item.key)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: isCollapsed ? 'center' : 'flex-start',
                    gap: 9,
                    height: 36,
                    padding: isCollapsed ? 0 : '0 10px',
                    borderRadius: 9,
                    borderWidth: 0,
                    borderStyle: 'none',
                    backgroundColor: active ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
                    color: active ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    position: 'relative',
                  }}
                >
                  <span style={{ display: 'flex', color: active ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textMuted }}>{item.icon}</span>
                  {!isCollapsed && (
                    <span
                      style={{
                        fontSize: '0.78rem',
                        fontWeight: active ? 800 : 600,
                        color: active ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textPrimary,

                        textAlign: 'left',
                        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',

                        fontWeight: 800,

        style={{
          padding: isCollapsed ? '8px 0' : '8px 10px',
          borderTopWidth: 1,
          borderTopStyle: 'solid',
          borderTopColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: isCollapsed ? 'center' : 'flex-start',
          gap: 8,
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ width: 30, height: 30, borderRadius: '50%', overflow: 'hidden', backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
          {safeUserPhoto ? (
            <img src={safeUserPhoto} alt="User" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />

          <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
              {session?.faculty_name || session?.username || 'User'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.60rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textMuted }}>{role}</div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
};

export default Sidebar;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import {
  Calendar,
  BookOpen,
  DoorOpen,
  Layers,
  Users,
  Clock,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  Trash2,

export type TabType =
  | 'SECTIONS'
  | 'SCHEDULE'
  | 'SECTION'
  | 'ROOM'
  | 'ROOMS'
  | 'SUBJECT'
  | 'SUBJECTS'
  | 'GRADES'
  | 'YEARS';

export interface AcademicSetupModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdated?: () => void;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
  initialTab?: TabType;
  editItem?: any;
}

const normalizeTab = (tab: TabType): 'SECTIONS' | 'SCHEDULE' | 'ROOMS' | 'SUBJECTS' | 'GRADES' | 'YEARS' => {
  if (tab === 'SECTION' || tab === 'SECTIONS') return 'SECTIONS';
  if (tab === 'SCHEDULE') return 'SCHEDULE';
  if (tab === 'ROOM' || tab === 'ROOMS') return 'ROOMS';
  if (tab === 'SUBJECT' || tab === 'SUBJECTS') return 'SUBJECTS';
  if (tab === 'GRADES') return 'GRADES';
  return 'YEARS';
};

export const AcademicSetupModal: React.FC<AcademicSetupModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onUpdated,
  onSuccess,
  initialTab = 'SECTIONS',
  editItem = null,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<
    'SECTIONS' | 'SCHEDULE' | 'ROOMS' | 'SUBJECTS' | 'GRADES' | 'YEARS'
  >(normalizeTab(initialTab));

  const [, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Database Records
  const [years, setYears] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [grades, setGrades] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [rooms, setRooms] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [subjects, setSubjects] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [facultyList, setFacultyList] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [schedules, setSchedules] = useState<any[]>([]);

  // Section & Adviser Form State
  const [sectionForm, setSectionForm] = useState({
    id: null as number | null,
    name: '',
    grade_level: '',
    adviser_id: '',
    room_number: '',
    capacity: 45,
  });

  // Schedule & Subject Faculty Form State
  const [scheduleForm, setScheduleForm] = useState({
    id: null as number | null,
    section_id: '',
    subject_id: '',
    faculty_id: '',
    room_id: '',
    start_time: '07:30',
    end_time: '08:30',
    days_of_week: 'MON-FRI',
  });

  // Simple Structural Forms (Rooms, Subjects, Grades)
  const [simpleForm, setSimpleForm] = useState({
    code: '',
    name: '',
    building: '',
    capacity: 45,
    title: '',
    units: 1,
  });

  // Synchronize Tab & Edit Item
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialTab) {
      const target = normalizeTab(initialTab);
      setActiveSubTab(target);

      if (editItem) {
        if (target === 'SECTIONS') {
          const advId =
            editItem.adviser_id ||
            (typeof editItem.adviser === 'object' && editItem.adviser ? editItem.adviser.id : editItem.adviser) ||
            '';
          const gradeId =
            editItem.grade_level_id ||
            (typeof editItem.grade_level === 'object' && editItem.grade_level ? editItem.grade_level.id : editItem.grade_level) ||
            '';

          setSectionForm({
            id: editItem.id || null,
            name: editItem.name || editItem.section_name || '',
            grade_level: String(gradeId || ''),
            adviser_id: String(advId || ''),
            room_number: editItem.room_number || '',
            capacity: editItem.capacity || 45,
          });
        } else if (target === 'SCHEDULE') {
          const secId =
            editItem.section_id ||
            (typeof editItem.section === 'object' && editItem.section ? editItem.section.id : editItem.section) ||
            '';
          const subId =
            editItem.subject_id ||
            (typeof editItem.subject === 'object' && editItem.subject ? editItem.subject.id : editItem.subject) ||
            '';
          const facId =
            editItem.faculty_id ||
            (typeof editItem.faculty === 'object' && editItem.faculty ? editItem.faculty.id : editItem.faculty) ||
            '';
          const roomId =
            (typeof editItem.room === 'object' && editItem.room ? editItem.room.id : editItem.room) || '';

          setScheduleForm({
            id: editItem.id || null,
            section_id: String(secId || ''),
            subject_id: String(subId || ''),
            faculty_id: String(facId || ''),
            room_id: String(roomId || ''),
            start_time: editItem.start_time ? String(editItem.start_time).slice(0, 5) : '07:30',
            end_time: editItem.end_time ? String(editItem.end_time).slice(0, 5) : '08:30',
            days_of_week: editItem.days_of_week || 'MON-FRI',
          });
        }
      } else {
        setSectionForm({ id: null, name: '', grade_level: '', adviser_id: '', room_number: '', capacity: 45 });
        setScheduleForm({ id: null, section_id: '', subject_id: '', faculty_id: '', room_id: '', start_time: '07:30', end_time: '08:30', days_of_week: 'MON-FRI' });
      }
    }
  }, [initialTab, editItem]);

  // Fast Batch Data Loading
  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const results = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get('/v1/school/school-years/'),
        apiClient.get('/v1/school/grade-levels/'),
        apiClient.get('/v1/school/rooms/'),
        apiClient.get('/v1/school/subjects/'),
        apiClient.get('/v1/school/sections/?page_size=300'),
        apiClient.get('/v1/accounts/teachers/dropdown/').catch(() => apiClient.get('/faculties/')),
        apiClient.get('/v1/school/periods/?page_size=300'),
      ]);

      const getData = (res: PromiseSettledResult<any>) =>
        res.status === 'fulfilled' && res.value?.data
          ? Array.isArray(res.value.data)
            ? res.value.data
            : res.value.data.results || []
          : [];

      setYears(getData(results[0]));
      setGrades(getData(results[1]));
      setRooms(getData(results[2]));
      setSubjects(getData(results[3]));
      setSections(getData(results[4]));
      setFacultyList(getData(results[5]));
      setSchedules(getData(results[6]));
    } catch {
      setError('Could not fetch academic records.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadData();
    }
  }, [isOpen, loadData]);

  // Handle Section & Adviser Save
  const handleSaveSection = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!sectionForm.name.trim()) {
      setError('Section name is required.');
      return;
    }
    if (!sectionForm.grade_level) {
      setError('Please select a grade level.');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);

    const payload = {
      name: sectionForm.name.trim(),
      grade_level: Number(sectionForm.grade_level),
      adviser_id: sectionForm.adviser_id ? Number(sectionForm.adviser_id) : null,
      adviser: sectionForm.adviser_id ? Number(sectionForm.adviser_id) : null,
      room_number: sectionForm.room_number.trim(),
      capacity: Number(sectionForm.capacity) || 45,
    };

    try {
      if (sectionForm.id) {
        await apiClient.patch(`/v1/school/sections/${sectionForm.id}/`, payload);
        setSuccessMessage('Section and Class Adviser updated successfully.');
      } else {
        await apiClient.post('/v1/school/sections/', payload);
        setSuccessMessage('New Section and Class Adviser assigned.');
      }

      setSectionForm({ id: null, name: '', grade_level: '', adviser_id: '', room_number: '', capacity: 45 });
      loadData();
      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.detail || err.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to save section.');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle Class Schedule & Subject Faculty Save
  const handleSaveSchedule = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!scheduleForm.section_id) {
      setError('Please select a class section.');
      return;
    }
    if (!scheduleForm.subject_id) {
      setError('Please select an academic subject.');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);

    const payload = {
      section: Number(scheduleForm.section_id),
      section_id: Number(scheduleForm.section_id),
      subject: Number(scheduleForm.subject_id),
      subject_id: Number(scheduleForm.subject_id),
      faculty: scheduleForm.faculty_id ? Number(scheduleForm.faculty_id) : null,
      faculty_id: scheduleForm.faculty_id ? Number(scheduleForm.faculty_id) : null,
      room: scheduleForm.room_id ? Number(scheduleForm.room_id) : null,
      start_time: scheduleForm.start_time,
      end_time: scheduleForm.end_time,
      days_of_week: scheduleForm.days_of_week || 'MON-FRI',
    };

    try {
      if (scheduleForm.id) {
        await apiClient.patch(`/v1/school/periods/${scheduleForm.id}/`, payload);
        setSuccessMessage('Class schedule and Subject Faculty updated.');
      } else {
        await apiClient.post('/v1/school/periods/', payload);
        setSuccessMessage('New class period and Subject Faculty assigned.');
      }

      setScheduleForm({
        id: null,
        section_id: '',
        subject_id: '',
        faculty_id: '',
        room_id: '',
        start_time: '07:30',
        end_time: '08:30',
        days_of_week: 'MON-FRI',
      });
      loadData();
      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.detail || err.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to save schedule period.');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle Simple Items (Rooms, Subjects, Grades)
  const handleAddSimpleItem = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      if (activeSubTab === 'ROOMS') {
        await apiClient.post('/v1/school/rooms/', {
          name: simpleForm.name.trim(),
          building: simpleForm.building.trim(),
          capacity: Number(simpleForm.capacity) || 45,
        });
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS') {
        await apiClient.post('/v1/school/subjects/', {
          code: simpleForm.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
          title: simpleForm.title.trim(),
          units: Number(simpleForm.units) || 1,
        });
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'GRADES') {
        await apiClient.post('/v1/school/grade-levels/', {
          code: simpleForm.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
          name: simpleForm.name.trim(),
        });
      }

      setSimpleForm({ code: '', name: '', building: '', capacity: 45, title: '', units: 1 });
      loadData();
      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to save record.');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteItem = async (endpoint: string, id: number) => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this record?')) return;
    try {
      await apiClient.delete(`/${endpoint}/${id}/`);
      loadData();
      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
    } catch {
      alert('Could not delete record.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="Academic Structure & Faculty Assignments">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
        {/* Navigation Tabs */}
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 8,
            borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            paddingBottom: 8,
            overflowX: 'auto',
          }}
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('SECTIONS'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'SECTIONS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Users size={14} /> Sections &amp; Advisers
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('SCHEDULE'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'SCHEDULE', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Clock size={14} /> Schedules &amp; Subject Faculty
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('SUBJECTS'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <BookOpen size={14} /> Subjects
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('ROOMS'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'ROOMS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <DoorOpen size={14} /> Classrooms
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('GRADES'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'GRADES', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Layers size={14} /> Grade Levels
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('YEARS'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'YEARS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Calendar size={14} /> School Years
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Status Alerts */}
        {error && (
          <div style={alertBoxStyle(tokens.dangerLight, brand.danger)}>
            <AlertCircle size={15} />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {successMessage && (
          <div style={alertBoxStyle(tokens.successLight, brand.success)}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={15} />
            <span>{successMessage}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 1. SECTIONS & CLASS ADVISER FORM */}
        {activeSubTab === 'SECTIONS' && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveSection} style={formCardStyle(tokens)}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                {sectionForm.id ? 'Edit Section & Adviser' : 'Add Section & Assign Class Adviser'}
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Section Name *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. Diamond"
                    value={sectionForm.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, name: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Level *</label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={sectionForm.grade_level}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, grade_level: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select Grade Level</option>
                    {grades.map((g) => (
                      <option key={g.id} value={g.id}>
                        {g.name || g.code}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                {/* Class Adviser Selection */}
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Class Adviser (Faculty)</label>
                  <select
                    value={sectionForm.adviser_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, adviser_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">(None / Unassigned)</option>
                    {facultyList.map((f) => (
                      <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                        {f.full_name || f.name} {f.employee_id ? `(${f.employee_id})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Default Room Number</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Room 204"
                    value={sectionForm.room_number}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, room_number: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
                {sectionForm.id && (
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="sm"
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSectionForm({ id: null, name: '', grade_level: '', adviser_id: '', room_number: '', capacity: 45 })}
                  >
                    Cancel Edit
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
                  {submitting ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : sectionForm.id ? 'Save Changes' : 'Create Section'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>

            {/* List Existing Sections with Adviser */}
            <div style={tableContainer(tokens)}>
              <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Section</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Grade</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Class Adviser</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {sections.map((sec) => {
                    const adviserName =
                      sec.adviser_name ||
                      sec.adviser_full_name ||
                      (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser ? sec.adviser.full_name || sec.adviser.name : null) ||
                      facultyList.find((f) => f.id === sec.adviser_id || f.id === sec.adviser)?.full_name ||
                      'Unassigned';

                    return (
                      <tr key={sec.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{sec.name}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{sec.grade_level_name || sec.grade_level?.name || '—'}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: adviserName === 'Unassigned' ? brand.warning : brand.primary, fontWeight: 600 }}>
                          {adviserName}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              const advId = sec.adviser_id || (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser ? sec.adviser.id : sec.adviser) || '';
                              setSectionForm({
                                id: sec.id,
                                name: sec.name,
                                grade_level: String(sec.grade_level?.id || sec.grade_level || ''),
                                adviser_id: String(advId || ''),
                                room_number: sec.room_number || '',
                                capacity: sec.capacity || 45,
                              });
                            }}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, cursor: 'pointer', marginRight: 8 }}
                            title="Edit Section & Adviser"
                          >
                            <Edit2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteItem('v1/school/sections', sec.id)}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                            title="Delete Section"
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 2. SCHEDULES & SUBJECT FACULTY FORM */}
        {activeSubTab === 'SCHEDULE' && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveSchedule} style={formCardStyle(tokens)}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                {scheduleForm.id ? 'Edit Class Schedule & Faculty' : 'Add Subject Period & Assign Faculty'}
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Class Section *</label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.section_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, section_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select Section</option>
                    {sections.map((s) => (
                      <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                        {s.name} ({s.grade_level_name || s.grade_level?.name || 'Section'})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject *</label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.subject_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, subject_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select Subject</option>
                    {subjects.map((sub) => (
                      <option key={sub.id} value={sub.id}>
                        {sub.code} - {sub.title}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                {/* Subject Faculty Selection */}
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Faculty</label>
                  <select
                    value={scheduleForm.faculty_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, faculty_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">(None / Unassigned)</option>
                    {facultyList.map((f) => (
                      <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                        {f.full_name || f.name} {f.employee_id ? `(${f.employee_id})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Classroom</label>
                  <select
                    value={scheduleForm.room_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, room_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">(Select Room)</option>
                    {rooms.map((r) => (
                      <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                        {r.name} {r.building ? `(${r.building})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Start Time</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.start_time}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, start_time: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>End Time</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.end_time}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, end_time: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
                {scheduleForm.id && (
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="sm"
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setScheduleForm({ id: null, section_id: '', subject_id: '', faculty_id: '', room_id: '', start_time: '07:30', end_time: '08:30', days_of_week: 'MON-FRI' })}
                  >
                    Cancel Edit
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
                  {submitting ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : scheduleForm.id ? 'Save Changes' : 'Create Class Period'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>

            {/* List Existing Schedules */}
            <div style={tableContainer(tokens)}>
              <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Section</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Subject</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Subject Faculty</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Time</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {schedules.map((sc) => {
                    const secName = sc.section_name || sc.section?.name || 'Section';
                    const subCode = sc.subject_code || sc.subject?.code || 'SUB';
                    const facultyName =
                      sc.faculty_name ||
                      (typeof sc.faculty === 'object' && sc.faculty ? sc.faculty.full_name || sc.faculty.name : null) ||
                      facultyList.find((f) => f.id === sc.faculty_id || f.id === sc.faculty)?.full_name ||
                      'Unassigned';

                    return (
                      <tr key={sc.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{secName}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700 }}>{subCode}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: facultyName === 'Unassigned' ? brand.warning : tokens.textSecondary, fontWeight: 600 }}>
                          {facultyName}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                          {String(sc.start_time).slice(0, 5)} - {String(sc.end_time).slice(0, 5)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              const secId = sc.section_id || (typeof sc.section === 'object' && sc.section ? sc.section.id : sc.section) || '';
                              const subId = sc.subject_id || (typeof sc.subject === 'object' && sc.subject ? sc.subject.id : sc.subject) || '';
                              const facId = sc.faculty_id || (typeof sc.faculty === 'object' && sc.faculty ? sc.faculty.id : sc.faculty) || '';
                              const roomId = (typeof sc.room === 'object' && sc.room ? sc.room.id : sc.room) || '';

                              setScheduleForm({
                                id: sc.id,
                                section_id: String(secId || ''),
                                subject_id: String(subId || ''),
                                faculty_id: String(facId || ''),
                                room_id: String(roomId || ''),
                                start_time: sc.start_time ? String(sc.start_time).slice(0, 5) : '07:30',
                                end_time: sc.end_time ? String(sc.end_time).slice(0, 5) : '08:30',
                                days_of_week: sc.days_of_week || 'MON-FRI',
                              });
                            }}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, cursor: 'pointer', marginRight: 8 }}
                            title="Edit Schedule & Faculty"
                          >
                            <Edit2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteItem('v1/school/periods', sc.id)}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                            title="Delete Schedule"
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 3. SIMPLE MODES: ROOMS, SUBJECTS, GRADES, YEARS */}
        {!['SECTIONS', 'SCHEDULE'].includes(activeSubTab) && (
          <form onSubmit={handleAddSimpleItem} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-end', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {activeSubTab === 'ROOMS' && (
              <>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Room Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. Room 101"
                    value={simpleForm.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, name: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Building</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Science Wing"
                    value={simpleForm.building}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, building: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {activeSubTab === 'GRADES' && (
              <>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100 }}>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Code</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. G7"
                    value={simpleForm.code}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, code: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div style={{ flex: 2, minWidth: 140 }}>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. Grade 7"
                    value={simpleForm.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, name: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS' && (
              <>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100 }}>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Code</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. MATH7"
                    value={simpleForm.code}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, code: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div style={{ flex: 2, minWidth: 140 }}>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Title</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. Mathematics 7"
                    value={simpleForm.title}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, title: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {activeSubTab !== 'YEARS' && (
              <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
                {submitting ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : 'Add Record'}
              </Button>
            )}
          </form>
        )}

        {/* Simple Tables */}
        {!['SECTIONS', 'SCHEDULE'].includes(activeSubTab) && (
          <div style={tableContainer(tokens)}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
              <thead>
                <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Item Name / Code</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Details</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Action</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {activeSubTab === 'YEARS' &&
                  years.map((y) => (
                    <tr key={y.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{y.code}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                        {y.is_active ? <span style={{ color: brand.success, fontWeight: 700 }}>Active School Year</span> : 'Archived'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Locked</span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}

                {activeSubTab === 'GRADES' &&
                  grades.map((g) => (
                    <tr key={g.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{g.code}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{g.name}</td>

                        <button type="button" onClick={() => handleDeleteItem('v1/school/rooms', r.id)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}>

                          <Trash2 size={13} />

/**
 * AttendSure - First-Time Profile Completion Modal
 * File: web/src/components/modals/CompleteProfileModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { UserCheck, ShieldCheck, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface CompletedProfileUser {
  full_name?: string;
  username?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface CompleteProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onCompleted: (updatedUser: CompletedProfileUser) => void;
}

export const CompleteProfileModal: React.FC<CompleteProfileModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onCompleted }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    contact_number: '',
    department: 'Junior High School',
    password: '',
  });

  const cleanPhone = formData.contact_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
  const isPhoneValid = /^(09|\+639)\d{9}$/.test(cleanPhone);
  const isPasswordValid =
    !formData.password ||
    (formData.password.length >= 8 && /[A-Za-z]/.test(formData.password) && /[0-9]/.test(formData.password));
  const isFormValid =
    formData.first_name.trim().length >= 2 &&
    formData.last_name.trim().length >= 2 &&
    isPhoneValid &&
    isPasswordValid;

  const setField = (key: keyof typeof formData, val: string) => setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, [key]: val }));

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isFormValid) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, string> = {
        first_name: formData.first_name.trim(),
        middle_name: formData.middle_name.trim(),
        last_name: formData.last_name.trim(),
        suffix: formData.suffix.trim(),
        contact_number: cleanPhone,
        department: formData.department.trim(),
      };
      if (formData.password.trim().length >= 8) payload.password = formData.password.trim();

      const res = await apiClient.put('/v1/accounts/me/', payload);
      showAlert({ title: 'Profile Completed', message: 'Your faculty record is now active.', type: 'success' });
      onCompleted(res.data);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to update profile.', type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={() => {}} title="Complete Your Profile Information">
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, backgroundColor: tokens.infoLight, borderColor: brand.secondary, display: 'flex', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <ShieldCheck size={20} color={brand.secondary} />
          <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
            Please complete your personal details to activate your DTR and class list access.
          </span>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>First Name *</label>
            <input required style={ui.input} value={formData.first_name} onChange={(e) => setField('first_name', e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Last Name *</label>
            <input required style={ui.input} value={formData.last_name} onChange={(e) => setField('last_name', e.target.value)} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1.4fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Middle Name</label>
            <input style={ui.input} value={formData.middle_name} onChange={(e) => setField('middle_name', e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Suffix</label>
            <select style={ui.input} value={formData.suffix} onChange={(e) => setField('suffix', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">None</option>
              <option value="Jr.">Jr.</option>
              <option value="Sr.">Sr.</option>
              <option value="II">II</option>
              <option value="III">III</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Contact Number (11 Digits) *</label>
            <input required maxLength={13} placeholder="09171234567" style={ui.input} value={formData.contact_number} onChange={(e) => setField('contact_number', e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Department *</label>
            <select required style={ui.input} value={formData.department} onChange={(e) => setField('department', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="Junior High School">Junior High School</option>
              <option value="Senior High School">Senior High School</option>
              <option value="Office of the Principal / Administration">Administration</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label style={ui.label}>New Password (Optional, min 8 chars with letters & numbers)</label>
          <input type="password" style={ui.input} value={formData.password} onChange={(e) => setField('password', e.target.value)} />
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: 8 }}>
          <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="submit" disabled={saving || !isFormValid}>
            {saving ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <UserCheck size={16} />}
            <span>{saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Complete & Activate Profile'}</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
};

export default CompleteProfileModal;

/**
 * AttendSure - User Profile View & Edit Modal
 * File: web/src/components/modals/ProfileModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { Camera, X, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ProfileUpdatePayload {
  full_name?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface ProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onProfileUpdated?: (updated: ProfileUpdatePayload) => void;
}

export const ProfileModal: React.FC<ProfileModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onProfileUpdated }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    first_name: '', middle_name: '', last_name: '', suffix: '',
    email: '', contact_number: '', position: '', department: '', password: '', photo: null as string | null,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    setLoading(true);
    apiClient.get('/v1/accounts/me/')
      .then((res) => {
        const u = res.data;
        setFormData({
          first_name: u.first_name || '', middle_name: u.middle_name || '', last_name: u.last_name || '',
          suffix: u.suffix || '', email: u.email || '', contact_number: u.contact_number || '',
          position: u.position || '', department: u.department || '', password: '', photo: null,
        });
        setPhotoPreview(u.photo_url || u.photo || null);
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type) || file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Image', message: 'Use JPG, PNG, or WebP under 2.5 MB.', type: 'error' });
      return;
    }
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      const b64 = reader.result as string;
      setPhotoPreview(b64);
      setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: b64 }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    const payload: Record<string, any> = {
      first_name: formData.first_name.trim(), middle_name: formData.middle_name.trim(),
      last_name: formData.last_name.trim(), suffix: formData.suffix.trim(),
      email: formData.email.trim(), contact_number: formData.contact_number.trim(),
    };
    if (formData.password.trim().length >= 8) payload.password = formData.password.trim();
    if (formData.photo !== null) payload.photo = formData.photo === '' ? null : formData.photo;

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put('/v1/accounts/me/', payload);
      showAlert({ title: 'Saved', message: 'Profile updated.', type: 'success' });
      onProfileUpdated?.(res.data);
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: err.response?.data?.detail || 'Update failed.', type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const setField = (k: keyof typeof formData, v: string) => setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: v }));

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="My User Profile">
      {loading ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Loading profile...</div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14 }}>
            <div style={{ width: 52, height: 52, borderRadius: '50%', overflow: 'hidden', backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              {photoPreview ? <img src={photoPreview} alt="Profile" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} /> : <span style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>No Pic</span>}
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.btnPrimary}>
                <Camera size={12} /> Change Photo
                <input type="file" accept="image/*" onChange={handlePhotoSelect} style={{ display: 'none' }} />
              </label>
              {photoPreview && (
                <button type="button" onClick={() => { setPhotoPreview(null); setField('photo', ''); }} style={{ marginLeft: 8, color: brand.danger, background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.74rem' }}>
                  <X size={12} /> Remove
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
            <div><label style={ui.label}>First Name</label><input required style={ui.input} value={formData.first_name} onChange={(e) => setField('first_name', e.target.value)} /></div>
            <div><label style={ui.label}>Last Name</label><input required style={ui.input} value={formData.last_name} onChange={(e) => setField('last_name', e.target.value)} /></div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1.4fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
            <div><label style={ui.label}>Middle Name</label><input style={ui.input} value={formData.middle_name} onChange={(e) => setField('middle_name', e.target.value)} /></div>
            <div><label style={ui.label}>Suffix</label><input style={ui.input} value={formData.suffix} onChange={(e) => setField('suffix', e.target.value)} /></div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
            <div><label style={ui.label}>Email</label><input type="email" style={ui.input} value={formData.email} onChange={(e) => setField('email', e.target.value)} /></div>
            <div><label style={ui.label}>Contact Number</label><input style={ui.input} value={formData.contact_number} onChange={(e) => setField('contact_number', e.target.value)} /></div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>New Password (Optional)</label>
            <input type="password" placeholder="Min 8 characters" style={ui.input} value={formData.password} onChange={(e) => setField('password', e.target.value)} />
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="submit" disabled={saving}>
              {saving ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : 'Save Changes'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
};

export default ProfileModal;

/**

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { ShieldCheck, Copy, Check, Printer, User as UserIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import type { StudentItem, AssignedClass } from '../tabs/MyAssignedClassesTab';

interface StudentIdPassModalProps {
  student: (Partial<StudentItem> & { name: string; lrn: string; qr_token?: string; photo_url?: string | null }) | null;
  selectedClass?: AssignedClass | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCopyLrn: (lrn: string) => void;
}

export const StudentIdPassModal: React.FC<StudentIdPassModalProps> = ({ student, selectedClass, onClose, onCopyLrn }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  if (!student) return null;
  const safePhoto = isSafeImageUrl(student.photo_url) ? student.photo_url : null;
  const identifier = student.lrn || 'ID-00000';

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={Boolean(student)} onClose={onClose} title="Digital QR ID Pass">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center' }}>
        <div style={{ width: 290, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, border: `2px solid ${brand.primary}`, borderRadius: 14, overflow: 'hidden', boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow }}>
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: brand.primary, color: '#fff', padding: 12 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: fonts.size.xs, fontWeight: 800 }}>
              <ShieldCheck size={14} /> ATTENDSURE OFFICIAL PASS
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.62rem', opacity: 0.9, marginTop: 2 }}>Macasandig National High School</div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ padding: 16 }}>
            <div style={{ width: 54, height: 54, borderRadius: '50%', margin: '0 auto 10px', backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, border: `2px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, overflow: 'hidden', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              {safePhoto ? <img src={safePhoto} alt={student.name} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} /> : <UserIcon size={26} color={tokens.textMuted} />}
            </div>

            <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{student.name}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, color: tokens.textSecondary, marginTop: 2 }}>{selectedClass?.section_name || 'Authorized Member'}</div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { onCopyLrn(identifier); setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000); }}
              style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, margin: '10px auto', fontFamily: fonts.mono }}
            >
              <span>ID: {identifier}</span>
              {copied ? <Check size={12} color={brand.success} /> : <Copy size={12} />}

            <div style={{ margin: '6px auto', padding: 6, backgroundColor: '#ffffff', border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, borderRadius: 10, width: 124, height: 124 }}>

/**
 * AttendSure - DepEd Manual of Style (DMOS) Header & Footer
 * File: web/src/components/reports/DepEdReportHeaderFooter.tsx

// Cybersecurity: Validate that image sources use safe protocols to prevent XSS / script injection
const isSafeImageUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = url.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || clean === 'null' || clean === 'undefined' || clean === 'none') return false;
  if (clean.startsWith('javascript:') || clean.startsWith('vbscript:')) return false;
  return (
    clean.startsWith('http://') ||
    clean.startsWith('https://') ||
    clean.startsWith('/') ||
    clean.startsWith('data:image/') ||
    clean.startsWith('blob:')
  );
};

const DEFAULT_REPORTS: ReportTabItem[] = [

const getCurrentMonthName = (): string => {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'long' }).format(new Date());
  } catch {
    return 'January';
  }
};

const extractGradeLevelName = (val: any): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') return val.trim();
  if (typeof val === 'number') return `Grade ${val}`;
  if (typeof val === 'object') {
    const name = val.name || val.level || val.grade_name || val.grade || val.id;
    return name !== undefined && name !== null ? String(name).trim() : '';
  }
  return String(val).trim();
};

export const ReportNavBar: React.FC<ReportNavBarProps> = ({
  reports = DEFAULT_REPORTS,
  activeReportId,
  onSelectReport,
  academicYears = [],
  selectedAcademicYear = '',
  onAcademicYearChange,
  showAcademicYearFilter = false,
  gradeLevels = [],
  selectedGradeLevel = 'ALL',
  onGradeLevelChange,
  showGradeLevelFilter = true,
  sections = [],
  selectedSectionId,
  onSectionChange,
  showSectionFilter = true,
  showDateFilter = false,
  selectedDate = '',
  onDateChange,
  showMonthFilter = false,
  selectedMonth = getCurrentMonthName(),
  onMonthChange,
  monthsList = DEFAULT_MONTHS,
  showCalendarYearFilter = false,
  selectedCalendarYear = new Date().getFullYear(),
  onCalendarYearChange,
  searchQuery = '',
  onSearchChange,
  showSearch = true,
  layoutMode = 'pages',
  onToggleLayoutMode,
  showLayoutModeToggle = true,
  onRefresh,
  isRefreshing = false,
  onOpenPageSetup,
  exportHandlers,
  onPrint,
  isExporting = false,
  exportingText = 'Exporting...',
  disableActions = false,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [isExportDropdownOpen, setIsExportDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const userRole = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || '').toUpperCase();
  const isAdminOrPrincipal = userRole === 'ADMIN' || userRole === 'PRINCIPAL';

  const filteredReports = useMemo(() => {
    return reports.filter((rep) => {
      if (rep.id === 'sf4' && !isAdminOrPrincipal) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }, [reports, isAdminOrPrincipal]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isExportDropdownOpen) return;

    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isExportDropdownOpen]);

  const filteredSections = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedGradeLevel || selectedGradeLevel === 'ALL') {
      return sections;
    }
    return sections.filter((sec) => {
      const g = extractGradeLevelName(sec.grade_level).toLowerCase();

      new Set(
        sections
          .map((s) => extractGradeLevelName(s?.grade_level))
          .filter(Boolean)

    return extracted.sort((a, b) =>
      String(a).localeCompare(String(b), undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' })

  }, [gradeLevels, sections]);

import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
