export interface ScannedStudent {
  student_id: number;
  student_name: string;
  lrn: string;
  section: string;
  status: string;
  scanned_at: string;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  attendance_note?: string;
  is_duplicate?: boolean;
}

interface ClassPeriodOption {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  grade_level: string;
  subject_code: string;
  subject_title: string;
  time_display: string;
}

interface OfflineScanEntry {
  qr_token: string;
  period_id: number | null;
  scanned_at: string;
}

export interface ClassroomScannerProps {
  onClose?: () => void;
  isModal?: boolean;
}

const OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY = 'attendsure_offline_qr_queue';

const loadOfflineQueue = (): OfflineScanEntry[] => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as OfflineScanEntry[]) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

const playFeedbackChime = (type: 'SUCCESS' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR') => {
  try {
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) return;
    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = type === 'SUCCESS' ? 'sine' : 'triangle';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(type === 'SUCCESS' ? 1046 : 250, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.22);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.start();
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.22);
  } catch {
    // Browser autoplay policy blocked audio
  }
};

export const ClassroomScanner: React.FC<ClassroomScannerProps> = ({ onClose, isModal = false }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const [scannerMode, setScannerMode] = useState<'USB_GUN' | 'CAMERA'>('USB_GUN');
  const [soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [syncingOffline, setSyncingOffline] = useState(false);
  const [inputCode, setInputCode] = useState('');

  const [periods, setPeriods] = useState<ClassPeriodOption[]>([]);
  const [selectedPeriodId, setSelectedPeriodId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [activeStudent, setActiveStudent] = useState<ScannedStudent | null>(null);
  const [sessionList, setSessionList] = useState<ScannedStudent[]>([]);
  const [offlineQueue, setOfflineQueue] = useState<OfflineScanEntry[]>(loadOfflineQueue);
  const [cameraMessage, setCameraMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const keyBuffer = useRef('');
  const lastKeyTime = useRef(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const frameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, { params: { summary: 1 } })
      .then((res) => {
        const list: ClassPeriodOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : [];
        setPeriods(list);
        if (list.length > 0) setSelectedPeriodId((prev) => prev ?? list[0].id);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);
  
  const syncOfflineScans = useCallback(async () => {
    const queued = loadOfflineQueue();
    if (queued.length === 0) return;
    setSyncingOffline(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.attendance.offlineSync, { scans: queued });
      localStorage.removeItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY);
      setOfflineQueue([]);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Offline Scans Synced',
        message: `Synced ${res.data?.synced_count ?? 0} scan(s) (${res.data?.duplicate_count ?? 0} duplicate).`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Sync Notice', message: extractApiError(err, 'Still offline.'), type: 'warning' });
    } finally {
      setSyncingOffline(false);
    }
  }, [showAlert]);

  const handleProcessScan = useCallback(
    async (rawCode: string) => {
      const clean = rawCode.trim().replace(/[\r\n]/g, '');
      if (!clean) return;

      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.attendance.scan, {
          qr_text: clean,
          period_id: selectedPeriodId || undefined,
        });

        const d = res.data || {};
        const item: ScannedStudent = {
          student_id: d.student_id,
          student_name: d.student_name,
          lrn: d.lrn,
          section: d.section,
          status: d.status || 'PRESENT',
          scanned_at: d.scanned_at,
          photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(d.photo_url) ? d.photo_url : null,
          attendance_note: d.attendance_note,
          is_duplicate: Boolean(d.is_duplicate),
        };

        setActiveStudent(item);
        if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime(item.is_duplicate ? 'WARNING' : 'SUCCESS');
        if (!item.is_duplicate) {
          setSessionList((prev) => [item, ...prev.filter((p) => p.lrn !== item.lrn)]);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const netErr = err as { response?: unknown };
        if (!netErr?.response) {
          const nextQueue: OfflineScanEntry[] = [
            ...loadOfflineQueue(),
            { qr_token: clean, period_id: selectedPeriodId, scanned_at: new Date().toISOString() },
          ];
          localStorage.setItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextQueue));
          setOfflineQueue(nextQueue);
          if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime('WARNING');
          showAlert({
            title: 'Saved to Offline Queue',
            message: `Internet unavailable. Queued "${clean.slice(0, 20)}" for automatic sync.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
        } else {
          if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime('ERROR');
          showAlert({ title: 'Scan Rejected', message: extractApiError(err), type: 'warning' });
        }
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setInputCode('');
        setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 40);
      }
    },
    [selectedPeriodId, soundEnabled, showAlert]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const tag = (document.activeElement as HTMLElement)?.tagName;
      if (tag === 'INPUT' && document.activeElement !== inputRef.current) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastKeyTime.current > 120) keyBuffer.current = '';
      lastKeyTime.current = now;
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && keyBuffer.current.length >= 4) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleProcessScan(keyBuffer.current);
        keyBuffer.current = '';
      } else if (e.key.length === 1) {
        keyBuffer.current += e.key;
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [handleProcessScan]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scannerMode !== 'CAMERA') {
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
      if (frameRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
      return;
    }

    let active = true;
    navigator.mediaDevices
      ?.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'environment', width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } } })
      .then((stream) => {
        if (!active) {
          stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
          return;
        }
        streamRef.current = stream;
        if (videoRef.current) {
          videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
          videoRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
        }
        if ('BarcodeDetector' in window) {
          const Detector = (window as unknown as { BarcodeDetector: new (opts: { formats: string[] }) => { detect: (el: HTMLVideoElement) => Promise<Array<{ rawValue?: string }>> } }).BarcodeDetector;
          const detector = new Detector({ formats: ['qr_code', 'code_128'] });
          const tick = async () => {
            if (!active) return;
            if (videoRef.current && videoRef.current.readyState >= 2 && !loading) {
              const codes = await detector.detect(videoRef.current).catch(() => []);
              if (codes[0]?.rawValue) {
                await handleProcessScan(codes[0].rawValue);
                await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1300));
              }
            }
            if (active) frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
          };
          frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        setCameraMessage('Camera permission denied. Allow camera access in your browser bar or use USB Scanner mode.');
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
      if (frameRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
    };
  }, [scannerMode, loading, handleProcessScan]);

  return (
    <div style={isModal ? { position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 9999, backgroundColor: 'rgba(15,23,42,0.65)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: 16 } : { width: '100%' }}>
      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden', width: '100%', maxWidth: isModal ? 900 : '100%' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12, padding: '12px 18px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <ControlSwitch
              options={[
                { value: 'USB_GUN', label: 'USB QR Scanner', icon: <HardDrive size={14} /> },
                { value: 'CAMERA', label: 'Device Camera', icon: <Camera size={14} /> },
              ]}
              value={scannerMode}
              onChange={setScannerMode}
            />

            {periods.length > 0 && (
              <select
                value={selectedPeriodId || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedPeriodId(e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : null)}
                style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 220, padding: '6px 10px' }}
              >
                {periods.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                    {p.grade_level} - {p.name} • {p.subject_code || p.subject_title} ({p.time_display || 'Active'})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            {offlineQueue.length > 0 && (
              <button type="button" onClick={syncOfflineScans} disabled={syncingOffline} style={ui.btnPrimary}>
                <CloudUpload size={14} /> Sync Offline ({offlineQueue.length})
              </button>
            )}

            <button type="button" onClick={() => setSoundEnabled(!soundEnabled)} style={ui.btnSecondary}>
              {soundEnabled ? <Volume2 size={14} color={brand.primary} /> : <VolumeX size={14} />}
              {soundEnabled ? 'Sound On' : 'Muted'}
            </button>

            {onClose && (
              <button type="button" onClick={onClose} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                <X size={18} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr))', gap: 16, padding: 18, backgroundColor: tokens.bgCanvas }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            {scannerMode === 'USB_GUN' ? (
              <div onClick={() => inputRef.current?.focus()} style={{ ...ui.card, textAlign: 'center', padding: 24, cursor: 'text' }}>
                <div style={{ width: 54, height: 54, borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, color: brand.primary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', margin: '0 auto 10px' }}>
                  <Scan size={26} />
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>USB QR Scanner Ready</div>
                <p style={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, margin: '6px auto 14px', maxWidth: 400 }}>
                  Scan a signed student QR ID card or type the 12-digit LRN below.
                </p>
                <form
                  onSubmit={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleProcessScan(inputCode);
                  }}
                  style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}
                >
                  <input
                    ref={inputRef}
                    type="text"
                    autoFocus
                    value={inputCode}
                    onChange={(e) => setInputCode(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Scan QR card or enter LRN..."
                    style={{ ...ui.input, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}

                  <button type="submit" disabled={loading || !inputCode.trim()} style={ui.btnPrimary}>

              </div>
            ) : (
              <div style={ui.card}>

                  <div style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, color: brand.warning }}>{cameraMessage}</div>
                ) : (
                  <div style={{ position: 'relative', height: 260, backgroundColor: '#0f172a', borderRadius: 10, overflow: 'hidden', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                    <video ref={videoRef} muted playsInline style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
                    <div style={{ position: 'absolute', width: 165, height: 165, border: `2px solid ${brand.primary}`, borderRadius: 12, pointerEvents: 'none' }} />

            {activeStudent ? (

  last_name: string;
  full_name: string;
  department?: string;
  position?: string;
  photo_url?: string | null;
}

interface DailyDTRRow {
  day: number;
  date_str: string;
  day_of_week: string;
  is_weekend: boolean;
  am_arrival: string;
  am_departure: string;
  pm_arrival: string;
  pm_departure: string;
  undertime_hours: number | string;
  undertime_minutes: number | string;
  is_loafing?: boolean;
  loafing_excused?: boolean;
  loafing_remarks?: string;
}

interface DTRReportData {
  faculty_id: number;
  faculty_name: string;
  employee_id: string;
  department?: string;
  month: string;
  month_number: number;
  year: number;
  regular_days_hours: string;
  saturdays_hours: string;
  school_head: string;
  school_head_title?: string;
  dtr_submitted?: boolean;
  dept_head_approved: boolean;
  can_approve_dept?: boolean;
  can_clear_loafing?: boolean;
  rows: DailyDTRRow[];
  daily_logs?: DailyDTRRow[];
  total_undertime_hours: number;
  total_undertime_minutes: number;
  days_present: number;
}

type FormSide = 'BOTH' | 'FRONT' | 'BACK';

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
];

const HTML2PDF_CDN_URL =
  'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2pdf.js/0.10.1/html2pdf.bundle.min.js';
const HTML2PDF_SRI_HASH =
  'sha512-GsLlZN/3F2ErC5ifS5QtgpiJtWd43JWSuIgh7mbzZ8zBps+dvLusV+eNQATqgA/HdeKFVgA5v3S/cIrLF7QnIg==';

const loadHtml2PdfSecurely = (): Promise<any> => {
  const existing = (window as unknown as { html2pdf?: any }).html2pdf;
  if (existing) return Promise.resolve(existing);

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = HTML2PDF_CDN_URL;
    script.integrity = HTML2PDF_SRI_HASH;
    script.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    script.referrerPolicy = 'no-referrer';
    script.onload = () => resolve((window as unknown as { html2pdf?: any }).html2pdf);
    script.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load verified PDF library.'));
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  });
};

export const DTRTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { school } = useSchool();

  const currentUserRole = useMemo(
    () => (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase(),
    []
  );
  const isFaculty = currentUserRole === 'FACULTY';

  const nowDate = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);
  const yearOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const cur = nowDate.getFullYear();
    return [cur - 1, cur, cur + 1];
  }, [nowDate]);

  const [teacherList, setTeacherList] = useState<TeacherDropdownItem[]>([]);
  const [selectedTeacherId, setSelectedTeacherId] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<number>(nowDate.getMonth() + 1);
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(nowDate.getFullYear());

  const [regularHours, setRegularHours] = useState<string>('');
  const [saturdayHours, setSaturdayHours] = useState<string>('');
  const [hoursDirty, setHoursDirty] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [viewSide, setViewSide] = useState<FormSide>('BOTH');

  const [dtrData, setDtrData] = useState<DTRReportData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [actionProcessing, setActionProcessing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [exportingPdf, setExportingPdf] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [selectedAlertRow, setSelectedAlertRow] = useState<DailyDTRRow | null>(null);
  const [excuseRemarks, setExcuseRemarks] = useState<string>('');

  const printAreaRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const isInteracting = useRef<boolean>(false);
  isInteracting.current = Boolean(selectedAlertRow) || actionProcessing || hoursDirty;

  const activeTeacher = useMemo(
    () => teacherList.find((t) => String(t.id) === selectedTeacherId),
    [teacherList, selectedTeacherId]
  );

  // Load lightweight cached teacher dropdown once for leadership roles
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isFaculty) return;
    let active = true;

    apiClient
      .get<TeacherDropdownItem[]>(API_ROUTES.accounts.teachersDropdown)
      .then((res) => {
        if (!active) return;
        const list = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : [];
        setTeacherList(list);
        if (list.length > 0) {
          setSelectedTeacherId((prev) => prev || String(list[0].id));
        }
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (active) setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load teachers list.'));
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [isFaculty]);

  // Reset dirty flag whenever target teacher, month, or year changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setHoursDirty(false);
  }, [selectedTeacherId, selectedMonth, selectedYear]);

  const fetchDTR = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      if (!isFaculty && !selectedTeacherId && teacherList.length > 0) return;

      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const endpoint =
        !isFaculty && selectedTeacherId
          ? `${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${selectedTeacherId}/`
          : API_ROUTES.reports.dtr;

      if (!silent) setLoading(true);
      else setRefreshing(true);
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<any>(endpoint, {
          params: {
            month: selectedMonth,
            year: selectedYear,
            ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        const raw = res.data || {};
        const rawRows: any[] = Array.isArray(raw.rows)
          ? raw.rows
          : Array.isArray(raw.daily_logs)
          ? raw.daily_logs
          : [];

        const rowsByDay = new Map<number, any>();
        rawRows.forEach((r) => {
          if (r && typeof r.day === 'number') rowsByDay.set(r.day, r);
        });

        const rows31: DailyDTRRow[] = [];
        for (let dayNum = 1; dayNum <= 31; dayNum++) {
          const found = rowsByDay.get(dayNum);
          if (found) {
            rows31.push({
              day: dayNum,
              date_str: String(found.date_str || found.date || ''),
              day_of_week: String(found.day_of_week || found.weekday || ''),
              is_weekend: Boolean(found.is_weekend || found.status === 'WEEKEND'),
              am_arrival: String(found.am_arrival || ''),
              am_departure: String(found.am_departure || ''),
              pm_arrival: String(found.pm_arrival || ''),
              pm_departure: String(found.pm_departure || ''),
              undertime_hours: found.undertime_hours ?? '',
              undertime_minutes: found.undertime_minutes ?? '',
              is_loafing: Boolean(found.is_loafing),
              loafing_excused: Boolean(found.loafing_excused),
              loafing_remarks: String(found.loafing_remarks || ''),
            });
          } else {
            rows31.push({
              day: dayNum,
              date_str: '',
              day_of_week: '',
              is_weekend: false,
              am_arrival: '',
              am_departure: '',
              pm_arrival: '',
              pm_departure: '',
              undertime_hours: '',
              undertime_minutes: '',
              is_loafing: false,
              loafing_excused: false,
              loafing_remarks: '',
            });
          }
        }

        const resolvedMonthNum = Number(raw.month_number || selectedMonth);
        const resolvedMonthName =
          typeof raw.month === 'string' && isNaN(Number(raw.month))
            ? raw.month
            : MONTH_NAMES[resolvedMonthNum - 1] || 'Month';

        const regHrs = String(raw.regular_days_hours ?? raw.regular_hours ?? '');
        const satHrs = String(raw.saturdays_hours ?? raw.saturday_hours ?? '');

        if (!isInteracting.current) {
          setRegularHours(regHrs);
          setSaturdayHours(satHrs);
        }

        if (raw.faculty_id && !selectedTeacherId) {
          setSelectedTeacherId(String(raw.faculty_id));
        }

        setDtrData({
          faculty_id: Number(raw.faculty_id || raw.teacher_id || 0),
          faculty_name: String(raw.faculty_name || ''),
          employee_id: String(raw.employee_id || ''),
          department: String(raw.department || ''),
          month: resolvedMonthName,
          month_number: resolvedMonthNum,
          year: Number(raw.year || selectedYear),
          regular_days_hours: regHrs,
          saturdays_hours: satHrs,
          school_head: String(raw.school_head || raw.school?.school_head || ''),
          school_head_title: String(raw.school_head_title || raw.school?.principal_title || ''),
          dtr_submitted: Boolean(raw.dtr_submitted ?? raw.is_submitted),
          dept_head_approved: Boolean(raw.dept_head_approved ?? raw.is_dept_head_approved),
          can_approve_dept: Boolean(
            raw.can_approve_dept ?? ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(currentUserRole)
          ),
          can_clear_loafing: Boolean(
            raw.can_clear_loafing ?? ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(currentUserRole)
          ),
          rows: rows31,
          total_undertime_hours: Number(raw.total_undertime_hours || 0),
          total_undertime_minutes: Number(raw.total_undertime_minutes || 0),
          days_present: Number(raw.days_present || 0),
        });
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') return;
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load Daily Time Record.'));
        }
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [isFaculty, selectedTeacherId, selectedMonth, selectedYear, teacherList.length, currentUserRole]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDTR(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        fetchDTR(true, true);
      }
    }, 20000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  const handleSubmitDTR = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Certify & Submit DTR',
      message: `Certify and submit your Daily Time Record for ${dtrData.month} ${dtrData.year} to your Department Head for review?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Certify & Submit',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionProcessing(true);
        try {
          await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${dtrData.faculty_id}/`, {
            action: 'SUBMIT_DTR',
            faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
            month: dtrData.month_number,
            year: dtrData.year,
            regular_days_hours: sanitizeText(regularHours, 100),
            saturdays_hours: sanitizeText(saturdayHours, 100),
          });
          setHoursDirty(false);
          showAlert({
            title: 'DTR Submitted',
            message: 'Your Daily Time Record was submitted for Department Head approval.',
            type: 'success',
          });
          fetchDTR(true, true);
        } catch (err) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Submission Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not submit DTR.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionProcessing(false);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleApproveByDeptHead = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Approve Official DTR',
      message: `Approve the Daily Time Record for ${dtrData.faculty_name} (${dtrData.month} ${dtrData.year})? This removes the DRAFT watermark and unlocks printing.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Approve DTR',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionProcessing(true);
        try {
          await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${dtrData.faculty_id}/`, {
            action: 'APPROVE_DEPT_HEAD',
            faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
            month: dtrData.month_number,
            year: dtrData.year,
            regular_days_hours: sanitizeText(regularHours, 100),
            saturdays_hours: sanitizeText(saturdayHours, 100),
          });
          setHoursDirty(false);
          showAlert({
            title: 'DTR Approved',
            message: `Official DTR for ${dtrData.faculty_name} is now unlocked for printing.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
          fetchDTR(true, true);
        } catch (err) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Approval Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not approve DTR.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionProcessing(false);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleExcuseAlertByPrincipal = async () => {
    if (!dtrData || !selectedAlertRow) return;
    const cleanReason = sanitizeText(excuseRemarks, 240);
    if (!cleanReason) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Reason Required',
        message: 'Please enter official remarks explaining why this off-campus alert is excused.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setActionProcessing(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${dtrData.faculty_id}/`, {
        action: 'EXCUSE_LOAFING',
        faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
        date_str: selectedAlertRow.date_str,
        month: dtrData.month_number,
        year: dtrData.year,
        remarks: cleanReason,
      });
      showAlert({
        title: 'Alert Excused',
        message: `Off-campus alert on ${selectedAlertRow.date_str} has been marked as excused.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
      setSelectedAlertRow(null);
      setExcuseRemarks('');
      fetchDTR(true, true);
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Action Denied',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Only authorized leadership can excuse campus alerts.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setActionProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadPdf = async () => {
    if (!printAreaRef.current || !dtrData) return;
    if (!dtrData.dept_head_approved) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Approval Required',
        message: 'Department Head approval is required before exporting official PDF copies.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setExportingPdf(true);
    try {
      const html2pdfInstance = await loadHtml2PdfSecurely();
      const safeName = (dtrData.faculty_name || 'Teacher').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_');
      const opt = {
        margin: [0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15],
        filename: `CSC_Form_48_${safeName}_${dtrData.month}_${dtrData.year}.pdf`,
        image: { type: 'jpeg', quality: 0.98 },
        html2canvas: { scale: 2, useCORS: true, logging: false, scrollX: 0, scrollY: 0 },
        jsPDF: { unit: 'in', format: 'legal', orientation: 'portrait' },
        pagebreak: { mode: ['css', 'legacy'], after: '.csc-print-page' },
      };
      await html2pdfInstance().from(printAreaRef.current).set(opt).save();
    } catch {
      window.print();
    } finally {
      setExportingPdf(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    if (!dtrData?.dept_head_approved) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Printing Locked',
        message: 'Printing is locked until the Department Head approves this record.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }
    window.print();
  };

  const resolvedSchoolHead = (dtrData?.school_head || school.principal_name || '').trim();
  const resolvedSchoolHeadTitle = (dtrData?.school_head_title || school.principal_title || '').trim();

  const renderDTRCopy = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return null;

    return (
      <div style={formCardContainer}>
        {!dtrData.dept_head_approved && (
          <div style={draftWatermarkStyle}>
            <div style={{ transform: 'rotate(-32deg)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <div style={draftWatermarkText}>DRAFT</div>
              <div style={draftWatermarkSub}>PENDING DEPT HEAD APPROVAL</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 2 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '7.5pt', fontStyle: 'italic', fontFamily: "'Times New Roman', Times, serif" }}>
            Civil Service Form No. 48
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '11.5pt', fontWeight: 900, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.6px', marginTop: 1 }}>
            DAILY TIME RECORD
          </div>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 8, borderBottom: '1.2px solid #000', paddingBottom: 1, minHeight: 18 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '9.2pt', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
              {dtrData.faculty_name}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '6.5pt', fontStyle: 'italic', marginTop: 1 }}>(Name)</div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ fontSize: '6.8pt', marginBottom: 4, lineHeight: 1.25 }}>
          <div style={{ borderBottom: '0.8px solid #000', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
            <span>
              For the month of <u>&nbsp;<strong>{dtrData.month}</strong>&nbsp;</u>, {dtrData.year}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginTop: 3 }}>
            <div style={{ width: '46%', fontSize: '6.2pt', lineHeight: 1.15 }}>
              Official hours of arrival<br />
              and departure
            </div>
            <div style={{ width: '54%', fontSize: '6.2pt', lineHeight: 1.15 }}>
              <div>Regular Days: <u>{regularHours || '\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0'}</u></div>
              <div style={{ marginTop: 1 }}>Saturdays: <u>{saturdayHours || '\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0'}</u></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <table style={dtrTable}>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th rowSpan={2} style={{ width: '10%', ...dtrTh }}>Days</th>
              <th colSpan={2} style={dtrTh}>A. M.</th>
              <th colSpan={2} style={dtrTh}>P. M.</th>
              <th colSpan={2} style={dtrTh}>
                UNDER<br />TIME
              </th>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>ARRIVAL</th>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>DEPAR-<br />TURE</th>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>ARRIVAL</th>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>DEPAR-<br />TURE</th>
              <th style={{ width: '10%', ...dtrThSub }}>Hours</th>
              <th style={{ width: '10%', ...dtrThSub }}>Minutes</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {dtrData.rows.map((row) => {
              const hasOpenAlert = Boolean(row.is_loafing && !row.loafing_excused);

              return (
                <tr
                  key={row.day}
                  style={{
                    height: 14,
                    backgroundColor: hasOpenAlert ? '#fee2e2' : row.is_weekend ? '#fafafa' : '#ffffff',
                  }}
                >
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    {row.day}
                    {row.is_loafing && (
                      <span
                        onClick={() => dtrData.can_clear_loafing && setSelectedAlertRow(row)}
                        title={hasOpenAlert ? 'Off-campus alert. Click to review.' : 'Excused by Principal'}
                        style={{
                          marginLeft: 2,
                          fontSize: '5.2pt',
                          color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#059669',
                          cursor: dtrData.can_clear_loafing ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                        }}
                      >
                        {hasOpenAlert ? '(!)' : '(✓)'}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.am_arrival}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.am_departure}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.pm_arrival}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.pm_departure}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 800 : 400 }}>
                    {row.undertime_hours}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 800 : 400 }}>
                    {row.undertime_minutes}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}

            <tr style={{ height: 16, borderTop: '1.2px solid #000', fontWeight: 800 }}>
              <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, fontWeight: 900 }}>TOTAL</td>
              <td colSpan={4} style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, fontSize: '5.6pt' }}>
                Days Present: <strong>{dtrData.days_present}</strong> &bull; Undertime:
              </td>
              <td style={dtrTdCenter}>{dtrData.total_undertime_hours || ''}</td>
              <td style={dtrTdCenter}>{dtrData.total_undertime_minutes || ''}</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>

    ranks: [
      'Assistant School Principal I',
      'Assistant School Principal II',
      'School Principal I',
      'School Principal II',
      'School Principal III',
      'School Principal IV',
      'Secondary School Principal IV',
    ],
  },
  {
    category: 'Non-Teaching & Academic Support',
    ranks: [
      'Administrative Officer II',
      'Administrative Assistant',
      'School Registrar',
      'Guidance Counselor I',
    ],
  },
];

const FACULTY_DEPARTMENTS = [
  'Office of the Principal / Administration',
  'Junior High School',
  'Senior High School',
  'English Department',
  'Science Department',
  'Mathematics Department',
  'Filipino Department',
  'Araling Panlipunan Department',
  'MAPEH Department',
  'TLE / TVL Department',
  'Values Education / EsP Department',
  'Guidance & Counseling Office',
];

const SUFFIX_OPTIONS = ['', 'Jr.', 'Sr.', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V'];

const INITIAL_FORM_DATA = {
  employee_id: '',
  first_name: '',
  middle_name: '',
  last_name: '',
  suffix: '',
  position: 'Faculty I',
  department: 'Junior High School',
  contact_number: '',
  email: '',
  qr_token: '',
  photo: null as string | null,
};

export const FacultyTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const [facultys, setFacultys] = useState<Faculty[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [departmentFilter, setDepartmentFilter] = useState('');

  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<number>(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState<number>(25);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState<number>(1);
  const [totalCount, setTotalCount] = useState<number>(0);

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingFaculty, setEditingFaculty] = useState<Faculty | null>(null);
  const [inspectingFaculty, setInspectingFaculty] = useState<Faculty | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState(INITIAL_FORM_DATA);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const activeAbortController = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const isInteracting = useRef(false);
  isInteracting.current = isModalOpen || Boolean(inspectingFaculty);

  const handleCopy = async (text: string, id: string) => {
    let success = false;
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        success = true;
      } catch {
        success = false;
      }
    }
    if (!success) {
      try {
        const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textArea.value = text;
        textArea.style.position = 'fixed';
        textArea.style.left = '-999999px';
        document.body.appendChild(textArea);
        textArea.focus();
        textArea.select();
        success = document.execCommand('copy');
        textArea.remove();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Clipboard copy error:', err);
      }
    }
    if (success) {
      setCopiedKey(id);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
    }
  };

  const fetchFacultys = useCallback(
    async (page = 1, size = 25, query = '', deptVal = '', silent = false) => {
      if (activeAbortController.current) {
        activeAbortController.current.abort();
      }
      const controller = new AbortController();
      activeAbortController.current = controller;

      try {
        if (!silent) setLoading(true);
        setError(null);
        const isAll = size >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE;

        const res = await apiClient.get<PaginatedResponse<Faculty> | Faculty[]>('/v1/accounts/teachers/', {
          params: {
            page: isAll ? 1 : page,
            page_size: isAll ? 'ALL' : size,
            search: query.trim() || undefined,
            department: deptVal || undefined,
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        if (res.data && 'results' in res.data) {
          setFacultys(res.data.results);
          setTotalCount(res.data.count);
          setTotalPages(isAll ? 1 : res.data.total_pages || Math.ceil(res.data.count / size) || 1);
          setCurrentPage(isAll ? 1 : res.data.current_page || page);
        } else if (Array.isArray(res.data)) {
          setFacultys(res.data);
          setTotalCount(res.data.length);
          setTotalPages(1);
          setCurrentPage(1);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err.name === 'CanceledError' || err.name === 'AbortError') return;
        if (!silent) {
          setError('Unable to load faculty records. Please check server connectivity.');
        }
      } finally {
        if (!silent) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    []
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      setCurrentPage(1);
      fetchFacultys(1, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [search, departmentFilter, pageSize, fetchFacultys]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const liveInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current) {
        fetchFacultys(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true);
      }
    }, 4000);

    return () => clearInterval(liveInterval);
  }, [currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, fetchFacultys]);

  const handlePageChange = (newPage: number) => {
    if (newPage < 1 || newPage > totalPages) return;
    setCurrentPage(newPage);
    fetchFacultys(newPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false);
  };

  const handlePageSizeChange = (newSize: number) => {
    setPageSize(newSize);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    fetchFacultys(1, newSize, search, departmentFilter, false);
  };

  const handleExportFacultyCsv = () => {
    const suffix = pageSize >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE ? 'ALL' : `Page${currentPage}_${pageSize}rows`;
    const exported = exportToCsv(
      `AttendSure_Faculty_${suffix}.csv`,
      ['Employee ID', 'Full Name', 'Position', 'Department', 'Email', 'Contact', 'qr_id UID', 'Status'],
      facultys.map((f) => [
        f.employee_id,
        f.full_name,
        f.position,
        f.department,
        f.email || '',
        f.contact_number || '',
        f.qr_token || '',
        f.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE',
      ])
    );

    if (exported) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'CSV Exported',
        message: `Exported ${facultys.length} faculty records to CSV.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    }
  };

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'];
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Unsupported Image Format',
        message: 'Only JPG, PNG, and WebP image formats are accepted.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'File Too Large',
        message: 'Profile photos must be 2.5 MB or smaller.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      return;
    }

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      const base64String = reader.result as string;
      setPhotoPreview(base64String);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: base64String }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleRemovePhoto = () => {
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: '' }));
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
  };

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingFaculty(null);
    setFormData(INITIAL_FORM_DATA);
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (faculty: Faculty) => {
    setEditingFaculty(faculty);
    setFormData({
      employee_id: faculty.employee_id || '',
      first_name: faculty.first_name || '',
      middle_name: faculty.middle_name || '',
      last_name: faculty.last_name || '',
      suffix: faculty.suffix || '',
      position: faculty.position || 'Faculty I',
      department: faculty.department || 'Junior High School',
      contact_number: faculty.contact_number || '',
      email: faculty.email || '',
      qr_token: faculty.qr_token || '',
      photo: null,
    });
    setPhotoPreview(faculty.photo_url || faculty.photo || null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);

    const cleanedContact = formData.contact_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
    const cleanPayload: Record<string, any> = {
      employee_id: formData.employee_id.trim().toUpperCase(),
      first_name: formData.first_name.trim(),
      middle_name: formData.middle_name.trim(),
      last_name: formData.last_name.trim(),
      suffix: formData.suffix.trim(),
      position: formData.position.trim(),
      department: formData.department.trim(),
      email: formData.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
      contact_number: cleanedContact,
      qr_token: formData.qr_token.trim().toUpperCase() || null,
    };

    if (formData.photo !== null) {
      cleanPayload.photo = formData.photo === '' ? null : formData.photo;
    }

    try {
      if (editingFaculty) {
        const res = await apiClient.put<Faculty>(`/v1/accounts/teachers/${editingFaculty.id}/`, cleanPayload);
        setFacultys((prev) => prev.map((f) => (f.id === editingFaculty.id ? res.data : f)));
        showAlert({
          title: 'Profile Updated',
          message: `Saved changes for ${editingFaculty.first_name} ${editingFaculty.last_name}.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else {
        const res = await apiClient.post<Faculty>('/v1/accounts/teachers/', cleanPayload);
        setFacultys((prev) => [res.data, ...prev]);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Faculty Registered',
          message: `${cleanPayload.first_name} ${cleanPayload.last_name} registered successfully.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      }
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      fetchFacultys(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      const serverMessage =
        err.response?.data?.employee_id?.[0] ||
        err.response?.data?.qr_token?.[0] ||
        err.response?.data?.email?.[0] ||
        err.response?.data?.detail ||
        'Failed to save faculty record. Please verify details.';

      showAlert({
        title: 'Save Failed',
        message: serverMessage,
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const promptDelete = (faculty: Faculty) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Faculty Member',
      message: `Permanently delete ${faculty.full_name || faculty.first_name} (${faculty.employee_id}) from the faculty registry?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete Faculty',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`/v1/accounts/teachers/${faculty.id}/`);
          setFacultys((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.id !== faculty.id));
          if (inspectingFaculty?.id === faculty.id) setInspectingFaculty(null);
          showAlert({
            title: 'Faculty Removed',
            message: `Record for ${faculty.first_name} has been deleted.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
          fetchFacultys(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true);
        } catch (err: any) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Delete Failed',
            message: err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Unable to delete faculty member.',
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const activeFacultyCount = facultys.filter((f) => f.is_active).length;
  const pairedCardsCount = facultys.filter((f) => Boolean(f.qr_token && f.qr_token.trim().length > 0)).length;
  const uniqueDepartments = new Set(facultys.map((f) => f.department).filter(Boolean)).size;


  // Dynamic Theme-Driven Styles
  const dynamicStyles = useMemo(() => {
    return {
      container: {
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column' as const,
        gap: 16,
        padding: 'clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 20px)',
      },
      statsContainer: {
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 200px), 1fr))',
        gap: 14,
      },
      statCard: {
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        borderRadius: 14,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
        padding: '16px 18px',
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
      },
      statLabel: {
        fontSize: '0.66rem',
        fontWeight: 800,
        color: tokens.textMuted,
        letterSpacing: '0.4px',
        textTransform: 'uppercase' as const,
      },
      statValue: {
        fontSize: '1.60rem',
        fontWeight: 800,
        color: tokens.textPrimary,
        margin: '6px 0 2px 0',
      },
      statHelp: {
        fontSize: '0.70rem',
        color: tokens.textSecondary,
      },
      filterBar: {
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'center',
        flexWrap: 'wrap' as const,
        gap: 12,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        padding: '12px 18px',
        borderRadius: 12,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
      },
      searchInput: {
        width: 240,
        padding: '8px 12px 8px 34px',
        borderRadius: 8,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        color: tokens.textPrimary,
        fontSize: '0.82rem',
        outline: 'none',
      },
      selectInput: {
        padding: '8px 12px',
        borderRadius: 8,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        color: tokens.textPrimary,
        fontSize: '0.82rem',
        outline: 'none',
      },
      tableCard: {
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        borderRadius: 14,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
        overflow: 'hidden',
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
      },
      th: {
        padding: '12px 14px',
        fontSize: '0.72rem',
        fontWeight: 800,
        color: tokens.textMuted,
        textTransform: 'uppercase' as const,
        letterSpacing: '0.4px',
        borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
      },
      td: {
        padding: '12px 14px',
        fontSize: '0.80rem',
        color: tokens.textPrimary,
        borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
      },
      actionBtn: {
        width: 30,
        height: 30,
        borderRadius: 6,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        color: tokens.textSecondary,
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        cursor: 'pointer',
        transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
      },
    };
  }, [tokens, brand]);

  return (
    <div style={dynamicStyles.container}>
      {/* 1. Statistics Cards */}
      <div style={dynamicStyles.statsContainer}>
        <div style={dynamicStyles.statCard}>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statLabel}>TOTAL REGISTERED FACULTY</div>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statValue}>{totalCount || facultys.length}</div>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statHelp}>Teaching and non-teaching personnel</div>
        </div>

        <div style={dynamicStyles.statCard}>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statLabel}>ACTIVE ON DUTY</div>
          <div style={{ ...dynamicStyles.statValue, color: brand.success }}>{activeFacultyCount}</div>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statHelp}>Cleared for real-time tracking</div>
        </div>

        <div style={dynamicStyles.statCard}>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statLabel}>qr_id CARDS PAIRED</div>
          <div style={{ ...dynamicStyles.statValue, color: brand.primary }}>
            {pairedCardsCount}
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: tokens.textMuted, fontWeight: 500 }}>
              {' '}
              / {facultys.length}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statHelp}>Active smart ID credentials</div>
        </div>

        <div style={dynamicStyles.statCard}>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statLabel}>DEPARTMENTS</div>
          <div style={{ ...dynamicStyles.statValue, color: brand.secondary }}>{uniqueDepartments}</div>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statHelp}>Academic instructional units</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Controls & Filter Bar */}
      <div style={dynamicStyles.filterBar}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
            <Search size={14} color={tokens.textMuted} style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 10, top: 10 }} />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search faculty name, ID..."
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              style={dynamicStyles.searchInput}
            />
          </div>

          <select
            value={departmentFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setDepartmentFilter(e.target.value)}
            style={dynamicStyles.selectInput}
          >
            <option value="">All Departments</option>
            {FACULTY_DEPARTMENTS.map((dept) => (
              <option key={dept} value={dept}>{dept}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="md" onClick={handleExportFacultyCsv}>
            <Download size={14} />
            <span style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>Export CSV</span>
          </Button>

          <Button variant="primary" size="md" onClick={handleOpenCreate}>
            <Plus size={14} />
            <span style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>Add Faculty Member</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Faculty Table */}
      <div style={dynamicStyles.tableCard}>
        <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
          <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left' }}>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style={{ ...dynamicStyles.th, width: 50 }}>Photo</th>
                <th style={dynamicStyles.th}>Employee ID</th>
                <th style={dynamicStyles.th}>Full Name</th>
                <th style={dynamicStyles.th}>Position</th>
                <th style={dynamicStyles.th}>Department</th>
                <th style={dynamicStyles.th}>Contact</th>
                <th style={dynamicStyles.th}>qr_id Card UID</th>
                <th style={dynamicStyles.th}>Status</th>
                <th style={{ ...dynamicStyles.th, textAlign: 'right' }}>Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {loading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={9} style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={24} style={{ margin: '0 auto 8px auto', color: brand.primary }} />
                    <span>Loading faculty records...</span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : facultys.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={9} style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    No faculty members found matching your search.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                facultys.map((f) => (
                  <tr key={f.id}>
                    <td style={dynamicStyles.td}>
                      <div
                        style={{
                          width: 36,
                          height: 36,
                          borderRadius: '50%',
                          overflow: 'hidden',
                          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                          display: 'flex',
                          alignItems: 'center',
                          justifyContent: 'center',
                          border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                        }}
                      >
                        {f.photo_url || f.photo ? (
                          <img
                            src={f.photo_url || f.photo!}
                            alt={f.full_name}
                            style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <User size={16} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td style={{ ...dynamicStyles.td, fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                      {f.employee_id}
                    </td>
                    <td style={{ ...dynamicStyles.td, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                      {f.full_name}
                    </td>
                    <td style={dynamicStyles.td}>{f.position}</td>
                    <td style={{ ...dynamicStyles.td, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{f.department}</td>
                    <td style={dynamicStyles.td}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem' }}>{f.email || '—'}</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>{f.contact_number || '—'}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td style={dynamicStyles.td}>
                      {f.qr_token ? (
                        <span
                          onClick={() => handleCopy(f.qr_token!, `qr-${f.id}`)}
                          style={{
                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                            padding: '3px 8px',
                            borderRadius: 6,
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            display: 'inline-flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 4,
                          }}
                          title="Click to copy UID"
                        >
                          {copiedKey === `qr-${f.id}` ? <Check size={11} color={brand.success} /> : <Copy size={11} />}
                          <span>{f.qr_token}</span>
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Unassigned</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td style={dynamicStyles.td}>
                      <span
                        style={{
                          display: 'inline-flex',
                          alignItems: 'center',
                          gap: 4,
                          padding: '3px 8px',
                          borderRadius: 6,
                          fontSize: '0.68rem',
                          fontWeight: 800,

/**
 * AttendSure - Campus Exit Passes & Exit Clearances
 * File: web/src/components/tabs/GatePassesTab.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { ModuleTableLayout } from './ModuleTableLayout';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  Printer,
  QrCode,
  FileText,
  Plus,
  FileCheck,
  FileX,
  ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface GatePass {
  id: number;
  pass_number: string;
  bearer_type: 'STUDENT' | 'FACULTY';
  student?: number | null;
  student_name?: string;
  student_lrn?: string;
  faculty?: number | null;
  faculty_name?: string;
  faculty_emp_id?: string;
  pass_type: string;
  reason: string;
  valid_from: string;
  valid_to: string;
  status: 'PENDING' | 'ACTIVE' | 'USED' | 'DECLINED' | 'EXPIRED' | 'REVOKED';
  attachment_url?: string | null;
  adviser_name?: string;
  approved_by?: string;
}

interface StudentOption {
  id: number;
  lrn: string;
  full_name: string;
}

export const GatePassesTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { school } = useSchool();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const userRole = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const isPrincipalOrAdmin = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(userRole);
  const isRestrictedRole = userRole === 'PARENT';

  const [passes, setPasses] = useState<GatePass[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  const [selectedPass, setSelectedPass] = useState<GatePass | null>(null);
  const [reviewingPass, setReviewingPass] = useState<GatePass | null>(null);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const [students, setStudents] = useState<StudentOption[]>([]);
  const [loadingStudents, setLoadingStudents] = useState(false);
  const [passFormType, setPassFormType] = useState<'STUDENT' | 'FACULTY'>('STUDENT');

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    student_id: '',
    pass_type: 'Medical / Health Emergency',
    reason: '',
    valid_from: '',
    valid_to: '',
  });

  const [attachedFile, setAttachedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [declineReason, setDeclineReason] = useState('');
  const [showDeclineModal, setShowDeclineModal] = useState(false);

  const fetchPasses = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get<any>('/v1/attendance/exit-passes/', {
        params: {
          search: search.trim() || undefined,
          status: statusFilter !== 'ALL' ? statusFilter : undefined,
        },
      });
      const list = res.data?.results ?? (Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : []);
      setPasses(list);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to fetch gate passes.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [search, statusFilter]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchPasses();
  }, [fetchPasses]);

  const fetchStudents = async () => {
    setLoadingStudents(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get<any>('/v1/students/dropdown/');
      const list = res.data?.results ?? (Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : []);
      setStudents(list);
    } catch {
      setStudents([]);
    } finally {
      setLoadingStudents(false);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenCreateModal = (type: 'STUDENT' | 'FACULTY') => {
    setPassFormType(type);
    const now = new Date();
    const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    const toInputDate = (d: Date) =>
      `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;

    setFormData({
      student_id: '',
      pass_type: type === 'STUDENT' ? 'Clinic / Medical Clearance' : 'Official DepEd Travel Order',
      reason: '',
      valid_from: toInputDate(now),
      valid_to: toInputDate(new Date(now.getTime() + 4 * 3600000)),
    });
    setAttachedFile(null);

    if (type === 'STUDENT') {
      fetchStudents();
    }
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmitPass = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!attachedFile) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Proof Document Required',
        message: 'A proof document (medical referral, parent letter, or travel order) must be attached.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = new FormData();
      payload.append('bearer_type', passFormType);
      payload.append('pass_type', formData.pass_type);
      payload.append('reason', formData.reason.trim());
      payload.append('valid_from', new Date(formData.valid_from).toISOString());
      payload.append('valid_to', new Date(formData.valid_to).toISOString());
      payload.append('attachment', attachedFile);

      if (passFormType === 'STUDENT') {
        if (!formData.student_id) {
          showAlert({ title: 'Student Required', message: 'Please select a student.', type: 'warning' });
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        payload.append('student', formData.student_id);
      }

      await apiClient.post('/v1/attendance/exit-passes/', payload, {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
      });

      showAlert({
        title: passFormType === 'FACULTY' ? 'Travel Pass Submitted' : 'Student Exit Permit Issued',
        message:
          passFormType === 'FACULTY'
            ? 'Travel order submitted to Principal/Admin for document review.'
            : 'Adviser exit permit generated. Administration has been notified.',
        type: 'success',
      });

      setIsModalOpen(false);
      fetchPasses();
    } catch (err: any) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Submission Error',
        message: err?.response?.data?.attachment?.[0] || 'Unable to submit gate pass.',
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleApprove = async (passId: number) => {
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`/v1/attendance/exit-passes/${passId}/approve/`);
      showAlert({ title: 'Pass Approved', message: 'Travel pass approved and active for gate departure.', type: 'success' });
      setReviewingPass(null);
      fetchPasses();
    } catch {
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: 'Failed to approve pass.', type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleDecline = async () => {
    if (!reviewingPass) return;
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`/v1/attendance/exit-passes/${reviewingPass.id}/decline/`, {
        reason: declineReason.trim() || 'Declined upon document authenticity review.',
      });
      showAlert({ title: 'Pass Declined', message: 'Gate pass has been declined.', type: 'info' });
      setShowDeclineModal(false);
      setReviewingPass(null);
      fetchPasses();
    } catch {
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: 'Failed to decline pass.', type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleMarkUsed = async (passId: number) => {
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`/v1/attendance/exit-passes/${passId}/mark-used/`);
      showAlert({ title: 'Exit Confirmed', message: 'Bearer departure confirmed.', type: 'success' });
      fetchPasses();
    } catch (err: any) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Notice', message: err?.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to update.', type: 'warning' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16, padding: 'clamp(14px, 2.5vw, 24px)', boxSizing: 'border-box', width: '100%' }}>
      {/* Control Bar */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, padding: 14, borderRadius: 12, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {['ALL', 'PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'USED', 'DECLINED'].map((st) => (
            <button
              key={st}
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter(st)}
              style={{
                padding: '6px 14px',
                borderRadius: 20,
                fontSize: '0.74rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                border: `1px solid ${statusFilter === st ? brand.primary : tokens.borderStrong}`,
