    if (!document.getElementById('leaflet-css')) {
      const link = document.createElement('link');
      link.id = 'leaflet-css';
      link.rel = 'stylesheet';
      link.href = 'https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css';
      document.head.appendChild(link);
    }

    if (!document.getElementById('leaflet-js')) {
      const script = document.createElement('script');
      script.id = 'leaflet-js';
      script.src = 'https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js';
      script.async = true;
      script.onload = () => setLeafletReady(true);
      document.head.appendChild(script);
    } else {
      const existing = document.getElementById('leaflet-js');
      existing?.addEventListener('load', () => setLeafletReady(true));
    }

    return () => {
      if (mapInstanceRef.current) {
        mapInstanceRef.current.remove();
        mapInstanceRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const fetchGeofenceData = useCallback(
    async (silent: boolean = false) => {
      if (!silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<GeofenceData>('/v1/campus/boundary/', { timeout: 8000 });
        if (res.data) {
          setGeoData(res.data);
          if (!isDirtyRef.current) {
            const recLat = res.data.latitude !== null ? parseFloat(String(res.data.latitude)) : null;
            const recLng = res.data.longitude !== null ? parseFloat(String(res.data.longitude)) : null;
            const recRad = res.data.radius_meters !== null ? parseInt(String(res.data.radius_meters), 10) : null;

            if (recLat !== null && !isNaN(recLat)) setLat(recLat);
            if (recLng !== null && !isNaN(recLng)) setLng(recLng);
            if (recRad !== null && !isNaN(recRad)) setRadius(recRad);
          }
        }
      } catch {
        if (!silent) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Connection Notice',
            message: 'Unable to reach the school server for telemetry updates.',
            type: 'warning',
          });
        }
      } finally {
        if (!silent) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [showAlert]
  );

  const fetchAuditHistory = useCallback(
    async (silent: boolean = false) => {
      if (!silent) setAuditLoading(true);
      try {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        if (dateFilterMode === 'SPECIFIC_DATE' && auditDate) {
          params.append('date_from', auditDate);
        }
        if (auditFacultyFilter !== 'ALL') {
          params.append('faculty_id', auditFacultyFilter);
        }
        if (auditVerdictFilter !== 'ALL') {
          params.append('status', auditVerdictFilter);
        }
        if (auditSearchQuery.trim()) {
          params.append('search', auditSearchQuery.trim());
        }

        const res = await apiClient.get(`/v1/campus/audit/?${params.toString()}`, { timeout: 8000 });
        if (res.data?.records) {
          setAuditRecords(res.data.records);
          setTotalDatabaseRecords(res.data.total_heartbeats ?? res.data.records.length);
        }
      } catch {
        if (!silent) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Audit Log Error',
            message: 'Could not load geofence records from the server.',
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      } finally {
        if (!silent) setAuditLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [dateFilterMode, auditDate, auditFacultyFilter, auditVerdictFilter, auditSearchQuery, showAlert]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchGeofenceData(false);
  }, [fetchGeofenceData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const liveInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && !isDirtyRef.current) {
        if (activeScreen === 'LIVE_MAP') {
          fetchGeofenceData(true);
        } else if (activeScreen === 'AUDIT_SCREEN') {
          fetchAuditHistory(true);
        }
      }
    }, 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(liveInterval);
  }, [fetchGeofenceData, fetchAuditHistory, activeScreen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeScreen === 'AUDIT_SCREEN') {
      fetchAuditHistory(false);
    }
  }, [activeScreen, fetchAuditHistory]);

  // Leaflet Map Initialization with Tab Remount Recovery
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeScreen !== 'LIVE_MAP' || !leafletReady || !mapContainerRef.current) return;
    if (lat === null || lng === null) return;
    const L = window.L;

    const getTileUrl = (layer: 'streets' | 'satellite') => {
      if (layer === 'satellite') {
        return 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}';
      }
      return 'https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png';
    };

    if (mapInstanceRef.current && mapInstanceRef.current.getContainer() !== mapContainerRef.current) {
      try {
        mapInstanceRef.current.remove();
      } catch {}
      mapInstanceRef.current = null;
      markerInstanceRef.current = null;
      circleInstanceRef.current = null;
      userMarkersLayerRef.current = null;
      tileLayerRef.current = null;
    }

    if (!mapInstanceRef.current) {
      const map = L.map(mapContainerRef.current, {
        center: [lat, lng],
        zoom: 17,
        zoomControl: true,
      });

      tileLayerRef.current = L.tileLayer(getTileUrl(mapLayer), {
        maxZoom: 19,
        attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors',
      }).addTo(map);

      userMarkersLayerRef.current = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
      mapInstanceRef.current = map;

      setTimeout(() => {
        map.invalidateSize();
      }, 250);

      map.on('click', (e: any) => {
        if (!isAdmin) return;
        isDirtyRef.current = true;
        setLat(parseFloat(e.latlng.lat.toFixed(6)));
        setLng(parseFloat(e.latlng.lng.toFixed(6)));
      });
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => {
        mapInstanceRef.current?.invalidateSize();
      }, 150);
    }

    const currentMap = mapInstanceRef.current;

    if (tileLayerRef.current && (tileLayerRef.current as any)._layerType !== mapLayer) {
      currentMap.removeLayer(tileLayerRef.current);
      tileLayerRef.current = L.tileLayer(getTileUrl(mapLayer), { maxZoom: 19 }).addTo(currentMap);
      (tileLayerRef.current as any)._layerType = mapLayer;
    }

    const campusCenterIcon = L.divIcon({
      className: 'campus-center-beacon',
      html: `
        <div style="width: 36px; height: 36px; background-color: #004b87; border: 3px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,75,135,0.5); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #ffffff;">
          <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M20 10c0 6-8 12-8 12s-8-6-8-12a8 8 0 0 1 16 0Z"/>
            <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
      `,
      iconSize: [36, 36],
      iconAnchor: [18, 36],
    });

    if (markerInstanceRef.current) {
      markerInstanceRef.current.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
    } else {
      markerInstanceRef.current = L.marker([lat, lng], {
        icon: campusCenterIcon,
        draggable: isAdmin,
      }).addTo(currentMap);

      markerInstanceRef.current.on('dragend', (e: any) => {
        isDirtyRef.current = true;
        const pos = e.target.getLatLng();
        setLat(parseFloat(pos.lat.toFixed(6)));
        setLng(parseFloat(pos.lng.toFixed(6)));
      });
    }

    if (radius !== null) {
      if (circleInstanceRef.current) {
        circleInstanceRef.current.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
        circleInstanceRef.current.setRadius(radius);
      } else {
        circleInstanceRef.current = L.circle([lat, lng], {
          radius: radius,
          color: '#0284c7',
          weight: 2.5,
          fillColor: '#38bdf8',
          fillOpacity: 0.14,
          dashArray: '6, 6',
        }).addTo(currentMap);
      }
    }
  }, [activeScreen, leafletReady, lat, lng, radius, mapLayer, isAdmin]);

  const renderSignalBars = (percentage: number | null | undefined) => {
    if (percentage === null || percentage === undefined) {
      return <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.68rem' }}>—</span>;
    }

    const bars = [25, 50, 75, 100];
    const color = percentage >= 75 ? '#16a34a' : percentage >= 45 ? '#d97706' : '#dc2626';

    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 2, height: 14 }}>
        {bars.map((thresh, idx) => {
          const isActive = percentage >= thresh;
          const height = 4 + idx * 3;
          return (
            <span
              key={idx}
              style={{
                width: 3,
                height: height,
                backgroundColor: isActive ? color : '#cbd5e1',
                borderRadius: 1,
              }}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeScreen !== 'LIVE_MAP' || !leafletReady || !mapInstanceRef.current || !userMarkersLayerRef.current) return;
    const L = window.L;
    const layer = userMarkersLayerRef.current;
    layer.clearLayers();

    const faculty = geoData?.faculty_list || [];

    faculty.forEach((user: FacultyListItem) => {
      const userLat = parseFloat(String(user.latitude));
      const userLng = parseFloat(String(user.longitude));

      if (isNaN(userLat) || isNaN(userLng) || userLat === 0 || userLng === 0) return;

      const isOnline = Boolean(user.is_online);
      const isBreach = user.status === 'PERIMETER_BREACH' || user.status === 'OFF_CAMPUS';
      const isSpoof = user.is_mock_location || user.status === 'SPOOF_ATTEMPT';

      if ((isBreach || isSpoof) && lat !== null && lng !== null) {
        const linePath = [
          [lat, lng],
          [userLat, userLng],
        ];

        const connectingLine = L.polyline(linePath, {
          color: isSpoof ? '#dc2626' : isOnline ? '#e11d48' : '#94a3b8',
          weight: 2.5,
          opacity: isOnline ? 0.85 : 0.45,
          dashArray: '6, 8',
          lineCap: 'round',
        }).addTo(layer);

        connectingLine.bindTooltip(
          `
            <div style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; padding: 2px;">
              <strong style="color: #991b1b;">${user.faculty_name}</strong><br/>
              <span>Distance to School: <strong>${user.distance || '—'}</strong></span>
            </div>
          `,
          { sticky: true, opacity: 0.95 }
        );
      }

      const pinColor = isOnline ? '#16a34a' : '#64748b';
      const ringBg = isOnline ? 'rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.35)' : 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.15)';
      const statusLabel = isSpoof ? 'Fake GPS Blocked' : isBreach ? 'Outside School Grounds' : 'Inside School Grounds';
      const onlineTag = isOnline ? '● Online' : '○ Offline';

      const avatarSrc = user.photo_url || user.photo;
      const initials = (user.faculty_name || '')
        .split(' ')
        .map((n) => n[0])
        .slice(0, 2)
        .join('')
        .toUpperCase();

      const avatarInnerHtml = avatarSrc
        ? `<img src="${avatarSrc}" alt="${user.faculty_name}" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';" /><div style="display: none; width: 100%; height: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #f1f5f9; color: ${pinColor}; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px;">${initials}</div>`
        : `<div style="display: flex; width: 100%; height: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #f1f5f9; color: ${pinColor}; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px;">${initials}</div>`;

      const userLocationPinIcon = L.divIcon({
        className: 'user-location-pin-marker',
        html: `
          <div style="position: relative; width: 50px; height: 60px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.30));">
            ${
              isOnline
                ? `<div style="
                    position: absolute;
                    top: 0;
                    left: 1px;
                    width: 48px;
                    height: 48px;
                    border-radius: 50%;
                    background-color: ${ringBg};
                    animation: ping 2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
                    z-index: 0;
                  "></div>`
                : ''
            }

            <svg width="50" height="60" viewBox="0 0 50 60" fill="none" style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; z-index: 1;">
              <path d="M25 0C11.193 0 0 11.193 0 25C0 41.5 25 60 25 60C25 60 50 41.5 50 25C50 11.193 38.807 0 25 0Z" fill="${pinColor}"/>
              <circle cx="25" cy="25" r="21" fill="#ffffff"/>
            </svg>

            <div style="
              position: absolute;
              top: 4px;
              left: 4px;
              width: 42px;
              height: 42px;
              border-radius: 50%;
              overflow: hidden;
              background-color: #ffffff;
              z-index: 2;
            ">
              ${avatarInnerHtml}
            </div>

            <div style="
              position: absolute;
              top: 32px;
              right: 4px;
              width: 12px;
              height: 12px;
              border-radius: 50%;
              background-color: ${pinColor};
              border: 2px solid #ffffff;
              z-index: 4;
            "></div>

            <div style="
              position: absolute;
              top: 64px;
              z-index: 3;
              background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.94);
              color: #ffffff;
              font-size: 10px;
              font-weight: 800;
              padding: 2px 8px;
              border-radius: 4px;
              white-space: nowrap;
              box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.30);
              border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
              pointer-events: none;
            ">
              ${user.faculty_name} &bull; <span style="color: ${isOnline ? '#4ade80' : '#cbd5e1'}; font-weight: 800;">${onlineTag}</span> (${user.distance || '—'})
            </div>
          </div>
        `,
        iconSize: [50, 60],
        iconAnchor: [25, 60],
      });

      const marker = L.marker([userLat, userLng], { icon: userLocationPinIcon }).addTo(layer);

      const tooltipContent = `
        <div style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; min-width: 210px; padding: 4px;">
          <div style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; color: #0f172a; margin-bottom: 2px;">
            ${user.faculty_name}
          </div>
          <div style="color: #64748b; font-size: 10px; margin-bottom: 6px;">
            ID: ${user.employee_id} &bull; ${user.position || '—'}
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <span>Connection:</span>
            <strong style="color: ${isOnline ? '#16a34a' : '#64748b'};">
              ${user.connection_label || (isOnline ? 'Online' : 'Offline')}
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <span>Signal Strength:</span>
            <strong style="color: #004b87;">${user.signal_strength || '—'}</strong>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <span>Campus Boundary:</span>
            <strong style="color: ${isBreach ? '#dc2626' : '#16a34a'};">${statusLabel}</strong>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <span>Distance from School:</span>
            <strong>${user.distance || '—'}</strong>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <span>Device Battery:</span>
            <strong>${user.battery || '—'}</strong>
          </div>
          <div style="color: #004b87; font-size: 9px; font-family: monospace; margin-top: 4px; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-top: 3px;">
            IP: ${user.ip_address || '—'} &bull; Device ID: ${user.mac_address || user.bound_device_id || '—'}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      marker.bindTooltip(tooltipContent, {
        direction: 'top',
        offset: [0, -60],
        opacity: 0.98,
      });
    });
  }, [activeScreen, leafletReady, geoData, lat, lng, radius]);

  const handleFitAllOnMap = () => {
    if (!mapInstanceRef.current || !window.L || lat === null || lng === null) return;
    const L = window.L;
    const bounds = L.latLngBounds([[lat, lng]]);

    (geoData?.faculty_list || []).forEach((u) => {
      const uLat = parseFloat(String(u.latitude));
      const uLng = parseFloat(String(u.longitude));
      if (!isNaN(uLat) && !isNaN(uLng) && uLat !== 0) {
        bounds.extend([uLat, uLng]);
      }
    });

    mapInstanceRef.current.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [70, 70], maxZoom: 17 });
  };

  const handleDetectGPS = () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Hardware Error', message: 'GPS location is not supported by this browser.', type: 'error' });
      return;
    }

    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        isDirtyRef.current = true;
        const detectedLat = parseFloat(pos.coords.latitude.toFixed(6));
        const detectedLng = parseFloat(pos.coords.longitude.toFixed(6));
        setLat(detectedLat);
        setLng(detectedLng);
        if (mapInstanceRef.current) {
          mapInstanceRef.current.flyTo([detectedLat, detectedLng], 17);
        }
        showAlert({
          title: 'Location Centered',
          message: `Coordinates centered: ${detectedLat}°N, ${detectedLng}°E.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      },
      (err) => {
        showAlert({ title: 'Location Error', message: err.message, type: 'warning' });
      },
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000 }
    );
  };

  const handleSavePerimeter = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isAdmin || lat === null || lng === null || radius === null) return;

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put(
        '/v1/campus/boundary/',
        {
          latitude: lat,
          longitude: lng,
          radius_meters: radius,
        },
        { timeout: 8000 }
      );

      isDirtyRef.current = false;
      showAlert({
        title: 'Perimeter Saved',
        message: res.data?.message || 'School boundary updated successfully.',
        type: 'success',
      });
      refreshSchool();
      fetchGeofenceData(true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Save Failed',
        message: err.response?.data?.error || 'Could not update boundary parameters.',
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetDevice = (facultyId: number, facultyName: string) => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Reset Hardware Phone Lock',
      message: `Unbind the registered phone for ${facultyName}? This clears their device lock and allows them to pair a new phone on their next check-in.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Reset Device Lock',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setResettingId(facultyId);
        try {
          const res = await apiClient.post(`/v1/accounts/teachers/${facultyId}/reset-device/`);
          showAlert({
            title: 'Device Lock Cleared',
            message: res.data?.message || `Phone binding for ${facultyName} has been cleared.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
          fetchGeofenceData(true);
        } catch (err: any) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Reset Failed',
            message: err.response?.data?.error || 'Could not clear device binding.',
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setResettingId(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const exportAuditCSV = () => {
    if (auditRecords.length === 0) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Empty Export', message: 'No geofence records available to export.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }

    const headers = [
      'Timestamp (1m Interval)',
      'Faculty Member',
      'Employee ID',
      'Presence Verdict',
      'Distance from School',
      'Signal Strength',
      'IP Address',
      'MAC Address / Hardware ID',
      'Battery',
      'Device Model',
    ];
    const rows = auditRecords.map((r) => [
      `"${r.timestamp}"`,
      `"${r.faculty_name}"`,
      `"${r.employee_id}"`,
      `"${r.verdict === 'VERIFIED_INSIDE' ? 'Inside School Grounds' : 'Outside School Grounds'}"`,
      `"${r.distance || '—'}"`,
      `"${r.signal_strength || '—'}"`,
      `"${r.ip_address || '—'}"`,
      `"${r.mac_address || r.bound_device_id || '—'}"`,
      `"${r.battery || '—'}"`,
      `"${r.device_model || '—'}"`,
    ]);

    const csvContent =
      'data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,' + [headers.join(','), ...rows.map((e) => e.join(','))].join('\n');
    const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.setAttribute('href', encodedUri);
    link.setAttribute('download', `AttendSure_Geofence_Logs_${dateFilterMode === 'ALL_LOGS' ? 'All_Logs' : auditDate}.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (s: FacultyListItem) => {
    if (s.is_mock_location || s.status === 'SPOOF_ATTEMPT') {
      return (
        <span style={statusBadgeStyle('#fef2f2', '#dc2626', '#fecaca')}>
          <ShieldAlert size={11} style={{ marginRight: 3 }} /> Fake GPS Blocked
        </span>
      );
    }

    switch (s.status) {
      case 'VERIFIED_INSIDE':
        return (
          <span style={statusBadgeStyle('#ecfdf5', '#059669', '#a7f3d0')}>
            <Check size={11} style={{ marginRight: 3 }} /> Inside School Grounds
          </span>
        );
      case 'AUTHORIZED_LEAVE':
        return <span style={statusBadgeStyle('#eff6ff', '#004b87', '#bfdbfe')}>Official Gate Pass</span>;
      case 'HEARTBEAT_LOST':
        return <span style={statusBadgeStyle('#f1f5f9', '#64748b', '#cbd5e1')}>Signal Lost</span>;
      case 'PERIMETER_BREACH':
      case 'OFF_CAMPUS':
        return <span style={statusBadgeStyle('#fef2f2', '#dc2626', '#fecaca')}>Outside School Grounds</span>;
      case 'NOT_ON_DUTY':
      default:
        return <span style={statusBadgeStyle('#f8fafc', '#94a3b8', '#e2e8f0')}>Off Duty</span>;
    }
  };

                    onClick={() => setDateFilterMode('ALL_LOGS')}
                    style={{
                      padding: '6px 10px',
                      borderRadius: 6,
                      border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                      backgroundColor: dateFilterMode === 'ALL_LOGS' ? '#004b87' : '#ffffff',
                      color: dateFilterMode === 'ALL_LOGS' ? '#ffffff' : '#334155',
                      fontWeight: dateFilterMode === 'ALL_LOGS' ? 800 : 600,
                      fontSize: '0.74rem',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                    }}
                  >
                    All Logs
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setDateFilterMode('SPECIFIC_DATE')}
                    style={{

                <FileSpreadsheet size={13} />

            <div style={{ fontSize: '1.30rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a', marginTop: 6 }}>
              {totalDatabaseRecords}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: '#64748b', marginTop: 2 }}>
              {dateFilterMode === 'ALL_LOGS' ? 'All historical records (1m interval)' : `Records on ${auditDate}`}

          <div style={kpiCardStyle}>

            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: '#64748b', marginTop: 2 }}>
              Beyond allowed campus area
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={panelCardStyle}>
          <div style={{ padding: '12px 16px', borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                <span>Geofencing Logs (1-Minute Heartbeat Interval)</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', color: '#16a34a', backgroundColor: '#ecfdf5', padding: '1px 6px', borderRadius: 4, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                  Live Auto-Updating
                </span>
              </div>

            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b' }}>

            </span>
          </div>

          <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 900, borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.76rem' }}>

                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {auditRecords.length > 0 ? (

                    <tr key={r.id} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9' }}>

                        <div style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{r.time_only}</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>{r.date_only}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px' }}>
                        <strong style={{ color: '#0f172a' }}>{r.faculty_name}</strong>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', color: '#94a3b8', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                          ID: {r.employee_id}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px' }}>
                        {r.is_inside ? (
                          <span style={statusBadgeStyle('#ecfdf5', '#059669', '#a7f3d0')}>
                            <Check size={10} style={{ marginRight: 3 }} /> Inside School Grounds
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span style={statusBadgeStyle('#fef2f2', '#dc2626', '#fecaca')}>
                            <AlertTriangle size={10} style={{ marginRight: 3 }} /> Outside School Grounds
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px' }}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5 }}>
                          {renderSignalBars(r.signal_percentage)}
                          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#334155', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                            {r.signal_strength || '—'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700, color: r.is_inside ? '#059669' : '#dc2626' }}>
                        {r.distance || '—'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'monospace', color: '#004b87', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>
                        {r.ip_address || '—'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'monospace', color: '#475569', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>
                        {r.mac_address || r.bound_device_id || '—'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', color: '#475569' }}>{r.battery || '—'}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={8} style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '30px', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                      {auditLoading ? 'Loading geofence logs...' : 'No geofence logs found matching your filters.'}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Standard Module Table Layout
 * File: frontend/src/components/tabs/ModuleTableLayout.tsx
 *
 * Standard layout wrapper providing:
 * 1. Consistent title, subtitle, and search filter headers.
 * 2. Support for extra actions (filters, selectors) and bottom pagination slots.
 * 3. Type-safe ReactNode imports compliant with verbatimModuleSyntax.
 * 4. Responsive table overflow wrapper for station and tablet displays.
 * 5. Defensive data unwrapping for direct arrays and paginated API payloads.
 */

import React, { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Search, Plus, Loader2, AlertCircle, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';

export interface Column<T> {
  header: string;
  render: (item: T, index?: number) => ReactNode;
  align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right';
  width?: string | number;
}

export interface ModuleTableLayoutProps<T> {
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  searchValue: string;
  onSearchChange: (value: string) => void;
  addButtonLabel?: string;
  onAdd?: () => void;
  extraActions?: ReactNode;
  pagination?: ReactNode;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  columns: Column<T>[];
  data: T[];
  keyExtractor: (item: T) => string | number;
}

export function ModuleTableLayout<T>({
  title,
  subtitle,
  searchPlaceholder = 'Search records...',
  searchValue,
  onSearchChange,
  addButtonLabel,
  onAdd,
  extraActions,
  pagination,
  loading,
  error,
  columns,
  data,
  keyExtractor,
}: ModuleTableLayoutProps<T>) {
  // Defensive unwrapping: handles plain arrays, DRF paginated responses, or nested data
  const tableItems: T[] = Array.isArray(data)
    ? data
    : (data as any)?.results && Array.isArray((data as any).results)
    ? (data as any).results
    : (data as any)?.data && Array.isArray((data as any).data)
    ? (data as any).data
    : [];

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', width: '100%' }}>
      {/* 1. Header Toolbar */}
      <div style={headerContainer}>
        <div>
          <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.15rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a', letterSpacing: '-0.3px' }}>
            {title}
          </h3>
          <p style={{ margin: '3px 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.80rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
            {subtitle}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {/* Search Input with Clear Button */}
          <div style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <Search
              size={15}
              color="#94a3b8"
              style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 10, pointerEvents: 'none' }}
            />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
              value={searchValue}
              onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
              style={searchInputStyle}
            />
            {searchValue && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onSearchChange('')}
                title="Clear search"
                style={clearSearchBtn}
              >
                <X size={13} color="#94a3b8" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Optional Action Slot (Filters, Export Buttons, etc.) */}
          {extraActions && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
              {extraActions}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Standard Primary Action Button */}
          {addButtonLabel && onAdd && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="md"
              type="button"
              onClick={onAdd}
              style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}
            >
              <Plus size={16} />
              <span>{addButtonLabel}</span>
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Error Banner */}
      {error && (
        <div style={errorBanner}>
          <AlertCircle size={18} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 3. Table Container */}
      <div style={tableContainer}>
        {loading ? (
          <div style={loadingState}>
            <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={24} color="#0284c7" />
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>Querying database records...</span>
          </div>
        ) : tableItems.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={emptyState}>
            No matching database records found.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto', width: '100%' }}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.84rem' }}>
              <thead>
                <tr style={{ backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0', color: '#475569', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                  {columns.map((col, idx) => (
                    <th
                      key={idx}
                      style={{
                        padding: '12px 16px',
                        textAlign: col.align || 'left',
                        width: col.width || undefined,
                        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      }}
                    >
                      {col.header}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {tableItems.map((item, index) => {
                  const itemKey = keyExtractor(item) ?? index;
                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={itemKey}
                      style={{
                        borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                        transition: 'background-color 0.15s ease',
                      }}
                    >
                      {columns.map((col, cIdx) => (
                        <td
                          key={cIdx}
                          style={{
                            padding: '12px 16px',
                            textAlign: col.align || 'left',
                            verticalAlign: 'middle',
                          }}
                        >
                          {col.render(item, index)}
                        </td>
                      ))}
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 4. Bottom Pagination Slot */}
        {pagination && (
          <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0', backgroundColor: '#ffffff' }}>
            {pagination}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ModuleTableLayout;

export interface StudentItem {
  id: number;
  lrn: string;
  name: string;
  gender: string;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  attendance_status: string;
  parent_contact?: string;
  qr_token?: string;
}

export interface AssignedClass {
  schedule_id: number;
  section_id: number;
  section_name: string;
  grade_level?: string;
  display_name: string;
  subject_code: string;
  subject_title: string;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string;
  time_display?: string;
  room_number?: string;
  total_students: number;
  students: StudentItem[];
  is_adviser?: boolean;
}

type ViewScope = 'MY_CLASSES' | 'ALL_CLASSES';
type StatusFilter = 'ALL' | 'PRESENT' | 'LATE' | 'CUTTING' | 'UNSCANNED';

const copyTextSafely = async (textToCopy: string): Promise<boolean> => {
  const cleanText = String(textToCopy || '').trim();
  if (!cleanText) return false;

  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(cleanText);
      return true;
    } catch {
      // Fall through to legacy copy helper on non-HTTPS LAN origins
    }
  }

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
    textArea.value = cleanText;
    textArea.setAttribute('readonly', '');
    textArea.style.position = 'fixed';
    textArea.style.top = '-9999px';
    document.body.appendChild(textArea);
    textArea.select();
    let copied = false;
    try {
      copied = document.execCommand('copy');
    } catch {
      copied = false;
    }
    document.body.removeChild(textArea);
    return copied;
  }
  return false;
};

const extractGradeLevelText = (val: unknown): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') return val.trim();
  if (typeof val === 'number') return `Grade ${val}`;
  if (typeof val === 'object') {
    const obj = val as Record<string, unknown>;
    const label = obj.name ?? obj.level ?? obj.grade_name ?? obj.grade;
    return label ? String(label).trim() : '';
  }
  return String(val).trim();
};

const maskQrToken = (token?: string): string => {
  const clean = String(token || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return '';
  return clean.length <= 4 ? 'Linked' : `••••${clean.slice(-4)}`;
};

const formatStatusLabel = (status: string): string => {
  const code = status.toUpperCase();
  if (code === 'UNSCANNED') return 'NOT SCANNED';
  return code;
};

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<StatusFilter>('ALL');

              id: Number(st.id) || 0,
              lrn: String(st.lrn || '—').trim(),
              name: fullName,
              gender: String(st.sex || st.gender || '—').trim(),
              photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(rawPhoto) ? rawPhoto : null,
              attendance_status: String(st.attendance_status || 'UNSCANNED').toUpperCase(),
              parent_contact: String(st.parent_contact || '').trim(),
              qr_token: String(st.qr_token || '').trim(),
            };
          });

          const sectionName = String(item.section_name || item.name || 'Section').trim();
          const subjectTitle = String(item.subject_title || item.subject_name || 'Homeroom').trim();
          const startTime = item.start_time ? String(item.start_time).slice(0, 5) : '';
          const endTime = item.end_time ? String(item.end_time).slice(0, 5) : '';
          const timeDisplay =
            String(item.time_display || '').trim() ||
            (startTime && endTime ? `${startTime} - ${endTime}` : 'Homeroom');
          const roomVal = String(item.room_number || item.room || '').trim();

          return {
            schedule_id: Number(item.schedule_id || item.id || idx + 1),
            section_id: Number(item.section_id || idx + 1),
            section_name: sectionName,
            grade_level: extractGradeLevelText(item.grade_level),
            display_name: String(item.display_name || `${sectionName} • ${subjectTitle}`),
            subject_code: String(item.subject_code || 'CLASS'),
            subject_title: subjectTitle,
            start_time: startTime,
            end_time: endTime,
            time_display: timeDisplay,
            room_number: roomVal || '—',
            total_students: students.length || Number(item.total_students) || 0,
            students,
            is_adviser: Boolean(item.is_adviser),
          };

            ) ||

          );
        });
      } catch (err: unknown) {

        if (!silent) {

/**
 * AttendSure - Theme-Adaptive Parent & Teacher Direct Messaging
 * File: web/src/components/tabs/ParentChatTab.tsx
 */

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { MessageSquare, RefreshCw, Send, Trash2, User } from 'lucide-react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES } from '../../api/routes';
import { useApiResource } from '../../hooks/useApiResource';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

interface ChatThread {
  thread_key: string;
  student_id: number;
  student_name: string;
  section: string;
  faculty_id: number;
  parent_name: string;
  last_message: string;
  unread_count: number;
}

interface ChatMessageItem {
  id: number;
  sender_name: string;
  is_mine: boolean;
  body: string;
  time_only: string;
}

export const ParentChatTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { data: payload, loading: loadingThreads, reload: reloadThreads } = useApiResource<{ threads: ChatThread[] }>(
    API_ROUTES.messaging.threads,
    { threads: [] }
  );

  const threads = Array.isArray(payload?.threads) ? payload.threads : [];
  const [selectedThread, setSelectedThread] = useState<ChatThread | null>(null);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessageItem[]>([]);
  const [loadingMessages, setLoadingMessages] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const bottomRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (threads.length > 0 && !selectedThread) setSelectedThread(threads[0]);
  }, [threads, selectedThread]);

  const loadMessages = useCallback(async (thread: ChatThread, silent = false) => {
    if (silent && document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return;
    if (!silent) setLoadingMessages(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.messaging.messages, {
        params: { student_id: thread.student_id, teacher_id: thread.faculty_id, ...(silent ? { nocache: 1 } : {}) },
      });
      setMessages(Array.isArray(res.data?.messages) ? res.data.messages : []);
    } catch {
      // Handled gracefully
    } finally {
      if (!silent) setLoadingMessages(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedThread) return;
    loadMessages(selectedThread, false);
    const timer = setInterval(() => loadMessages(selectedThread, true), 12000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [selectedThread, loadMessages]);

  useEffect(() => {
    bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages]);

  const handleSend = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedThread || !draft.trim() || sending) return;
    const body = draft.trim();
    setDraft('');
    setSending(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.messaging.messages, {
        student_id: selectedThread.student_id,
        teacher_id: selectedThread.faculty_id,
        body,
      });
      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, res.data]);
      reloadThreads(true);
    } catch {
      setDraft(body);
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteMessage = async (id: number) => {
    await apiClient.delete(API_ROUTES.messaging.messages, { params: { id } }).catch(() => {});
    setMessages((prev) => prev.filter((m) => m.id !== id));
  };

  const filteredThreads = threads.filter((t) => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return !q || t.student_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || t.parent_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || t.section.toLowerCase().includes(q);
  });

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(260px, 320px) 1fr', gap: 16, padding: 18, height: 'calc(100vh - 140px)' }}>
      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <div style={{ padding: 14, borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <strong style={{ fontSize: '0.90rem', color: tokens.textPrimary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <MessageSquare size={16} color={brand.primary} /> Parent Threads
            </strong>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => reloadThreads(false)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
              <RefreshCw size={14} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <input type="text" value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search learner or parent..." style={ui.input} />
        </div>

        <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
          {loadingThreads ? (
            <div style={{ padding: 16, fontSize: '0.8rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Loading threads...</div>
          ) : filteredThreads.length === 0 ? (
            <div style={{ padding: 16, fontSize: '0.8rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>No linked parent accounts in your classes yet.</div>
          ) : (
            filteredThreads.map((t) => {
              const active = selectedThread?.thread_key === t.thread_key;
              return (
                <button
                  key={t.thread_key}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedThread(t)}
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    textAlign: 'left',
                    padding: '12px 14px',
                    border: 'none',
                    borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                    backgroundColor: active ? tokens.primaryLight : 'transparent',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                    <strong style={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{t.student_name}</strong>
                    {t.unread_count > 0 && <span style={ui.badge(brand.primary, '#ffffff')}>{t.unread_count}</span>}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 2 }}>
                    Parent: {t.parent_name} &bull; {t.section}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textMuted, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', marginTop: 2 }}>
                    {t.last_message}
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        {!selectedThread ? (
          <div style={{ margin: 'auto', color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: '0.86rem' }}>Select a learner conversation on the left.</div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div style={{ padding: '12px 16px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{selectedThread.student_name} ({selectedThread.section})</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5 }}>
                  <User size={12} /> Guardian: <strong>{selectedThread.parent_name}</strong>
                </div>
              </div>
              <span style={ui.badge(tokens.successLight, brand.success)}>Mobile Push Active</span>
            </div>

            <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', padding: 16, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10, backgroundColor: tokens.bgCanvas }}>
              {loadingMessages ? (
                <div style={{ color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>Loading messages...</div>
              ) : messages.length === 0 ? (
                <div style={{ margin: 'auto', color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>No messages yet. Say hello to {selectedThread.parent_name}.</div>
              ) : (
                messages.map((m) => (
                  <div
                    key={m.id}
                    style={{
                      alignSelf: m.is_mine ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start',
                      maxWidth: '74%',
                      backgroundColor: m.is_mine ? brand.primary : tokens.bgSurface,
                      color: m.is_mine ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textPrimary,
                      padding: '10px 14px',
                      borderRadius: 12,
                      border: m.is_mine ? 'none' : `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                    }}
                  >
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 10, fontSize: '0.68rem', opacity: 0.85, marginBottom: 4, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                      <span>{m.sender_name} &bull; {m.time_only}</span>
                      {m.is_mine && (
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => handleDeleteMessage(m.id)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0 }}>
                          <Trash2 size={11} />
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>{m.body}</div>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
              <div ref={bottomRef} />
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSend} style={{ padding: 12, borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
              <input type="text" value={draft} onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)} placeholder={`Message ${selectedThread.parent_name}...`} style={ui.input} />
              <button type="submit" disabled={sending || !draft.trim()} style={ui.btnPrimary}>
                <Send size={14} /> {sending ? 'Sending...' : 'Send'}
              </button>
            </form>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ParentChatTab;

/**
 * AttendSure - Mobile Push Notifications & Parent Alerts Center (Zero Hardware Bloat)
 * File: web/src/components/tabs/PushNotificationsTab.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { StatsCard } from '../common/StatsCard';
import { ControlSwitch } from '../ui/ControlSwitch';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { Bell, CheckCircle2, Plus, RefreshCw, Send, Smartphone, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface NotificationRow {
  id: number;
  student: number | null;
  student_name: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  category: string;
  is_read: boolean;
  is_pushed: boolean;
  created_at: string;
}

type CategoryFilter = 'ALL' | 'ATTENDANCE' | 'CUTTING_ALERT' | 'GATE_PASS' | 'ANNOUNCEMENT';

export const PushNotificationsTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const [rows, setRows] = useState<NotificationRow[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState<CategoryFilter>('ALL');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusStats, setStatusStats] = useState({ sentToday: 0, pushedToday: 0, activeStudents: 0 });

  const [composeOpen, setComposeOpen] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ title: '', message: '', category: 'ANNOUNCEMENT' });

  const fetchAlerts = useCallback(async (silent = false) => {
    if (!silent) setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [notifRes, sysRes] = await Promise.all([
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications, { params: { page_size: 100 } }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.reports.systemStatus),
      ]);
      const list = Array.isArray(notifRes.data) ? notifRes.data : notifRes.data?.results || [];
      setRows(list);
      if (sysRes.data) {
        setStatusStats({
          sentToday: Number(sysRes.data.push_alerts_today || 0),
          pushedToday: Number(sysRes.data.push_delivered_today || 0),
          activeStudents: Number(sysRes.data.active_students || 0),
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (!silent) showAlert({ title: 'Load Error', message: extractApiError(err), type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      if (!silent) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [showAlert]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAlerts(false);
  }, [fetchAlerts]);

  const handleCreate = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.title.trim() || !form.message.trim()) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications, {
        title: form.title.trim(),
        message: form.message.trim(),
        category: form.category,
      });
      setComposeOpen(false);
      setForm({ title: '', message: '', category: 'ANNOUNCEMENT' });
      fetchAlerts(true);
      showAlert({ title: 'Alert Dispatched', message: 'Mobile push notification saved and queued.', type: 'success' });
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Dispatch Error', message: extractApiError(err), type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkAllRead = async () => {
    await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.messaging.markRead, {});
    fetchAlerts(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: number) => {
    await apiClient.delete(`${API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications}${id}/`);
    setRows((prev) => prev.filter((r) => r.id !== id));
  };

  const filtered = rows.filter((r) => {
    if (categoryFilter !== 'ALL' && r.category !== categoryFilter) return false;
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return true;
    return (
      r.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      r.message.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (r.student_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  });

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(210px, 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
        <StatsCard label="ALERTS CREATED TODAY" value={statusStats.sentToday} helpText="Attendance, cutting & exit alerts" badge={<Bell size={18} color={brand.primary} />} />
        <StatsCard label="EXPO PUSH DELIVERED" value={statusStats.pushedToday} valueColor={brand.success} helpText="Delivered to mobile devices" badge={<Smartphone size={18} color={brand.success} />} />
        <StatsCard label="UNREAD IN INBOX" value={rows.filter((r) => !r.is_read).length} helpText="Awaiting recipient read receipt" badge={<CheckCircle2 size={18} color={brand.secondary} />} />
      </div>

      <div style={{ ...ui.card, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10 }}>
        <ControlSwitch<CategoryFilter>
          options={[
            { value: 'ALL', label: 'All Alerts' },
            { value: 'ATTENDANCE', label: 'Attendance' },
            { value: 'CUTTING_ALERT', label: 'Cutting Alerts' },
            { value: 'GATE_PASS', label: 'Exit Passes' },
            { value: 'ANNOUNCEMENT', label: 'Announcements' },
          ]}
          value={categoryFilter}
          onChange={setCategoryFilter}
          size="sm"
        />

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search alerts..."
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 200 }}
          />
          <button type="button" onClick={handleMarkAllRead} style={ui.btnSecondary}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={14} /> Mark All Read
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => fetchAlerts(false)} style={ui.btnSecondary}>
            <RefreshCw size={14} className={loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''} /> Refresh
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setComposeOpen(true)} style={ui.btnPrimary}>
            <Plus size={14} /> New Notice
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflowX: 'auto' }}>
        <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left' }}>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th style={ui.th}>Category</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Student</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Title &amp; Message</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Delivery</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Created</th>
              <th style={{ ...ui.th, textAlign: 'right' }}>Action</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {loading ? (
              <tr><td colSpan={6} style={{ padding: 32, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Loading notifications...</td></tr>
            ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <tr><td colSpan={6} style={{ padding: 32, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>No notifications match the current filter.</td></tr>
            ) : (
              filtered.map((item) => (
                <tr key={item.id}>
                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <span style={ui.badge(tokens.primaryLight, brand.primary)}>{item.category}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td style={ui.td}>{item.student_name || 'General'}</td>
                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <strong style={{ display: 'block', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{item.title}</strong>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{item.message}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <span style={ui.badge(item.is_pushed ? tokens.successLight : tokens.infoLight, item.is_pushed ? brand.success : brand.secondary)}>
                      {item.is_pushed ? 'PUSHED' : 'IN-APP'}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...ui.td, fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    {new Date(item.created_at).toLocaleString()}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...ui.td, textAlign: 'right' }}>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => handleDelete(item.id)} style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, color: brand.danger, padding: '5px 8px' }}>
                      <Trash2 size={13} />
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <Modal isOpen={composeOpen} onClose={() => setComposeOpen(false)} title="Send Mobile Push Notice">
        <form onSubmit={handleCreate} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Category</label>
            <select value={form.category} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, category: e.target.value })} style={ui.input}>
              <option value="ANNOUNCEMENT">School Announcement</option>
              <option value="ATTENDANCE">Attendance Notice</option>
              <option value="GATE_PASS">Exit Pass Notice</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Title *</label>
            <input required maxLength={150} value={form.title} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })} style={ui.input} placeholder="e.g. Early Dismissal Advisory" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Message *</label>
            <textarea required rows={3} maxLength={500} value={form.message} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, message: e.target.value })} style={ui.input} placeholder="Write plain-English message..." />
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" type="button" onClick={() => setComposeOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button variant="primary" type="submit" loading={submitting} icon={<Send size={14} />}>Send Alert</Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

// Cybersecurity helper: blocks dangerous URI schemes
const isSafeImageUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = url.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || clean === 'null' || clean === 'undefined' || clean === 'none') return false;
  if (clean.startsWith('javascript:') || clean.startsWith('vbscript:')) return false;
  return clean.startsWith('http://') || clean.startsWith('https://') || clean.startsWith('/') || clean.startsWith('data:image/');
};

// Reads user role from local storage safely
const getUserRole = (): string => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user') || localStorage.getItem('user');
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return String(parsed.role || parsed.system_role || '').toUpperCase();
    }
    return String(localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || '').toUpperCase();
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
};

const getSectionDisplayName = (sec: SectionOption): string => {
  return sec.name || sec.section_name || `Section #${sec.id}`;
};

interface ProfileAvatarProps {
  photoUrl?: string | null;
  name?: string;
  size?: number;
  iconSize?: number;
}

const ProfileAvatar: React.FC<ProfileAvatarProps> = ({
  photoUrl,
  name = 'Faculty',
  size = 30,
  iconSize = 15,
}) => {
  const [imageFailed, setImageFailed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setImageFailed(false);
  }, [photoUrl]);

  const safePhoto = isSafeImageUrl(photoUrl) ? photoUrl : null;

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: '50%',
        backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
        border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
      title={name}
    >
      {safePhoto && !imageFailed ? (
        <img
          src={safePhoto}
          alt={name}
          style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
          onError={() => setImageFailed(true)}
          loading="lazy"
        />
      ) : (
        <UserIcon size={iconSize} color="#94a3b8" />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export const SchedulesTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();

  const [schedules, setSchedules] = useState<ScheduleItem[]>([]);
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionOption[]>([]);
  const [facultyList, setFacultyList] = useState<FacultyOption[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>('');

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedSectionFilter, setSelectedSectionFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [modalTab, setModalTab] = useState<AcademicTabType>('SCHEDULE');
  const [editItem, setEditItem] = useState<any>(null);

  const isInteracting = useRef(false);
  isInteracting.current = isModalOpen;

  const isMounted = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const userRole = useMemo(() => getUserRole(), []);
  const canManageSchedule = useMemo(() => {
    return ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(userRole) || userRole === '';
  }, [userRole]);

  // Read stored identity for advisory identification
  const loggedInFacultyName = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      localStorage.getItem('attendsure_faculty_name') ||
      localStorage.getItem('faculty_name') ||
      ''
    ).trim().toLowerCase();
  }, []);

  const loggedInUsername = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') ||
      localStorage.getItem('username') ||
      ''
    ).trim().toLowerCase();
  }, []);

  // Check if a section is the advisory class of the logged-in faculty
  const isSectionAdvisoryForUser = useCallback((sec: SectionOption): boolean => {
    if (sec.is_adviser) return true;

    if (loggedInUsername) {
      if (sec.adviser_employee_id && sec.adviser_employee_id.toLowerCase() === loggedInUsername) {
        return true;
      }
    }

    if (loggedInFacultyName) {
      if (sec.adviser_name && sec.adviser_name.toLowerCase().includes(loggedInFacultyName)) {
        return true;
      }
      if (sec.adviser_full_name && sec.adviser_full_name.toLowerCase().includes(loggedInFacultyName)) {
        return true;
      }
      if (typeof sec.adviser === 'string' && sec.adviser.toLowerCase().includes(loggedInFacultyName)) {
        return true;
      }
      if (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser) {
        const advName = (sec.adviser.full_name || sec.adviser.name || '').toLowerCase();
        if (advName && (advName.includes(loggedInFacultyName) || loggedInFacultyName.includes(advName))) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    return false;
  }, [loggedInFacultyName, loggedInUsername]);

  // Resolves the logged-in faculty's advisory section
  const myAdvisorySection = useMemo(() => {
    return sections.find((sec) => isSectionAdvisoryForUser(sec)) || null;
  }, [sections, isSectionAdvisoryForUser]);

  // Resilient data loading using Promise.allSettled
  const loadData = useCallback(async (silent = false) => {
    if (!silent) setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const results = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get('/v1/school/periods/?page_size=500'),
        apiClient.get('/v1/school/sections/?page_size=500'),
        apiClient.get('/v1/accounts/teachers/dropdown/'),
      ]);

      if (!isMounted.current) return;

      const schedRes = results[0].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[0].value : null;
      const secRes = results[1].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[1].value : null;
      const facRes = results[2].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[2].value : null;

      if (schedRes?.data) {
        const schedData = Array.isArray(schedRes.data) ? schedRes.data : schedRes.data?.results || [];
        setSchedules(schedData);
      }

      if (secRes?.data) {
        const secData = Array.isArray(secRes.data) ? secRes.data : secRes.data?.results || [];
        setSections(secData);
      }

      if (facRes?.data) {
        const facData = Array.isArray(facRes.data) ? facRes.data : facRes.data?.results || [];
        setFacultyList(facData);
      }

      if (results[0].status === 'rejected' && results[1].status === 'rejected') {
        const errReason: any = results[0].reason;
        const status = errReason?.response?.status;
        const detail = errReason?.response?.data?.detail || errReason?.response?.data?.error || errReason?.message;
        setError(`[Error ${status || 'Network'}] Could not load timetable data: ${detail}`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      if (!silent) {
        setError(`Could not load timetable records. Please check server connection.`);
      }
    } finally {
      if (!silent && isMounted.current) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData(false);
  }, [loadData]);

  // Auto-select the advisory section for faculty members on initial load
  const hasAutoSelectedRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasAutoSelectedRef.current && myAdvisorySection && userRole === 'FACULTY') {
      setSelectedSectionFilter(String(myAdvisorySection.id));
      hasAutoSelectedRef.current = true;
    }
  }, [myAdvisorySection, userRole]);

  // Background refresh when tab is visible
  useEffect(() => {
    const liveInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && isMounted.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        loadData(true);
      }
    }, 12000);

    return () => clearInterval(liveInterval);
  }, [loadData]);

  const handleDelete = (id: number, code: string) => {
    if (!canManageSchedule) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Access Denied',
        message: 'Only school administrators can delete class schedules.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Class Schedule',
      message: `Are you sure you want to delete class period "${code}"? The assigned subject faculty will be unassigned.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete Schedule',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`/v1/school/periods/${id}/`);
          if (isMounted.current) {
            setSchedules((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
          }
          showAlert({
            title: 'Schedule Removed',
            message: `Schedule ${code} was deleted successfully.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
          loadData(true);
        } catch (err: any) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Delete Error',
            message: err?.response?.data?.detail || err?.response?.data?.error || err.message || 'Failed to delete schedule period.',
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleOpenModal = (tab: AcademicTabType, item: any = null) => {
    setModalTab(tab);
    setEditItem(item);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCloseModal = () => {
    setIsModalOpen(false);
    setEditItem(null);
  };

  const formatTime = (timeStr?: string) => {
    if (!timeStr) return '--:--';
    const parts = timeStr.split(':');
    if (parts.length < 2) return timeStr;
    let hours = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
    const minutes = parts[1];
    const ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    hours = hours % 12 || 12;
    const strHours = hours < 10 ? `0${hours}` : `${hours}`;
    return `${strHours}:${minutes} ${ampm}`;
  };

  const getScheduleCode = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    return item.schedule_code || item.code || `SCH-${String(item.id).padStart(4, '0')}`;
  };

  // Fixed faculty resolution without duplicate checks
  const getFacultyInfo = useCallback((item: ScheduleItem) => {
    let name = 'Unassigned';
    let photo: string | null = null;
    let employeeId = '';

    if (item.faculty_name && item.faculty_name.trim() !== '') {
      name = item.faculty_name.trim();
    } else if (item.faculty_title && item.faculty_title.trim() !== '') {
      name = item.faculty_title.trim();
    } else if (typeof item.faculty === 'object' && item.faculty) {
      name = item.faculty.full_name || item.faculty.name || name;
      photo = item.faculty.photo_url || item.faculty.photo || null;
      employeeId = item.faculty.employee_id || '';
    }

    let targetFacultyId: number | undefined;
    if (typeof item.faculty_id === 'number') {
      targetFacultyId = item.faculty_id;
    } else if (typeof item.faculty === 'number') {
      targetFacultyId = item.faculty;
    } else if (typeof item.faculty === 'string' && !isNaN(Number(item.faculty))) {
      targetFacultyId = Number(item.faculty);
    } else if (typeof item.faculty === 'object' && item.faculty && typeof item.faculty.id === 'number') {
      targetFacultyId = item.faculty.id;
    }

    if (targetFacultyId !== undefined) {
      const matched = facultyList.find((f) => f.id === targetFacultyId);
      if (matched) {
        name = matched.full_name || matched.name || name;
        photo = matched.photo_url || matched.photo || photo;
        employeeId = matched.employee_id || employeeId;
      }
    }

    return { name, photo, employeeId };
  }, [facultyList]);

  const getSubjectCode = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.subject_code) return item.subject_code;
    if (typeof item.subject === 'object' && item.subject) {
      return item.subject.code || item.subject.title || item.subject.name || '—';
    }
    if (typeof item.subject === 'string') return item.subject;
    return item.subject ? `SUB-${item.subject}` : '—';
  };

  const getSubjectName = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.subject_title) return item.subject_title;
    if (item.subject_name) return item.subject_name;
    if (typeof item.subject === 'object' && item.subject) {
      return item.subject.title || item.subject.name || '';
    }
    return '';
  };

  const getSectionName = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.section_name) return item.section_name;
    if (typeof item.section === 'object' && item.section) {
      return item.section.name || item.section.section_name || `Section #${item.section.id}`;
    }
    return item.section ? `Section #${item.section}` : 'Unassigned';
  };

  const getRoomDisplay = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.room_number) return item.room_number;
    if (item.room_name) return item.room_name;
    if (typeof item.room === 'object' && item.room) {
      return item.room.room_number || item.room.name || '—';
    }
    if (typeof item.room === 'string') return item.room;
    if (item.room) return `Rm ${item.room}`;
    return '—';
  };

  // Safe search query sanitization
  const cleanSearchQuery = useMemo(() => {
    return searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 60);
  }, [searchQuery]);

  const filteredSchedules = useMemo(() => {
    return schedules.filter((s) => {
      if (selectedSectionFilter !== 'ALL') {
        const secId = typeof s.section === 'object' && s.section ? s.section.id : s.section;
        const matchesId = String(secId) === selectedSectionFilter;
        const matchesName = String(s.section_name) === selectedSectionFilter;
        if (!matchesId && !matchesName) return false;
      }

      if (cleanSearchQuery !== '') {
        const code = getScheduleCode(s).toLowerCase();
        const sec = getSectionName(s).toLowerCase();
        const sub = (getSubjectCode(s) + ' ' + getSubjectName(s)).toLowerCase();
        const fac = getFacultyInfo(s).name.toLowerCase();
        const rm = getRoomDisplay(s).toLowerCase();

        return (
          code.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          sec.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          sub.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          fac.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          rm.includes(cleanSearchQuery)
        );
      }

      return true;
    });
