/**
 * AttendSure - Global Modern Alert & Confirmation System
 * File: web/src/context/AlertContext.tsx
 *
 * Cybersecurity & Stability Hardening:
 * 1. Safe Type Parsing: Converts raw objects/arrays to clean text to prevent UI render crashes.
 * 2. Unhandled Exception Shield: Encapsulates async confirmations in try-catch-finally.
 * 3. Keyboard & Focus Trap Protection: Adds native Escape key dismiss handlers.
 * 4. Fast Auto-Dismiss: Closes non-critical success notifications automatically after 3.5 seconds.
 */

import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  useCallback,
  useRef,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  XCircle,
  Info,
  X,
  Loader2,
} from 'lucide-react';

export type AlertType = 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';

export interface AlertOptions {
  title: string;
  message: string | unknown;
  type?: AlertType;
  actionLabel?: string;
  autoCloseDuration?: number; // Milliseconds (defaults to 3500ms for success)
  onAction?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
}

export interface ConfirmOptions {
  title: string;
  message: string | unknown;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  isDestructive?: boolean;
  onConfirm: () => Promise<void> | void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
}

interface AlertContextType {
  showAlert: (options: AlertOptions) => void;
  showConfirm: (options: ConfirmOptions) => void;
  closeAlert: () => void;
  closeConfirm: () => void;
}

const AlertContext = createContext<AlertContextType | undefined>(undefined);

/**
 * Defensive Sanitizer: Ensures message is always a safe, readable string.
 * Prevents React child injection crashes from raw backend error dictionaries.
 */
const toSafeString = (val: unknown): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') return val;
  if (typeof val === 'number' || typeof val === 'boolean') return String(val);
  if (val instanceof Error) return val.message;
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(val);
  } catch {
    return 'An unexpected system event occurred.';
  }
};

export const AlertProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [alertData, setAlertData] = useState<AlertOptions | null>(null);
  const [confirmData, setConfirmData] = useState<ConfirmOptions | null>(null);
  const [isConfirmLoading, setIsConfirmLoading] = useState(false);

  const autoCloseTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const closeAlert = useCallback(() => {
    if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
      autoCloseTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    if (alertData?.onClose) {
      alertData.onClose();
    }
    setAlertData(null);
  }, [alertData]);

  const closeConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    if (isConfirmLoading) return;
    if (confirmData?.onCancel) {
      confirmData.onCancel();
    }
    setConfirmData(null);
  }, [confirmData, isConfirmLoading]);

  const showAlert = useCallback(
    (options: AlertOptions) => {
      if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
        autoCloseTimerRef.current = null;
      }

      setAlertData({
        ...options,
        title: toSafeString(options.title) || 'Notification',
        message: toSafeString(options.message),
      });

      // Auto-dismiss success notifications to keep workflows fast
      if (options.type === 'success' && !options.actionLabel) {
        const duration = options.autoCloseDuration ?? 3500;
        autoCloseTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          closeAlert();
        }, duration);
      }
    },
    [closeAlert]
  );

  const showConfirm = useCallback((options: ConfirmOptions) => {
    setConfirmData({
      ...options,
      title: toSafeString(options.title) || 'Confirm Action',
      message: toSafeString(options.message),
    });
  }, []);

  // Keyboard navigation protection (Escape key closes modals)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (confirmData && !isConfirmLoading) {
          closeConfirm();
        } else if (alertData) {
          closeAlert();
        }
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [alertData, confirmData, isConfirmLoading, closeAlert, closeConfirm]);

  const handleConfirmAction = async () => {
    if (!confirmData || isConfirmLoading) return;
    try {
      setIsConfirmLoading(true);
      await confirmData.onConfirm();
      setConfirmData(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[AlertContext] Confirm action failed:', err);
      // Display error modal if confirmation action throws
      showAlert({
        title: 'Action Error',
        message: err,
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsConfirmLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAlertAction = () => {
    if (alertData?.onAction) {
      alertData.onAction();
    }
    closeAlert();
  };

  const getAlertIcon = (type: AlertType) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'success':
        return <CheckCircle2 size={24} color="#059669" />;
      case 'error':
        return <XCircle size={24} color="#dc2626" />;
      case 'warning':
        return <AlertTriangle size={24} color="#d97706" />;
      case 'info':
      default:
        return <Info size={24} color="#0284c7" />;
    }
  };

  const getAlertColorTheme = (type: AlertType) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'success':
        return { bg: '#ecfdf5', border: '#a7f3d0' };
      case 'error':
        return { bg: '#fef2f2', border: '#fecaca' };
      case 'warning':
        return { bg: '#fffbeb', border: '#fde68a' };
      case 'info':
      default:
        return { bg: '#f0f9ff', border: '#bae6fd' };
    }
  };

  return (
    <AlertContext.Provider value={{ showAlert, showConfirm, closeAlert, closeConfirm }}>
      {children}

      {/* 1. INFORMATIONAL / ACTION ALERT MODAL */}
      {alertData && (
        <div style={overlayStyle} role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
          <div style={modalBoxStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  ...iconContainerStyle,
                  backgroundColor: getAlertColorTheme(alertData.type || 'info').bg,
                  border: `1px solid ${getAlertColorTheme(alertData.type || 'info').border}`,
                }}
              >
                {getAlertIcon(alertData.type || 'info')}
              </div>

              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.96rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                  {alertData.title}
                </h3>
                <p
                  style={{
                    margin: '6px 0 0 0',
                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    color: '#475569',
                    lineHeight: 1.45,
                    wordBreak: 'break-word',
                  }}
                >
                  {String(alertData.message)}
                </p>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={closeAlert}
                style={closeBtnStyle}
                title="Close"
                aria-label="Close alert"
              >
                <X size={16} color="#64748b" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 16 }}>
              {alertData.actionLabel ? (
                <>
                  <button type="button" onClick={closeAlert} style={secondaryBtnStyle}>
                    Dismiss
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={handleAlertAction} style={primaryBtnStyle}>
                    {alertData.actionLabel}
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <button type="button" onClick={closeAlert} style={primaryBtnStyle}>
                  Okay
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. CONFIRMATION DIALOG MODAL */}
      {confirmData && (
        <div style={overlayStyle} role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
          <div style={modalBoxStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  ...iconContainerStyle,
                  backgroundColor: confirmData.isDestructive ? '#fef2f2' : '#eff6ff',
                  border: `1px solid ${confirmData.isDestructive ? '#fecaca' : '#bfdbfe'}`,
                }}
              >
                {confirmData.isDestructive ? (
                  <AlertTriangle size={24} color="#dc2626" />
                ) : (
                  <Info size={24} color="#0284c7" />
                )}
              </div>

              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.96rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                  {confirmData.title}
                </h3>
                <p
                  style={{
                    margin: '6px 0 0 0',
                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    color: '#475569',
                    lineHeight: 1.45,
                    wordBreak: 'break-word',
                  }}
                >
                  {String(confirmData.message)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 18 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isConfirmLoading}
                onClick={closeConfirm}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
              >
                {confirmData.cancelLabel || 'Cancel'}
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isConfirmLoading}
                onClick={handleConfirmAction}
                style={{
                  ...primaryBtnStyle,
                  backgroundColor: confirmData.isDestructive ? '#dc2626' : '#0284c7',
                }}
              >
                {isConfirmLoading ? (
                  <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} />
                ) : null}
                {confirmData.confirmLabel || 'Confirm'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </AlertContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAlert = () => {
  const context = useContext(AlertContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAlert must be used within an AlertProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

  school_logo: null,
  left_logo: null,
  right_logo: null,
  latitude: null,
  longitude: null,
  geofence_radius_meters: 150,
  academic_year: '',
};

const sanitizeCachedSchool = (raw: Partial<SchoolData>): SchoolData => {
  const merged = { ...EMPTY_SCHOOL, ...raw };
  // Purge legacy mock placeholder ID if present in browser storage
  if (merged.school_id === '55555' || merged.school_id === '000000') {
    merged.school_id = '';
  }
  return merged;
};

const hasActiveToken = (): boolean =>
  Boolean(localStorage.getItem('attendsure_access') || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token'));

interface SchoolContextValue {
  school: SchoolData;
  loading: boolean;
  refreshSchool: () => Promise<void>;
  updateSchool: (data: Partial<SchoolData>) => void;
  updateSchoolInstantly: (data: Partial<SchoolData>) => void;
}

const SchoolContext = createContext<SchoolContextValue>({
  school: EMPTY_SCHOOL,
  loading: false,
  refreshSchool: async () => {},
  updateSchool: () => {},
  updateSchoolInstantly: () => {},
});

export const SchoolProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [school, setSchool] = useState<SchoolData>(() => {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_school_profile');
      if (cached) return sanitizeCachedSchool(JSON.parse(cached));
    } catch {
      // Ignore malformed cache
    }
    return EMPTY_SCHOOL;
  });

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(
    () => hasActiveToken() && !localStorage.getItem('attendsure_school_profile')
  );

  const applySchoolUpdate = useCallback((patch: Partial<SchoolData>) => {
    setSchool((prev) => {
      const updated = sanitizeCachedSchool({ ...prev, ...patch });
      try {
        const storageSafe = { ...updated };
        if (storageSafe.school_logo && storageSafe.school_logo.length > 300000) storageSafe.school_logo = null;
        if (storageSafe.left_logo && storageSafe.left_logo.length > 300000) storageSafe.left_logo = null;
        if (storageSafe.right_logo && storageSafe.right_logo.length > 300000) storageSafe.right_logo = null;
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_school_profile', JSON.stringify(storageSafe));
      } catch {
        // Ignore quota limits
      }
      return updated;
    });
  }, []);

  const fetchSchoolData = useCallback(async () => {
    const endpoint = hasActiveToken()
      ? API_ROUTES.school.settings
      : '/v1/school/public-branding/';
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get<SchoolData>(endpoint, { timeout: 6000 });
      if (res.data) applySchoolUpdate(res.data);
    } catch {
      // Keep clean cached state if offline
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [applySchoolUpdate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchSchoolData();
  }, [fetchSchoolData]);

  return (
    <SchoolContext.Provider
      value={{
        school,
        loading,
        refreshSchool: fetchSchoolData,
        updateSchool: applySchoolUpdate,
        updateSchoolInstantly: applySchoolUpdate,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </SchoolContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useSchool = () => useContext(SchoolContext);
export default SchoolContext;

/**
 * ============================================================================
 * ATTENDSURE  - THEME CONTEXT & CSS VARIABLE ENGINE
 * File: web/src/context/ThemeContext.tsx
 *
 * PURPOSE:
 * Controls Light, Dark, and High-Contrast Daylight modes across the entire app.
 * Automatically updates CSS variables (--bg-surface, --text-primary, etc.)
 * and provides ready-made `ui` styles to every component.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  THEME_PALETTES,
  BRAND_COLORS,
  FONTS,
  RADIUS,
  createStyles,
  type ThemeMode,
  type ThemeTokens,
} from '../theme/tokens';

interface ThemeContextValue {
  mode: ThemeMode;
  setThemeMode: (mode: ThemeMode) => void;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  tokens: ThemeTokens;
  brand: typeof BRAND_COLORS.light;
  fonts: typeof FONTS;
  radius: typeof RADIUS;
  ui: ReturnType<typeof createStyles>;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextValue | undefined>(undefined);
const STORAGE_KEY = 'attendsure_theme_mode';

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ThemeMode>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) as ThemeMode;
    return saved && THEME_PALETTES[saved] ? saved : 'light';
  });

  const setThemeMode = (nextMode: ThemeMode) => {
    setMode(nextMode);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, nextMode);
  };

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    const order: ThemeMode[] = ['light', 'dark', 'high-contrast'];
    const next = order[(order.indexOf(mode) + 1) % order.length];
    setThemeMode(next);
  };

  const tokens = THEME_PALETTES[mode];
  const brand = BRAND_COLORS[mode];
  const ui = useMemo(() => createStyles(tokens, brand), [tokens, brand]);

  // Sync CSS variables onto <html> so CSS files and common components automatically change color
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', mode);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-app', tokens.bgApp);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-canvas', tokens.bgCanvas);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-surface', tokens.bgSurface);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-surface-subtle', tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-primary', tokens.textPrimary);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-secondary', tokens.textSecondary);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-muted', tokens.textMuted);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-subtle', tokens.borderSubtle);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-strong', tokens.borderStrong);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-primary', brand.primary);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-button-bg', brand.buttonBg);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-success', brand.success);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-warning', brand.warning);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-danger', brand.danger);
    root.style.setProperty('--card-shadow', tokens.cardShadow);
    root.style.setProperty('--font-sans', FONTS.sans);
  }, [mode, tokens, brand]);

  // Keyboard shortcut: Alt + T cycles color themes
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 't') {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleTheme();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [mode]);

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider
      value={{ mode, setThemeMode, toggleTheme, tokens, brand, fonts: FONTS, radius: RADIUS, ui }}
    >
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useTheme = (): ThemeContextValue => {
  const ctx = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useTheme must be used inside ThemeProvider');
  return ctx;
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Zero-Lag SWR Data Hook (Instant Cache Hydration + Keep-Previous-Data)
 * File: web/src/hooks/useApiResource.ts
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache, subscribeApiCache } from '../api/client';
import { extractApiError } from '../api/routes';

export function useApiResource<T>(
  endpoint: string,
  initialValue: T,
  params?: Record<string, unknown>
) {
  const paramsKey = JSON.stringify(params || {});
  const stableParams = useMemo<Record<string, unknown> | undefined>(
    () => (paramsKey === '{}' ? undefined : JSON.parse(paramsKey)),
    [paramsKey]
  );

  const initialCached = useMemo(
    () => peekApiCache<T>(endpoint, stableParams),
    [endpoint, stableParams]
  );

  const [data, setData] = useState<T>(() =>
    initialCached !== undefined ? initialCached : initialValue
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => initialCached === undefined);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const hasDataRef = useRef<boolean>(initialCached !== undefined);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return subscribeApiCache(endpoint, stableParams, (freshPayload) => {
      hasDataRef.current = true;
      setData(freshPayload as T);
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    });
  }, [endpoint, stableParams]);

  const reload = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const warmHit = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<T>(endpoint, stableParams) : undefined;
      if (warmHit !== undefined) {
        hasDataRef.current = true;
        setData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
      } else if (!silent && !hasDataRef.current) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }

      setError(null);

      try {
        const reqParams = bypassCache
          ? { ...(stableParams || {}), nocache: 1 }
          : stableParams;
        const res = await apiClient.get<T>(endpoint, {
          params: reqParams,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        hasDataRef.current = true;
        setData(res.data);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') return;
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Unable to load records.'));
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [endpoint, stableParams]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void reload(hasDataRef.current, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [reload]);

  return { data, setData, loading, refreshing, error, reload };
}

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP } from '../types/pageSetup';
import type { PageSetupConfig } from '../types/pageSetup';

const GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY = 'attendsure_page_setup_default';

export const usePageSetup = (reportKey: string = 'general') => {
  const specificKey = `attendsure_page_setup_${reportKey}`;

  const loadInitial = (): PageSetupConfig => {
    try {
      const specific = localStorage.getItem(specificKey);
      if (specific) return JSON.parse(specific);

      const globalDefault = localStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY);
      if (globalDefault) return JSON.parse(globalDefault);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to parse page setup from local storage', e);
    }
    return DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP;
  };

  const [config, setConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(loadInitial);

  // Sync state if localStorage changes from another tab/window
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => {
      if (e.key === specificKey || e.key === GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY) {
        setConfig(loadInitial());
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
  }, [specificKey]);

  const saveConfig = useCallback(
    (newConfig: PageSetupConfig, setAsGlobalDefault: boolean = false) => {
      setConfig(newConfig);
      localStorage.setItem(specificKey, JSON.stringify(newConfig));
      if (setAsGlobalDefault) {
        localStorage.setItem(GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY, JSON.stringify(newConfig));
      }
    },
    [specificKey]
  );

  return { config, saveConfig };
};

export const isSafeImageUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = url.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || clean === 'null' || clean === 'undefined' || clean === 'none') return false;
  if (clean.startsWith('javascript:') || clean.startsWith('vbscript:')) return false;
  if (clean.startsWith('data:') && !clean.startsWith('data:image/')) return false;
  return (
    clean.startsWith('http://') ||
    clean.startsWith('https://') ||
    clean.startsWith('/') ||
    clean.startsWith('data:image/') ||
    clean.startsWith('blob:')
  );
};

export const sanitizeText = (text: string, maxLength = 150): string => {
  return String(text || '').replace(/[<>]/g, '').trim().slice(0, maxLength);
};

}

/** Preloads both the Vite code chunk and PostgreSQL JSON data when hovering a Sidebar item. */
let hoverPrefetchTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

const prefetchTabResources = (tab: NavItemKey): void => {
  if (hoverPrefetchTimer) clearTimeout(hoverPrefetchTimer);
  hoverPrefetchTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    const now = new Date();
    switch (tab) {
      case 'dashboard':
        void loadDashboard();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard);
        break;
      case 'classroom-scanner':
        void loadScanner();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, { summary: 1 });
        break;
      case 'my-classes':
        void loadMyClasses();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes);
        break;
      case 'advisory-monitor':
        void loadAdvisory();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.attendance.adviserMatrix);
        break;
      case 'students':
        void loadStudents();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.students.metrics);
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.students.list, { page: 1, page_size: 25 });
        break;
      case 'facultys':
        void loadFaculty();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.accounts.teachers, { page: 1, page_size: 25 });
        break;
      case 'users':
        void loadUsers();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.accounts.users, { page_size: 'ALL' });
        break;
      case 'gate-passes':
        void loadGatePasses();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses);
        break;
      case 'schedules':
        void loadSchedules();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.school.periods, { page_size: 500 });
        break;
      case 'dtr':
        void loadDtr();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.reports.dtr, { month: now.getMonth() + 1, year: now.getFullYear() });
        break;
      case 'geofence':
        void loadGeofence();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.campus.boundary);
        break;
      case 'messages':
        void loadParentChat();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.messaging.threads);
        break;
      case 'push':
        void loadPush();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications, { page_size: 100 });
        break;
      case 'reports':
        void loadSf1();
        void loadSf2();
        void loadSf4();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.school.sections);
        break;
      case 'settings':
        void loadSettings();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.school.settings);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }, 120);
};

const AppContent: React.FC = () => {
  const { school, loading: isSchoolLoading } = useSchool();
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const [session, setSession] = useState<UserSession | null>(() => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token') || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_access');
    if (!token) return null;
    const username = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || '';
    return {
      user_id: Number(localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_id') || 0),
      token,
      username,
      faculty_name: localStorage.getItem('attendsure_faculty_name') || username || 'Staff User',
      role: localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY',
    };
  });

  const [userPhoto, setUserPhoto] = useState<string | null>(() => localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_photo'));
  const [canTeach, setCanTeach] = useState<boolean>(() => localStorage.getItem('attendsure_can_teach') === 'true');
  const [isCompleteProfileModalOpen, setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isProfileModalOpen, setIsProfileModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<NavItemKey>('dashboard');
  const [selectedReport, setSelectedReport] = useState<'sf1' | 'sf2' | 'sf4'>('sf1');
  const [isSidebarCollapsed, setIsSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [isServerOnline, setIsServerOnline] = useState(true);
  const [isCheckingServer, setIsCheckingServer] = useState(false);

  const userRole = (session?.role || '').toUpperCase();

  const allowedTabs = useMemo<NavItemKey[]>(() => {
    if (!userRole) return [];
    const tabs = [...(BASE_ROLE_PERMISSIONS[userRole] || BASE_ROLE_PERMISSIONS.FACULTY)];
    if (canTeach) {
      (['my-classes', 'classroom-scanner', 'advisory-monitor', 'messages'] as NavItemKey[]).forEach((t) => {
        if (!tabs.includes(t)) tabs.push(t);
      });
    }
    return tabs;
  }, [userRole, canTeach]);

  const isAllowed = allowedTabs.includes(activeTab);

  // Warm up primary endpoints & code chunks right after sign-in without blocking UI paint
useEffect(() => {
    if (!session?.token || !userRole) return;
    warmupRoleEndpoints(userRole, canTeach);
    const chunkTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      void loadMyClasses();
      void loadScanner();
      void loadStudents();
      void loadDtr();
    }, 800);
    return () => clearTimeout(chunkTimer);
  }, [session?.token, userRole, canTeach]);

  const handleAuthExpired = useCallback(() => {
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_access');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_refresh');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_token');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_username');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_faculty_name');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_role');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_user_id');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_user_photo');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_can_teach');
    setSession(null);
    setUserPhoto(null);
    setCanTeach(false);
    setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    window.addEventListener('attendsure:auth-expired', handleAuthExpired);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('attendsure:auth-expired', handleAuthExpired);
  }, [handleAuthExpired]);

  const handleTabSelection = useCallback(
    (tab: NavItemKey) => {
      if (!allowedTabs.includes(tab)) return;
      startTransition(() => {
        setActiveTab(tab);
      });
    },
    [allowedTabs]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const onNavigate = (e: Event) => {
      const detail = (e as CustomEvent<string | { tab: string; report?: string }>).detail;
      if (!detail) return;
      if (typeof detail === 'string') {
        handleTabSelection(detail as NavItemKey);
      } else if (detail.tab) {
        handleTabSelection(detail.tab as NavItemKey);
        if (detail.report && ['sf1', 'sf2', 'sf4'].includes(detail.report)) {
          startTransition(() => {
            setSelectedReport(detail.report as 'sf1' | 'sf2' | 'sf4');
          });
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('attendsure:navigate', onNavigate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('attendsure:navigate', onNavigate);
  }, [handleTabSelection]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session?.token) return;
    let active = true;
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.me)
      .then((res) => {
        if (!active || !res.data) return;
        setIsServerOnline(true);
        const d = res.data;
        const photo = d.photo_url || d.photo || null;
        const name = String(d.full_name || d.username || '').trim();
        const role = String(d.role || d.system_role || session.role || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
        const userId = Number(d.id || d.user_id || 0);
        const teachFlag = Boolean(d.can_teach || d.is_teaching || d.assigned_class_count > 0 || role === 'FACULTY');

        setUserPhoto(photo);
        if (photo) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', photo);
        else localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_user_photo');

        if (name) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', name);
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_role', role);
        if (userId) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_id', String(userId));
        setCanTeach(teachFlag);
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_can_teach', String(teachFlag));

        if (d.is_profile_completed === false) setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen(true);

        setSession((prev) =>
          prev ? { ...prev, user_id: userId || prev.user_id, faculty_name: name || prev.faculty_name, role } : null
        );
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (!active) return;
        if (!err.response) setIsServerOnline(false);
        else if (err.response?.status === 401) handleAuthExpired();
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [session?.token, handleAuthExpired]);

  const retryConnection = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsCheckingServer(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.health.db, { params: { nocache: 1 } });
      setIsServerOnline(true);
    } catch {
      setIsServerOnline(false);
    } finally {
      setIsCheckingServer(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const pageTitle = useMemo((): string => {
    if (!isAllowed) return 'Access Restricted';
    const prefix = school.school_name ? `${school.school_name} • ` : '';
    switch (activeTab) {
      case 'dashboard': return `${prefix}Dashboard`;
      case 'classroom-scanner': return 'Classroom QR Attendance Scanner';
      case 'my-classes': return 'My Classes & Student Lists';
      case 'advisory-monitor': return 'Advisory Attendance & Cutting Matrix';
      case 'students': return 'Student Directory & QR Cards';
      case 'facultys': return 'Teachers & Staff Directory';
      case 'users': return 'User Accounts & Roles';
      case 'gate-passes': return 'Campus Exit Passes';
      case 'schedules': return 'Sections & Class Schedules';
      case 'dtr': return 'Monthly Time Records (CSC Form 48)';
      case 'geofence': return 'Campus GPS Boundary';
      case 'messages': return 'Parent & Teacher Direct Chat';
      case 'push': return 'Mobile Push Alerts';
      case 'reports':
        return selectedReport === 'sf1'
          ? 'DepEd School Form 1 (Register)'
          : selectedReport === 'sf2'
          ? 'DepEd School Form 2 (Daily Attendance)'
          : 'DepEd School Form 4 (Monthly Movement)';
      case 'settings': return 'School Settings & Audit Logs';
      default: return 'AttendSure Portal';
    }
  }, [activeTab, isAllowed, school.school_name, selectedReport]);

  const renderTab = () => {
    if (!isAllowed) {
      return (
        <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center' }}>
          <ShieldAlert size={36} color={brand.danger} style={{ margin: '0 auto 12px', display: 'block' }} />
          <h2 style={{ margin: '0 0 6px', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Access Restricted</h2>
          <p style={{ color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: '0.84rem' }}>Your role ({userRole}) cannot view this module.</p>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleTabSelection(allowedTabs[0] || 'dashboard')}
            style={{ marginTop: 14, padding: '8px 16px', backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg, color: '#fff', border: 'none', borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}
          >
            <ArrowLeft size={14} /> Back to Dashboard
          </button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    switch (activeTab) {
      case 'dashboard':
        return (
          <DashboardView
            isServerOnline={isServerOnline}
            userRole={userRole}
            onManualRefresh={retryConnection}
            onNavigateTab={(tab, report) => {
              handleTabSelection(tab as NavItemKey);
              if (report && ['sf1', 'sf2', 'sf4'].includes(report)) {
                startTransition(() => setSelectedReport(report as 'sf1' | 'sf2' | 'sf4'));
              }
            }}
          />
        );
      case 'classroom-scanner':
        return <div style={{ padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}><ClassroomScanner /></div>;
      case 'my-classes': return <MyAssignedClassesTab />;
      case 'advisory-monitor':
        return <div style={{ padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}><AdvisorySubjectMonitor /></div>;
      case 'students': return <StudentsTab />;
      case 'facultys': return <FacultyTab />;
      case 'users': return <UsersTab />;
      case 'gate-passes': return <GatePassesTab />;
      case 'schedules': return <SchedulesTab />;
      case 'dtr': return <DTRTab />;
      case 'geofence': return <GeofenceTab />;
      case 'messages': return <ParentChatTab />;
      case 'push': return <PushNotificationsTab />;
      case 'reports':
        return (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%', width: '100%', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            {selectedReport === 'sf1' && <SF1ReportTab activeReportId={selectedReport} onSelectReport={(id) => startTransition(() => setSelectedReport(id as 'sf1' | 'sf2' | 'sf4'))} />}
            {selectedReport === 'sf2' && <SF2ReportTab activeReportId={selectedReport} onSelectReport={(id) => startTransition(() => setSelectedReport(id as 'sf1' | 'sf2' | 'sf4'))} />}
            {selectedReport === 'sf4' && <SF4ReportTab activeReportId={selectedReport} onSelectReport={(id) => startTransition(() => setSelectedReport(id as 'sf1' | 'sf2' | 'sf4'))} />}
          </div>
        );
      case 'settings': return <SettingsTab />;
      default: return <DashboardView isServerOnline={isServerOnline} onManualRefresh={retryConnection} />;
    }
  };

  const resolvedSchoolLogo = school.school_logo || school.left_logo || null;

  return (
    <>
      <SplashScreen loading={isSchoolLoading} minDurationMs={0} />

      {!session ? (
        <LoginView
          onLoginSuccess={(nextSession) => {
            setSession(nextSession);
            setActiveTab('dashboard');
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            height: '100vh',
            width: '100%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgApp,
            padding: 'clamp(6px, 1vw, 12px)',
            gap: 'clamp(6px, 1vw, 12px)',
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ height: '100%', borderRadius: 16, overflow: 'hidden', borderWidth: 1, borderStyle: 'solid', borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle, boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow, flexShrink: 0 }}>
            <Sidebar
              activeTab={activeTab}
              onSelectTab={handleTabSelection}
              onPrefetchTab={prefetchTabResources}
              session={session}
              userPhoto={userPhoto}
              isCollapsed={isSidebarCollapsed}
              onToggleCollapse={() => setIsSidebarCollapsed((p) => !p)}
              schoolName={school.school_name}
              schoolId={school.school_id}
              schoolLogo={resolvedSchoolLogo}
              canTeach={canTeach}
              allowedTabs={allowedTabs}
            />
          </div>

          <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, height: '100%', borderRadius: 16, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, borderWidth: 1, borderStyle: 'solid', borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle, boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <Header
              title={pageTitle}
              isSystemOnline={isServerOnline}
              session={session}
              userPhoto={userPhoto}
              schoolName={school.school_name}
              schoolId={school.school_id}
              schoolLogo={resolvedSchoolLogo}
              onLogout={handleAuthExpired}
              onNavigateTab={handleTabSelection}
              onOpenProfile={() => setIsProfileModalOpen(true)}
            />

            <main style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflowY: activeTab === 'dashboard' || activeTab === 'reports' ? 'hidden' : 'auto', overflowX: 'hidden', position: 'relative', backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
              <ErrorBoundary featureName={pageTitle} resetKeys={[activeTab, selectedReport]}>
                <Suspense fallback={<SubtleSkeletonFallback />}>
                  {renderTab()}
                </Suspense>
              </ErrorBoundary>

              {!isServerOnline && (
                <div onClick={retryConnection} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, zIndex: 35, backgroundColor: 'rgba(15,23,42,0.68)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '10px 20px', borderRadius: 9999, backgroundColor: '#0f172a', color: '#f8fafc', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                    <WifiOff size={16} color="#38bdf8" />
                    {isCheckingServer ? 'Reconnecting...' : 'Server offline. Click to reconnect.'}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </main>

            <Footer
              schoolName={school.school_name}
              schoolId={school.school_id}
              divisionOrCity={school.division}
              isDatabaseConnected={isServerOnline}
              isGateSystemOnline={isServerOnline}
            />
          </div>

          <ProfileModal
            isOpen={isProfileModalOpen}
            onClose={() => setIsProfileModalOpen(false)}
            onProfileUpdated={(updated: ProfileUpdatePayload) => {
              const name = typeof updated.full_name === 'string' && updated.full_name.trim() ? updated.full_name.trim() : undefined;
              if (name) {
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', name);
                setSession((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, faculty_name: name } : null));
              }
              if (updated.photo !== undefined) {
                setUserPhoto(updated.photo || null);
                if (updated.photo) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', updated.photo);
                else localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_user_photo');
              }
            }}
          />

          <CompleteProfileModal
            isOpen={isCompleteProfileModalOpen}
            onCompleted={(updatedUser: CompletedProfileUser) => {
              setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen(false);
              const name = String(updatedUser.full_name || updatedUser.username || '').trim();
              const photo = (typeof updatedUser.photo_url === 'string' && updatedUser.photo_url) || (typeof updatedUser.photo === 'string' && updatedUser.photo) || null;
              if (name) {
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', name);
                setSession((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, faculty_name: name } : null));
              }
              if (photo) {
                setUserPhoto(photo);
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', photo);
              }
            }}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export const App: React.FC = () => (
  <ThemeProvider>
    <SchoolProvider>
      <AlertProvider>
        <AppContent />
      </AlertProvider>
    </SchoolProvider>
  </ThemeProvider>
);

export default App;

/**
 * AttendSure - Instant-Mount Application Entry Point
 * File: web/src/main.tsx
 */

import React from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';
import App from './App';
import './index.css';
import { BRAND_ASSETS } from './components/branding/BrandAssets';

// Mount React immediately on Frame 1 before running optional favicon work
const rootElement = document.getElementById('root');
if (rootElement) {
  ReactDOM.createRoot(rootElement).render(
    <React.StrictMode>
      <App />
    </React.StrictMode>
  );
}

// Generate circular high-contrast favicon only when main thread is idle
const applyAppFavicon = () => {
  try {
    const img = new Image();
    img.decoding = 'async';
    img.src = BRAND_ASSETS.attendsureLogo;
    img.onload = () => {
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = 64;
        canvas.height = 64;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) return;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(32, 32, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.drawImage(img, 10, 10, 44, 44);

        const pngDataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
        document.querySelectorAll("link[rel*='icon']").forEach((el) => el.remove());

        const link = document.createElement('link');
        link.type = 'image/png';
        link.rel = 'icon';
        link.href = pngDataUrl;
        document.head.appendChild(link);
      } catch {
        // Keep inline SVG icon from index.html
      }
    };
  } catch {
    // Non-blocking fallback
  }
};

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  const idle = (window as unknown as { requestIdleCallback?: (cb: () => void) => void }).requestIdleCallback;
  if (idle) idle(applyAppFavicon);
  else setTimeout(applyAppFavicon, 600);
}

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

```js
export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...

      // Remove tseslint.configs.recommended and replace with this
      tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked,
      // Alternatively, use this for stricter rules
      tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked,
      // Optionally, add this for stylistic rules
      tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked,

      // Other configs...
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

You can also install [eslint-plugin-react-x](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-x) and [eslint-plugin-react-dom](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-dom) for React-specific lint rules:

```js
// eslint.config.js
import reactX from 'eslint-plugin-react-x'
import reactDom from 'eslint-plugin-react-dom'

export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {

      // Enable lint rules for React

      // Enable lint rules for React DOM
      reactDom.configs.recommended,
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])
```

        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: false,
        timeout: 10000,
        configure: (proxy) => {
          proxy.on('error', (err, _req, res) => {
            // shield: verify res is an HTTP response before writing headers
            if (res && 'writeHead' in res && typeof res.writeHead === 'function') {
              const httpRes = res as ServerResponse;
              if (!httpRes.headersSent) {
                httpRes.writeHead(502, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                httpRes.end(
                  JSON.stringify({
                    error: 'Backend offline or restarting',
                    detail: err.message,
                  })
                );
              }
            }
          });
        },
      },
      '/media': {
        target: 'http://127.0.0.1:8000',
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: false,
      },
    },
  },
  build: {
    chunkSizeWarningLimit: 1200,
    sourcemap: false, // Cybersecurity: prevent source code leaks in production
    rollupOptions: {
      output: {
        // Universal function syntax compatible with all Vite and Rollup releases
        manualChunks(id: string) {
          if (id.includes('node_modules')) {
            if (id.includes('react') || id.includes('react-dom')) {
              return 'vendor-react';
            }
            if (id.includes('lucide-react')) {
              return 'vendor-icons';
            }
            if (id.includes('axios')) {
              return 'vendor-network';
            }
          }
        },
      },
    },
  },
});

services:
  redis:
    image: redis:7.2-alpine
    container_name: attendsure_redis

      - "6379:6379"
